descriptionHtml:

  • Understand Agile software development and DevOps practices and can work closely with your peers and other mid to large size teams

descriptionHtml:
As BWE’s DevOps Engineer, you own how software gets built, tested, and released. BWE’s AI and Data teams are producing custom applications, agents, and integrations faster than they can safely deploy them, and this role is the delivery path: pipelines, packaging, environments, and the automation that makes releases repeatable, reversible, and auditable. You work across an Azure and Microsoft 365 environment in a regulated commercial real estate finance business, where every change needs a record. This is a builder’s role for an engineer who would rather automate a release than perform one.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Build and Release Engineering: Own the build, test, and release path for BWE’s custom applications and integrations so changes reach production on a predictable, repeatable cadence.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Build and maintain pipelines that lint, test, validate, and deploy application code and configuration, with automated quality gates ahead of production.
  • Software Packaging and Deployment: Package and deploy custom applications and internal tooling across environments, including versioning, rollback, and release documentation.
  • Environment Management: Provision and maintain development, test, and production environments, including configuration, secrets management, and promotion between environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Define infrastructure and platform state declaratively, keep it in version control, and deploy it through an automated, peer-reviewed process.
  • Source Control Standards: Establish and maintain Git workflow standards across BWE development work, including branching, pull request review, and release traceability.
  • AI Application Delivery: Provide the delivery path for AI-developed applications, including deployment of agents, integrations, and MCP connectors into supported environments.
  • Developer Enablement: Support the AI and Data teams in adopting source control, review, and deployment practices, and remove manual steps between working code and production.
  • Platform Integration: Integrate systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven automation so data moves between platforms without manual re-entry.
  • Pipeline Security: Implement code scanning, dependency, and software supply chain controls in the pipeline against standards set with Information Security.
  • Observability: Instrument applications and pipelines with monitoring, alerting, and dashboards covering deployment health, failure rates, and time to recover.
  • Change Evidence: Produce change history, approval records, and deployment evidence sufficient for agency, rating agency, and client review.
  • Platform Escalation: Serve as Tier 3 escalation for the pipelines, environments, and deployment tooling this role owns.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering, or software delivery, with hands-on responsibility for production deployments.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application code, not only scripts and configuration.
  • Strong proficiency with Git-based workflows, including branching, pull request review, and release tagging.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and declarative configuration management.
  • Strong automation ability in Python, PowerShell, or equivalent, including building against REST APIs.
  • Experience managing application environments, including secrets management and promotion between environments.
  • Experience deploying to Azure or an equivalent cloud platform.
  • Experience producing change and deployment records suitable for audit or compliance review.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience helping data or AI engineering teams move prototypes into supported production services.
  • Experience integrating LLM applications, agents, or MCP connectors into enterprise environments.
  • Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Foundry, or comparable data and AI platforms.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration, or running automation as event-driven services.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including service principals and application registrations.
  • Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Certifications such as Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or equivalent.

We encourage you to explore the career opportunities we have available here at BWE!

Please note, BWE will not sponsor applicants for this position for immigration benefits, including but not limited to assisting with obtaining work permission for F-1 students, H-1B professionals, O-1 workers, TN workers, E-3 workers, among other immigration statuses. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

descriptionHtml:
About Sphinx

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better.

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

About The Role

Sphinx is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team, building the next generation of mission planning and command and control software for space communications programs. This team is charged with creating modern, resilient services and capabilities to service the US Government for the next decade and beyond.

We're seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to help take our build and deployment automation to the next level. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will build the development and deployment infrastructure used by our Space Communications team, which provides infrastructure for a wide variety of US Government satellites; you will play a key role in building a cutting-edge communications platform for US government satellites. You will have a role in determining what we build and how we work. You'll work as an individual contributor and a lead for more junior engineers.

What You Will Be Focusing On

  • Working with a team to develop and operate automated build and deployment infrastructure in GitLab CI/CD and Atlantis
  • Developing and operating automated build and deployment infrastructure
  • Writing and maintaining Cloud Infrastructure
  • Owning technical problems end-to-end
  • Maintain multiple Kubernetes clusters in production
  • Packaging software into Helm Charts
  • Writing and maintaining Cloud Infrastructure with Terraform
  • Configure and maintain a federated message bus infrastructure
  • Maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Supporting software engineering teams with the use and integration of pipelines and cloud infrastructure
  • Ensuring developed infrastructure and CI/CD solutions seamlessly deploy/integrate with third-party platforms and infrastructures

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • You have 5+ years of progressively responsible software engineering experience in a DevOps role
  • Leveraged a major cloud provider's (AWS, Azure, GCP) services in a production setting
  • A habit of self-directed learning of new technologies
  • Strong experience with either Python or Go
  • Strong experience with Ansible automation
  • You have made enough mistakes and booked enough wins to know what not to build and what good looks like
  • The ability to see through the noise to the most critical problem.
  • The ability to provide technical leadership, guide, and mentor junior engineers
  • Excellent communication skills, working with end-users to design and build solutions to their needs, a habit of self-directed learning of new technologies, and the ability to learn quickly and adapt to a fast-paced environment
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government TS/SCI clearance

LOCATION

This role is a hybrid role based in Colorado Springs, CO that offers flexibility while supporting collaboration on classified work. This role will require onsite work as needed to support secure program requirements.

Compensation

This role is between $160,000 - $195,000 base salary.

Benefits

Compensation includes competitive salary, meaningful equity ownership, profit sharing, employer 401(k) contribution, and 100% employer covered medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents.

EEO STATEMENT

At Sphinx Defense, we are devoted to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Sphinx Defense is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position requires eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

descriptionHtml:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.

How We Work

  • We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
  • Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
  • Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
  • We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

About The Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Blitzy, you will be a critical force behind the infrastructure powering our cutting-edge AI agents and enterprise software development platform. Based out of our Cambridge, MA headquarters, you'll architect and maintain the scalable, resilient systems that enable Blitzy to autonomously deliver production-ready software at unprecedented speed. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an engineer who thrives in a fast-moving environment and takes deep ownership of the systems they build.

Responsibilities

  • Build, manage, and scale Kubernetes clusters supporting AI agent workloads and production application deployments.
  • Design and implement robust CI/CD pipelines for both application services and AI-driven workflows.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and operations using Python and Terraform.
  • Deploy and maintain applications via Helm charts, ensuring consistency across environments.
  • Own the observability stack: alerting, distributed tracing, and monitoring for all production services and APIs.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure for AI agent orchestration, enabling reliable and high-throughput agent execution.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to improve developer experience, deployment strategies, and operational tooling.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the security, reliability, and cost-efficiency of our cloud environments.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience in production environments.
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes including deployment, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong Python proficiency for automation, scripting, and tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with Helm for application package management.
  • Proven track record designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or, Azure).
  • Proficiency with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong Linux administration skills and containerization expertise (Docker).

Compensation: $160,000-$230,000 + Bonus +Equity

Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process

descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Job Description

Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: Top Secret SCI + CI Polygraph

Millennial Software is seeking a DevOps Software Engineer to join our team. You will be working closely with a talented team to deliver a complex software application into operations. In addition, you'll have the opportunity to grow and hone your skills with other talented members at Millennial Software. Our ideal candidate is a DevSecOps Engineer who is a hard charging self-starter that can come onto a team and begin to produce quickly. You should have a strong understanding of IaC, containerization, automated test, and deployment pipelines to evolve our existing software infrastructure and architecture.

Essential Functions

  • Utilize strong technical foundation with skills such as scripting and working to get tools from production into operation using software engineering skills.

  • Maintain current knowledge of engineering practices and technical solutions.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement automated test tools and strategies.
  • Take direction from senior technical leadership and/or Project Manager on project specifications.
  • Setup, configure and maintain various EC2 and Containerized environments to support development, test, integration, and operational software threads.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of comprehensive CICD pipelines with seamless automation
  • Support agile development activities including sprint planning, peer code reviews, and iterative updates based on end-user feedback
  • Help maintain clean, well-documented, and testable code

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Active TS/SCI with CI Poly
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline
  • 6+ years of relevant experience (or 4+ years with a Graduate Degree)
  • Experience with automated deployment technologies such as Terraform and Ansible
  • Linux system administration experience (RedHat 8/9).
  • Experience with scripting languages (Bash, Python).
  • Prior experience using Kubernetes to orchestrate the deployment, scaling, and management of Docker containers.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Monitoring and Observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for troubleshooting
  • Experience with Container registry management (Harbor)
  • Experience with how to deploy and maintain Helm charts
  • Familiarity with GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Must hold active Security+ certification.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and its core services (i.e., EC2, S3, SQS).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Software development experience
  • Demonstrable experience in some of the following areas:
    • Infrastructure-as-code (IAC) maintained using Salt, Ansible, and Puppet.
    • Developing software pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Gitlab-CI, and Artifactory.
    • Application containerization and on-premises Kubernetes integration.
    • Utilizing and developing primarily in Linux.
    • Working knowledge of software engineering and quality assurance processes.
    • Technical background in software development (language agnostic).
  • Ability to script in various languages (e.g., Python, Bash, groovy.).
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Object oriented software development in memory safe languages
  • Experience scripting with Bash, Python, and Make.
  • Experience in CMake and C++ development.
  • Experience with RHEL 7/8/9 environments as well as Ubuntu or Debian.
  • RedHat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
  • Knowledge of network firewalls, routing, subnetting, and port mappings.
  • Experience with security implementations such as SELinux, FAPolicyd, and security scans.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, SEC+).
  • Experience developing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.

companyDescription:
PrePass is North America’s most trusted provider of integrated weigh station bypass, electronic toll management, and compliance solutions. Designed to work with a fleet’s existing operations, PrePass leverages GPS and the PrePass Mobile App to help commercial fleets save time, reduce costs, improve safety scores (ISS), and increase driver productivity. 
For more than 30 years, PrePass has led freight transportation innovation by connecting weigh station bypass, safety screening, toll management, and actionable data into a streamlined ecosystem. Together, these capabilities empower fleets of all sizes to operate more efficiently while staying compliant and competitive.
Today, more than 100,000 fleets representing over 800,000 vehicles rely on PrePass to increase productivity, reduce friction, and keep trucks moving.
PrePass is operated by the PrePass Safety Alliance, a nonprofit public-private partnership governed by a board of state transportation and enforcement agencies alongside motor carrier industry leaders. This collaborative model advances the PrePass mission of improving safety and efficiency on our nation’s highways while serving the public interest in commercial vehicle operations. Through strategic oversight and industry alignment, it helps ensure PrePass technologies consistently deliver meaningful value to both fleets and enforcement partners.
descriptionHtml:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We're transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It's what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That's why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About The Role

The DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in driving automation, reliability, and scalability across PrePass's software delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure. This role supports both development and production environments and is central to our migration and ongoing operations within GitHub, GitHub Actions, and Azure. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to improve deployment efficiency, system stability, and operational excellence.

Essential Responsibilities


CI/CD Pipeline Management

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to support automated build, test, and deployment workflows
  • Integrate pipelines with Azure services to enable multi-cloud deployments
  • Ensure pipelines are reusable, templated, and well-documented to support team-wide adoption


Source Control & Collaboration

  • Manage GitHub repositories, enforce branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow), and oversee pull request workflows
  • Partner with development teams to migrate codebases from Azure DevOps to GitHub, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication


Cloud Infrastructure Management

  • Provision, configure, and manage cloud resources in Azure (VMs, AKS, App Services, Function Apps, API Managment Gateway, Azure Container Apps)
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures, including VPN configuration and network security


Automation, Monitoring & Reliability

  • Automate operational tasks using scripting languages such as PowerShell or Bash
  • Monitor and optimize application and infrastructure performance using Datadog and Azure Monitor
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues and production outages, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive solutions


Security & Compliance

  • Integrate security controls into CI/CD workflows following DevSecOps best practices
  • Manage secrets and credentials securely across GitHub, Azure, and AWS environments
  • Ensure systems and processes comply with organizational and regulatory standards


Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate new tools and technologies to enhance DevOps practices and platform reliability
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical discussions and process improvements


Requirements

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD automation
  • Proficiency with Azure cloud platform, including resource provisioning, networking, and security
  • Experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code
  • Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes or AKS
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools, including Datadog and Azure Monitor
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and cloud security best practices


Bonus / Preferred Skills (a Plus, But Not Required)

  • Experience with MySQL database management
  • Familiarity with ArgoCD
  • Experience with AWS


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset
  • Ability to work effectively in agile, cross-functional teams


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps or a related engineering role
  • Relevant Azure or DevOps certifications are a plus


Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays
  • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Company-funded "lifestyle account" upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships)
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you)
  • Company-sponsored and funded "Culture Team" that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees
  • Community Give-Back initiatives
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let's drive progress—together.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will bring proven experience with both AWS and Azure, containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, automation tools, GitOps methodologies, and release engineering best practices.

You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and automated deployment workflows — working closely with developers, QA, and operations teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality software releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and automation tooling
  • Manage and optimize infrastructure across AWS and Azure environments
  • Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot applications using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Implement GitOps workflows utilizing ArgoCD
  • Automate provisioning and configuration management with Ansible and AWX
  • Administer and maintain Linux and Windows Server systems in hybrid environments
  • Collaborate on release engineering processes: versioning, packaging, testing, and automated deployment
  • Monitor system health, implement security policies, and ensure high availability for critical services
  • Develop automation, tooling, and scripts using Bash, Python, or PowerShell
  • Troubleshoot production issues across multiple systems and platforms

Requirements

Required

  • Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role with at least five (5) years of experience
  • Expertise with AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure and services
  • Strong background in Docker and Kubernetes
  • Proficiency with Linux administration and shell scripting
  • Experience with GitOps principles and ArgoCD
  • Configuration management experience using Ansible and orchestration with AWX
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD using GitLab
  • Knowledge of release engineering concepts: build processes, artifact repositories, deployment workflows
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across software, infrastructure, and network layers
  • Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar)

Preferred

  • Experience managing Windows Server environments
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.)
  • AWS or Azure DevOps-related certifications

Soft Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in agile, fast-paced environments
  • Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to quality delivery

Education

Job Description

The Role

The Airflow Platform team is building Fidelity’s enterprise Apache Airflow platform, providing the foundation for running business-critical workflows reliably and at scale.

We design and deliver the platform capabilities, automation, security, and operational tooling needed to support enterprise workloads. Working closely with application, infrastructure, security, and production support teams, we are focused on delivering a secure, resilient, and highly automated platform while simplifying adoption and creating a strong developer experience.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Deploy, configure, and support Apache Airflow in Kubernetes environments using Helm.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Jenkins, and JFrog Artifactory.
  • Develop automated deployment, release, and promotion processes across multiple environments.
  • Manage application packaging, artifact versioning, and release workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Airflow, Kubernetes, deployment pipelines, and platform infrastructure.
  • Partner with architects, developers, and infrastructure teams to implement platform enhancements and operational improvements.
  • Improve platform reliability through automation, monitoring, logging, and operational best practices.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and support procedures.

The Skills And Experience You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on experience deploying applications to Kubernetes using Helm charts.
  • Experience administering, supporting, or deploying Open Source Apache Airflow.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Jenkins, and Git-based development workflows.
  • Experience managing build artifacts, repositories, and release processes using JFrog Artifactory.
  • Experience with containerized applications and Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native platform operations.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience troubleshooting production environments, deployment pipelines, and platform infrastructure.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating across globally distributed engineering teams.

The Team

The team consists of architects and engineers across the U.S. and India who work closely together to deliver the platform, automation, and operational capabilities required to run Apache Airflow at enterprise scale. The team's focus is enabling reliable, secure, and automated deployment and operation of Airflow while providing a strong foundation for application teams adopting the platform.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

A Principal DevOps Engineer works with developers and IT staff to oversee the code releases, combining an understanding of both engineering and coding. From creating and implementing systems software to analyzing data to improve the applications and environments, a DevOps Engineer increases productivity in the workplace. They understand the software development lifecycle and have a clear understanding of various automation tools for developing digital pipelines (CI/CD pipelines).

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Build CI/CD Pipelines: Create automated systems to test and deploy code quickly.

  • Mentor Team Members: Guide junior engineers and review their technical work.

Requires a Bachelor's Degree and minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

DevOps System Engineer

Candidate will develop CI/CD build and deploy pipelines; integrate tools into the pipeline and manage debugging integration issues. In addition, selected candidate will help integrate with various tools for the DevOps process.

Responsibilties include:

  • Development of CI/CD Build and Deployment Pipelines
  • Write/modify Jenkins-based groovy scripts
  • Write/update Terraform scripts
  • Troubleshoot pipeline issues across on-prem, Openshift environments and AWS Environments
  • Document key features for developer use
  • Help write and maintain scripts for process improvements (ex: stage/unstage builds, branch tag automation, automating variance corrections across networks)
  • Work with Helm charts to deploy container based microservices
  • Integrate tools into the pipeline
  • Work with the development teams to bring in new microservices into the pipeline. Helping troubleshoot as necessary.
  • Work through steps to automate installations of COTS products into the architecture
  • Debugging integration issues
  • Help identify issues in the deployment (i.e. potentially intermittent connectivity issues from an API Server to the Database)
  • Monitor (and help develop scripts to monitor) services to ensure everything is functioning as necessary
  • DevOps Tool Integration
  • Help integrate with various tools for the DevOps process (SonarQube, Fortify, Jenkins, Robot Framework/Selenium, Artifactory, etc...)

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with ability to obtain/maintain a polygraph
  • DoD IAT Level II Certification (Security + CE, CISSP, etc.)
  • Bachelor's degree and 8 years of relevant experience OR a Master's degree with 6 years of relevant experience; an additional 4 years of relevant experience considered in lieu of the degree requirement
  • Experience with Linux Environments
  • Experience with scripting languages, such as Bash and Python
  • Basic understanding of an Object-Oriented Programming Language, such as Java
  • Experience with Openshift or similar container environment

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
C.H. Robinson is seeking a DevOps Software Engineer III to help build, maintain, and evolve the platforms that power our software delivery ecosystem. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure while partnering with development, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to accelerate innovation across the organization.

This position is open to candidates located in Minneapolis, Chicago, or Kansas City.

Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of critical DevOps platforms and services supporting enterprise application delivery
  • Design, build, and support continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure across Windows, Linux, containerized, and cloud-based environments
  • Develop and maintain automated infrastructure and deployment solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripting, and configuration management tools
  • Support Kubernetes, Docker, build agents, deployment platforms, and application delivery tools used across development teams
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex software delivery, deployment, and infrastructure issues across application, platform, networking, and operating system layers
  • Partner with application, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, secure, and supportable technology solutions
  • Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance while proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability and operational efficiency
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce operational risk and prevent recurring issues
  • Evaluate emerging DevOps, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to improve developer productivity and platform capabilities
  • Promote engineering best practices through technical documentation, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and advocacy of DevOps principles

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IS, MIS, or other technology degree or 4+ years of equivalent work experience and high school diploma/GED
  • 4+ years of Enterprise application development experience, and experience maintaining, supporting, and deploying to production systems
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, and the principles of continuous integration and continuous deployment
  • Experience with infrastructure automation or infrastructure-as-code practices

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting .NET, Python and/or Node.js build ecosystems; with hands-on software development experience in one or more of these technologies
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins and/or Octopus Deploy
  • Experience with JFrog Artifactory or similar artefact and package management platforms
  • Experience with Azure, VMware or similar cloud and virtualisation platforms
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Terraform and Ansible
  • Knowledge of networking, DNS, certificates, identity, secrets management, storage and security principles
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, incident response, disaster recovery and production support
  • Familiarity with using and supporting AI development tooling to enhance developer productivity, CI/CD, automation and operational efficiency
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across application and infrastructure teams
  • A learning and growth mindset that is open to giving and receiving feedback
  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

Compensation Range

$102,700.00 - $231,100.00

The base pay range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only and do not include additional variable compensation.

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

The Tooling Team is part of the DevOps organization and supports scalable, secure CI/CD and platform tooling across Alarm.com engineering teams. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer (3-5 years of experience) to build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud deployment frameworks that support Alarm.com's engineering organization. This role focuses on build and release work including managing pipelines, deployments, and the infrastructure behind them. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality Engineering, Operations, and Release Management to modernize build and release workflows, reduce operational toil, and improve reliability, performance, and developer productivity.

This position is based on-site at our corporate headquarters in Tysons Corner, Virginia.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks
  • Build and manage infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices
  • Own provisioning, configuration, and deployment automation for the services you support
  • Manage build and release environments (VMs, containers, and cloud resources)
  • Work with Kubernetes (RKE2 and AKS) and ArgoCD to deploy and maintain services using GitOps practices
  • Monitor system performance, scalability, availability, and security using Grafana dashboards and alerts
  • Troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure issues, and deployment failures, including escalations from the engineering teams we support
  • Document processes and contribute to continuous improvement efforts
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation after an initial ramp-up period


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience required
  • 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, Build & Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Software Engineering
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (C#, Java, Python, PowerShell, or similar)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or GitHub Actions
  • Solid scripting experience with PowerShell and/or Bash
  • Working experience with Azure and/or AWS
  • Working experience with Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform
  • Comfortable administering Windows Server and/or Linux systems
  • Able to troubleshoot production issues and drive them to resolution with limited direction
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with engineers outside the DevOps organization


Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM?

  • Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.
  • Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!
  • Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
  • Community and Camaraderie: One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work.
  • Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office 4 days a week.


Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

Company Benefits

Our total rewards package is designed to support you holistically—in your health, your finances, and your life outside of work. The package includes medical plans with company subsidies, a Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution, and a 401(k) with an employer match. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with paid vacation that increases with tenure, paid holidays, wellness time, and paid maternity and bonding leave. To complete the package, we also provide company-paid disability and life insurance, all within a collaborative and casual work environment.

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision.

Notice To Third Party Agencies:

Alarm.com understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com.

The base salary range of this opportunity is listed below and is determined within a range based on factors including qualifications, location and experience. This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role. The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package.

Base Salary Range

$90,000—$135,000 USD

Ready for your next career step? We are seeking talented Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer with 8+ years hands-on experience to join our dynamic Agile software teams in Omaha, Nebraska. This opportunity will provide professional growth that is singularly focused on providing world class solutions to our customers in an exciting, collaborative, and inclusive environment. You will be challenged and provided with a tremendous opportunity to expand your skills in a customer-facing, fast-paced, and rewarding environment.

You’ll leverage your skills to provide their expertise in infrastructure provisioning and configuration and software deployment across the software development lifecycle. In this role, there is the potential to support multiple contracts to help provide growth and broadening opportunities within Leidos.

Most of the work will be on site in Leidos' facility in Omaha, Nebraska. Some level of remote/work from home is possible.

Primary Responsibilities

  • All aspects of the software development lifecycle including scope and work estimation, architecture and design, coding, Leverage open-source and in-house tools to manage infrastructure via code, designing reusable infrastructure components for scalable, highly-available, secure architectures for container-based and non-container-based applications.
  • Assist in providing input and expertise to senior engineers to maintain alignments with best practices and recommending system improvements while overseeing the automated deployment, roll-back, and monitoring of applications into software development, test, and production environment.
  • Mentor fellow DevOps Engineers as needed.
  • Develop automated CI/CD build/deployment pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker/Podman, and Ansible.
  • Apply DevOps expertise to ensure congruence of the various infrastructure, software, configurations and interfaces maintained under configuration control.
  • Work with an Agile team, attend daily scrums; communicating and collaborating frequently with teammates to ensure successful completion of project objectives.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve installation, infrastructure, and system issues.
  • Proactively and independently identify, report, monitor, and mitigate technical risks.

Basic Qualifications

  • US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of prior relevant experience or a Master’s degree with 6+ years of experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Knowledge and understanding of DevOps trends and technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Git and experience with development workflows in GitLab, Bitbucket or an equivalent tool.
  • Experience designing, building and deploying DevOps pipelines with GitLab, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience designing and implementing application deployment pipelines and developing software in a containerized environment with Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Experience with Kubernetes application deployment/management tools such as Helm or Kustomize.
  • Full software lifecycle automation experience (design, development, test, deployment), including deployment to a production environment.
  • Experience with automated provisioning and configuration tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Ansible or similar technologies.
  • Experience integrating code review systems into the SCM process.
  • Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems, network administration, and networking protocols/functions (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS, SSL/TLS, SMTP, DNS.).
  • Experience working with Agile software development teams and implementing continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
  • Excellent problem solving and analysis skills, including the ability to logically create structure and order from unstructured inputs.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • US Citizen with an active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • Experience developing and deploying software in a DoD environment (DISA experience is a plus), including experience building and deploying software applications that meet DoD security standards and updating applications and code to meet security scans and security implementation guidelines (e.g. STIGs).
  • Experience with GitOps concepts and related tools, such as Argo CD.
  • Experience designing, developing and deploying software in a cloud environment (Azure is a plus).
  • Experience with static code analysis, particularly security scans.
  • Experience designing and building automated software testing pipelines using Ansible, Selenium, JMeter, Junit and/or other applicable tools.
  • Kubernetes certification such as CKA or CKAD.
  • Professional cybersecurity certification such as Security+, or similar.
  • ITIL v3 Foundations Certification.

descriptionHtml:
At Rite-Hite, your work makes an impact. As the global leader in loading dock and door equipment, we design and deliver solutions that keep our customers safe, secure, and productive. Here, you’ll find innovation, stability, and the chance to grow your career as part of a team that’s always looking ahead.

Core Responsibilities

Platform Engineering and Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines that support automated build, test, and deployment workflows using GitLab CI/CD and standardized Git workflows.
  • Develop and maintain reusable pipeline templates, infrastructure modules, and automation patterns that enable consistent and efficient delivery across teams.
  • Continuously improve deployment speed, reliability, and quality through automation and tooling enhancements.

Cloud Infrastructure and Kubernetes Operations

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), with a primary focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Deploy, operate, and maintain Kubernetes clusters, particularly Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), ensuring high availability, scalability, and resilience.
  • Package and manage Kubernetes applications using Helm charts and established deployment standards.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to support cloud-native application architectures and runtime requirements.

Reliability, Monitoring, and Incident Response

  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system performance, availability, and operational visibility (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring).
  • Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis to restore service and prevent recurrence.
  • Contribute to fault-tolerant and resilient system designs that support production reliability and operational excellence.

Security and Compliance Enablement

  • Apply secure-by-design principles across CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, and Kubernetes environments, including secrets management, access controls, and least-privilege IAM.
  • Collaborate with security and platform stakeholders to integrate vulnerability scanning, configuration hardening, and compliance requirements into delivery workflows.
  • Support organizational security, audit, and compliance initiatives by ensuring infrastructure and deployment processes are auditable, repeatable, and well-documented.

Collaboration and Documentation

  • Work closely with software engineers, QA, and platform stakeholders to understand delivery needs and remove friction from the development lifecycle.
  • Document infrastructure designs, deployment patterns, operational procedures, and architectural decisions to support knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability.
  • Promote DevOps best practices, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This role does not have direct reports but is expected to provide technical leadership, guidance, and enablement across multiple engineering teams.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field required; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure roles supporting production systems.
  • Experience operating cloud-native environments and supporting modern software delivery pipelines.

Knowledge / Skill Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Strong proficiency with Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience managing infrastructure using Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Experience packaging and deploying applications using Helm.
  • Strong experience with GitLab, including CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, with preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python or Go; experience with Node.js is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Familiarity with distributed tracing tools such as Google Cloud Trace.
  • Experience supporting security, compliance, or regulated environments.
  • Prior experience working in agile or product-driven development environments.
  • Relevant cloud or Kubernetes certifications (e.g., Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA) are a plus.

WHY JOIN RITE-HITE DIGITAL SOLUTIONS?

At Rite-Hite, you’ll be part of a technology-driven organization that is transforming how industrial safety, productivity, and service solutions are delivered worldwide. As a DevOps Engineer, you will directly influence the reliability, security, and scalability of platforms that support thousands of customers and critical industrial operations.

You’ll work alongside talented engineers, product leaders, and platform teams to build modern, cloud-native systems with real-world impact—bridging digital innovation with physical environments where safety and uptime matter most.

What We Offer

At Rite-Hite, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work:

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life and disability insurance. A robust well-being program with an opportunity to receive an extra day off and more.
  • Financial Security: A strong retirement savings program with 401(k), company match, and profit sharing.
  • Time for You: Paid holidays, vacation time, and personal/sick days each year.

Join us and build a career where you’re supported – at work and beyond.

Rite-Hite is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. In accordance with VEVRAA, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for protected veterans. We are also committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace for the safety of our employees and customers.

- Work closely with software engineers, QA, and platform stakeholders to understand delivery needs and remove friction from the development lifecycle.
- Document infrastructure designs, deployment patterns, operational procedures, and architectural decisions to support knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability.
- Promote DevOps best practices, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.

Supervisory Responsibilities



- This role does not have direct reports but is expected to provide technical leadership, guidance, and enablement across multiple engineering teams.

Qualifications

Education & Experience



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field required; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

- Experience operating cloud-native environments and supporting modern software delivery pipelines.

Knowledge / Skill Requirements



- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
- Strong proficiency with Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
- Experience managing infrastructure using Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tools.

Job Summary

The DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing and managing CI/CD pipelines, developing Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and ensuring system compliance and security. This role involves automating processes to improve development efficiency, conducting root cause analysis for production issues, and integrating AWS and Azure services into existing infrastructure. The DevOps Engineer will collaborate with development teams to implement new features while ensuring adherence to best practices in software development.

Role Description

  • Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Monitor system performance and manage source code, ensuring operations reports are accurate.
  • Ensure systems are updated, compliant with standards, and secure against cyber threats.
  • Develop and maintain on-premises tooling solutions.
  • Automate processes to enhance development efficiency and outcomes.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for production issues to prevent recurrence.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate new software features.
  • Oversee the integration of AWS and Azure services into the existing infrastructure.
  • Ensure software development follows best practices and established processes.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Adaptability: Can adjust to changes in the work environment, manage multiple tasks, and effectively handle uncertainty.
  • Analytical Thinking: Can apply critical thinking to analyze data, identify patterns, and make basic inferences.
  • Collaboration: Can actively participate in team discussions, respect differing opinions, and collaborate with others to achieve common goals.
  • Continuous Improvement: Can identify moderate areas for improvement and implement moderate changes.
  • Digital Acumen: Can identify opportunities to use digital tools for improvement and propose digital solutions.
  • Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.
  • Technical Expertise: Can apply technical knowledge and skills effectively in most situations, with occasional guidance.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Knowledge of AWS and Azure Cloud Platforms and associated services - Basic
  • Expertise in various project management frameworks such as Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum to effectively plan, execute, and close projects - Basic
  • Knowledge of network protocols and technologies (TCP/IP, VPN, VLANs), understanding of security concepts (access control, authentication, encryption), and proficiency in managing network threats and security solutions (intrusion detection systems, firewalls, Anti-DDOS Protection, Threat Management Protection, Content Filtering, Ingress/Egress management) - Basic
  • Ability to utilize version control systems such as Git and Azure DevOps effectively - Basic
  • Competence in managing and maintaining Active Directory, AWS, VMware, and Windows Server platforms - Basic
  • Ability to effectively utilize tools such as Jenkins, Groovy, Terraform, Splunk, Git, CodeCommit, and/or SonarSource for development and operational processes - Basic
  • Ability to design, develop, and integrate APIs to enable seamless communication between software applications and services - Basic

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required
  • 1-3 years of experience in cloud computing required
  • 1-3 years of experience in a similar role required
  • 1-3 year of experience in AWS or Azure preferred

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $90,000 - $145,000 which includes a base salary. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Black Book is looking for a Mid-to-Senior DevOps Engineer with a minimum of 3 years' experience in DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Operations to help build, automate and operate the CI/CD and cloud platforms that support our automotive data and technology products.

As part of the Hearst Transportation group, Black Book combines automotive expertise, data science, predictive analytics, APIs and modern cloud technology to help dealerships, lenders, OEMs, insurers, fleet operators and other automotive businesses make better decisions.

You'll work closely with software engineers, data engineers, data scientists and analysts to improve how applications and infrastructure are built, deployed, monitored and supported.

Hybrid: This hybrid role is based in our Lawrenceville, Georgia office.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate highly available AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and automation.
  • Improve CI/CD and GitOps workflows.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar tools.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across applications, containers, networking and cloud infrastructure.
  • Improve observability, reliability, security, performance and cost efficiency.
  • Partner with development and data teams to promote DevOps and shift-left practices.
  • Participate in incident response and help eliminate root causes.
  • Document solutions, share knowledge and mentor teammates.
  • Support customer-impacting issues when needed.

What You'll Bring

This is not a ticket-driven infrastructure role. We're looking for an engineer who enjoys automation, troubleshooting complex problems, improving platforms and taking ownership from idea through production.

Our Environment Includes

AWS

  • Kubernetes/EKS
  • Pulumi
  • Argo CD
  • Azure DevOps
  • Python
  • PowerShell
  • Bash
  • Linux
  • Windows
  • Grafana
  • AI Engineering Tools

You don't need experience with every tool. Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and the ability to learn matter more than matching our stack exactly.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Operations.
  • Experience building or supporting production cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong AWS knowledge or experience with another major cloud provider.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code such as Pulumi, Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of automation and shift-left engineering practices.
  • Ability to automate using Python, PowerShell, Bash or another programming language.
  • Experience with Linux and/or Windows environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
  • Strong communication, ownership and technical judgment.
  • Ability to use modern AI development and engineering tools, such as Claude Code and similar AI agents, to accelerate development, troubleshooting, automation, documentation and research, going beyond basic prompting or code completion.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:

EKS, Helm, Argo CD, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, networking and DNS, REST or GraphQL APIs, .NET, Node.js, DevSecOps, SRE practices, MCP servers or AI agent/tool integrations.

We Value Engineers Who Can

  • Give agents clear context, constraints and acceptance criteria.
  • Build reusable skills, hooks, instructions and workflows.
  • Connect agents to appropriate tools, repositories, APIs and documentation.
  • Use automated validation and guardrails around agent-driven work.
  • Critically review AI-generated code, infrastructure and recommendations.
  • Understand the security implications of agent access and permissions.
  • Recognize when AI is the right tool-and when it isn't.

We view AI as an engineering multiplier, not a substitute for engineering judgment.

How We Work

We value engineers who:

  • Shift left and automate recurring problems.
  • Own outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
  • Keep learning and adapt as technology changes.
  • Embrace ambiguity and work through unfamiliar problems.
  • Choose simplicity over unnecessary complexity.
  • Use AI effectively while validating its work.
  • Think about the customer and the reliability of the systems they depend on.
  • Share knowledge and help the team improve.

Benefits

As part of Hearst, Black Book offers modern, flexible benefits designed to support you and your family. Benefits include:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • HSA contributions
  • 401(k) matching
  • Emotional wellness support
  • Paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Volunteer days
  • LGBTQ+ health services
  • Additional benefits to meet you and your family's needs

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector is seeking a DevOps Engineer - Level 3/4 to join our team. This position is located in Redondo Beach, CA.

  • Please be aware that this position is contingent upon obtaining and maintaining associated business and/or customer funding and obtaining final clearances and program access(es) within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company. Continued employment thereafter will be subject to maintenance at the level of clearance and program access required for the position in the future.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To, The Following

  • Develop and automate creative solutions.
  • System analysis, design, develop, build, test, implement, and maintain various systems to meet functional objectives of the business.
  • Work with a wide variety of technologies: Jenkins, Fortify, Ansible, Atlassian suite, TeamForge, ASP, Visual Build, Docker, Kubernetes and many more.
  • Implement provisioning and deployment techniques via packaging, containerizing or Cloud distribution.
  • Function with agile principles to execute efficiently in an environment of continuous feedback.
  • Ensure implementation of Software Configuration Management (SCM), code quality, and code coverage with automated testing for Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

This position can be filled at either a level 3 or a level 4 based on qualifications listed below.

Basic Qualifications For DevOps Engineer - Level 3

  • 5 years of relevant experience with Bachelors; 3 years of relevant experience with Masters; 1 year of relevant experience with PhD; an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree
  • Active Secret clearance required at the time of application
  • Proficiency in DevOps tools and platforms (e.g., GitLab CI/CD or Azure DevOps)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, or AWS)
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, or Helm)
  • Experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform)
  • Experience with managing scalable, high-availability computer environments

Basic Qualifications For DevOps Engineer - Level 4

  • 8 years of relevant experience with Bachelors; 6 years of relevant experience with Masters; 4 years of relevant experience with PhD; an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree
  • Proficiency in DevOps tools and platforms (e.g., GitLab CI/CD or Azure DevOps)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, or AWS)
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, or Helm)
  • Experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform)
  • Experience with managing scalable, high-availability computer environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GFx enterprise architectures and frameworks a plus
  • Experience creating, developing, and implementing solutions to address requirements
  • Experience with developing microservices
  • Familiarity with API Security and Container Security
  • Proficiency with Agile collaboration and tracking tools such as Atlassian Tools

Primary Level Salary Range: $118,000.00 - $176,500.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $147,500.00 - $221,000.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives.
