descriptionHtml:
An experienced Senior DevOps engineer is required to join the Technology Operations (TTO) team within LSEG Markets & Risk Intelligence. You will be part of a team that will help us build the future of financial services on blockchain technology. The team is responsible for the delivery and support of production environments which are typically housed within Azure, as well as integrating software changes into the enterprise environment as part of ongoing project work. The role includes participation in an on-call rota to ensure coverage during business hours, with plans to expand support coverage as the business scales. Occasional weekend work may be required to support release testing and deployment activities.

DMI (Digital Markets Infrastructure) is an ambitious project: large-scale, complex and uses a range of blockchain architecture patterns, with numerous stakeholders (internal and external) and use cases. The work is focussed on the tokenization of financial instruments, i.e. as digital assets. We seek candidates with a curiosity about financial markets with experience working on large projects. This is a chance to work on an ambitious project backed by the influential reach of the London Stock Exchange Group.

This opportunity sits within a true “build it, you run it” team, working on a cloud‑native product. The role offers hands-on ownership across the full lifecycle, from building and evolving the platform through to running and supporting it in production.

You’ll work closely with our development colleagues in the UK and Bucharest through agile sprints, contributing to design decisions, automation, reliability, and the continuous improvement of a critical trading service. Ensuring the availability of this service will be a key responsibility.

What you'll be doing:

  • Implement, handle, and optimise Cloud deployments and automations of DMI applications.
  • Develop and run container orchestration solutions using Kubernetes and similar technologies.
  • Implement, maintain, and optimise containerization for DMI services (e.g. via Docker).
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and scaling (e.g. Terraform).
  • Integrate security protocols into the DevOps lifecycle, ensuring adaptability against vulnerabilities.
  • Partner with software engineers, QA, and other teams to ensure efficient deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of applications.
  • Keep up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and guidelines in DevOps and cloud infrastructure.

What you'll bring:

  • Computer science, software engineering, or relevant technical background required.
  • 5 + years of professional experience in DevOps and infrastructure management.
  • 5+ years of specific experience with Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Proficient in Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.
  • Experience with the Azure cloud platform, handling workloads, provisioning & deployments.
  • Deep knowledge of security standards in cloud and DevOps contexts.
  • Proven knowledge of scaling, availability and cloud resiliency models, patterns and designs.
  • Ability to anticipate potential infrastructure challenges and provide innovative solutions.
  • Curiosity about new technologies and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Familiarity with blockchain/DLT desirable.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas and are committed to sustainability across our global business. You will experience the critical role we have in helping to re-engineer the financial ecosystem to support and drive sustainable economic growth. Together, we are aiming to achieve this growth by accelerating the just transition to net zero, enabling growth of the green economy and creating inclusive economic opportunity.

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

descriptionHtml:
“In 36 months, agentic AI systems will be an operating reality across major institutions. We intend to be central to it.” — Dr. Jim Rebesco, Cofounder and CEO, Striveworks


The government’s demand for AI is growing far faster than the systems required to support it. Fewer than 15% of federal AI programs have reached sustained production, despite billions of dollars invested. The models perform in testing, but they degrade in the real world. And when performance drops, trust goes with it.

Striveworks was built to solve that problem.


What you’ll build

Since 2018, we have delivered the most trusted AI systems operating in real-world use cases—providing a layer of assurance underneath hundreds of deployed models that monitors performance, manages drift, and sustains systems long after they leave the lab.


As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you are where the platform meets the mission. Our systems stay online and reliable in the field because of what you build, automate, and maintain. You will interface directly with customers and work across teams. You’ll define what needs to be built, deploy it, and keep it running across commercial, unclassified, CUI, and classified DOD networks. You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy the challenge of debugging complex Kubernetes clusters where connectivity is a luxury, not a given. You are someone who can navigate the unique constraints of local hardware today and write the automation that ensures seamless, reliable performance across the customer’s hybrid stack tomorrow.


What it’s like here

We lead with trust, treat each other with respect, and use candor consistently, kindly, and constructively. We care deeply about our work, and we find genuine satisfaction in doing it well. Above all, we take ownership—because we feel the weight of collective results personally. We are looking for people who share these values and are eager to put them into practice.


What we’re looking for

6+ years of direct, hands-on experience in:

  • Microservices deployment in Kubernetes
  • Diagnosing and resolving issues within containerized environments
  • Helm Chart and Kustomizations development/deployment
  • Python and/or Golang programming, or other general purpose programming languages
  • Automation and IaC, e.g., Terraform
  • Cloud infrastructure: AWS and Azure
  • Managing and troubleshooting Linux systems, e.g., networking and bash scripting
  • Active Secret (or above) US security clearance and US citizenship


The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:

  • Familiarity with DOD networking, tools, infrastructure, security requirements, and policies
  • Proficiency with US federal information system security policies, including STIGs, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-53, CMMC, and ICD 503
  • Experience with software deployments to on-premises and cloud-based unclassified, CUI, and classified networks within the DOD
  • Experience with DevSecOps/DevOps and CI/CD for the administration and deployment of GPU-enabled servers
  • Experience deploying or maintaining CNCF projects
  • Experience with NAS and SAN technologies
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native applications and services in DDIL impact environments


You will be remote or hybrid/on site at our customer sites at Joint Base Lewis-McChord In Tacoma, WA. If remote, you must be located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone. You will be expected to travel up to 25% of the time.


Compensation

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $185,000–$230,000/year. Striveworks’ total compensation package includes a competitive base salary, equity grants, and cash bonuses.


Benefits include:

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance
  • Voluntary life, long-term disability, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • HSA and FSA (including dependent care FSA) plans
  • 401(k) plan
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid parental leave


Ready to build systems that work for a mission that matters? Let’s talk.

Striveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, belief, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity or expression), national origin, social or ethnic origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factors. Striveworks will not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.


If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation in the application process, please contact People Operations at hr@striveworks.us.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete an employment eligibility verification form upon hire.


Striveworks is a participating employer in the E-Verify program.

Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for developing innovation solutions? Join our team! As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be a strategic leader responsible for overseeing and optimizing the organization’s DevOps processes. You will ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of our Continuous Integration/Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipelines and cloud infrastructure while mentoring the DevOps team and driving the adoption of industry best practices.

The Mission Solutions and Technologies (MST) business area provides affordable, turn-key command/control, communications, integrated ISR, force protection and security solutions worldwide. The MST team has a long legacy of supporting the Department of Defense, Department of Homeland Security, commercial and international customers with years of experience in platform operations, engineering and full lifecycle management across domains – air, land, sea, space and cyber.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines that support multiple deployment approaches across cloud, on‑premises, and hybrid environments.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to ensure consistent, reliable environments throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Optimize and standardize deployment workflows, enabling repeatable release processes that accommodate variations in product and customer requirements.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance and reliability, applying advanced diagnostic skills across distributed systems and complex integrations.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, and product teams to align deployment strategies with architectural goals, security requirements, and operational best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating new technologies, refining operational tooling, and establishing best‑practice documentation for deployment and release operations.
  • Works as part of a larger Agile software development team to rapidly provide operational capabilities to the field

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps or related role.
  • Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
  • Relevant experience can be considered as a substitute for the required educational qualifications. In the absence of a degree, a minimum of 12 years of related experience is required.
  • Software development experience , with at least one object oriented language such as but not limited to Java, Python, C#, C++ or Go
  • Demonstrated implementation of microservices, container, and cloud-native application development
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and/or Openshift and related container platform ecosystems
  • Experience working with multiple cloud vendors
  • Experience with managed Kubernetes services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
  • Demonstrated experience with developer tools such as GitHub and on-prem Azure DevOps
  • Significant experience with Linux
  • Strong understanding and experience of release engineering, CI and CD pipelines
  • Strong Agile experience working in Scrum and/or Kanban models
  • Proven track record of delivering high quality and consistent systems and environments for development teams
  • Ability to rapidly work with minimal supervision on projects involving both small and large teams
  • Ability to work in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Master’s degree in a related field.
  • Experience in the Aerospace and Defense industry.
  • AWS Solutions Architect – Associate or Higher certification
  • Azure Developer/Solutions Architect
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes
  • Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • Advanced proficiency with Ansible, including developing and maintaining playbooks
  • Experience coordinating release readiness activities
  • Experience implementing and enforcing configuration control of development environments

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods.
  • Frequent communication with team members and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment.
  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Must be able to lift up to 10 lbs occasionally.
  • Design and manage complex infrastructure solutions, leveraging cloud services, containerization, and orchestration tools to support scalable and secure environments.
  • Mentor junior DevOps engineers, conduct code and process reviews, and promote best practices in DevOps methodologies to maintain high standards of performance and security.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, security, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of applications and services, fostering a culture of collaboration and shared responsibility.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

SNC offers annual incentive pay based upon performance that is commensurate with the level of the position.

SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more.

Important Notice

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Learn more about the background check process for Security Clearances.

We provide leading edge technologies and transformative solutions that support our nation’s most critical security needs. If you are mission-focused, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make our country stronger with state-of-the-art technologies that safeguard freedom, join our team!

descriptionHtml:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of the Blue Origin Engines business unit, where our focus is the design, development, manufacturing, and testing of engines and propulsion systems. Built for multiple uses, our family of engines is powering the next generation of rockets for commercial, civil, national security, and human spaceflight.

As part of a small team, you will own and evolve the software infrastructure behind avionics software development for Blue Origin rocket engines. Our teams deliver the embedded software that monitors and controls fully autonomous rocket engines, and everything they build flows through the pipelines, containers, and development machines you maintain. This is a hands-on position: you will be the person other engineers come to when a build breaks, a pipeline needs to run somewhere new, or a development environment needs to be reproducible.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, initiative, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines and the GitLab Runner fleet supporting engine software development, from unit test through delivery to development hardware and simulated environments.
  • Own the container build and distribution path - Dockerfiles, base images, registries, and artifact repositories - including migration of the existing Kaniko-based image builds to the go-forward toolchain.
  • Provision and manage developer workstations, virtual machines, build servers, and containers as code using Ansible, driving toward reproducible, self-documenting infrastructure.
  • Develop automation and tooling in Python and Shell to eliminate manual steps, reduce error rates, and improve build and test throughput.
  • Act as the team's first line of support for Docker and CI issues across our software teams - triage failures, perform root cause analysis, and review other engineers' pipeline and container changes.
  • Partner with external IT, Site Reliability Engineering, and infrastructure organizations to secure resources, resolve cross-boundary issues, and represent the team's needs.
  • Identify weak points in our infrastructure management and propose and implement improvements rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Maintain the tooling that supports our safety-critical software development process, including static analysis infrastructure and the licensing, entitlement, and availability of those tools.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. degree or higher in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field. Other engineering or science degrees will be considered with relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, infrastructure, or a similar software engineering role.
  • Linux administration on RHEL and/or CentOS — comfortable managing services, filesystems, users, and permissions.
  • Docker: building and maintaining images and Dockerfiles, working with registries, volumes, and Docker Compose.
  • Virtual machines and hypervisors — provisioning, configuring, and troubleshooting virtualized build and development environments.
  • Ansible for provisioning and configuration management of physical and virtual machines.
  • GitLab CI/CD and GitLab Runners — designing, organizing, and maintaining pipelines, including build/test/deploy flows, secrets handling, and release automation.
  • Artifact repository management (Artifactory or similar).
  • Automation and scripting in Python and Shell.
  • Git fundamentals — branching strategies, code review workflows, versioning.
  • Core networking: SSH, TCP/UDP, routing basics, ports, and firewalling.
  • Ability to learn fast, multitask, and drive tasks to completion.
  • Ability to present technical concepts to peers and leadership, earn trust, and maintain positive and professional working relationships.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Rust — our infrastructure tooling spans several languages, and Rust is the one we are investing in most.
  • Working knowledge of C and C++.
  • Familiarity with Kaniko. We are phasing it out, so experience with it is directly useful during the transition.
  • Experience managing a fleet of developer machines, virtual machines, and containers as code at scale.
  • Monitoring and observability tooling for infrastructure and pipeline health.
  • Experience administering static analysis tooling for embedded or safety-critical code and integrating it into CI, including managing tool licenses and entitlements.
  • Exposure to tool qualification practices for safety-critical software development (DO-330 or equivalent).
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants.
  • Track record of collaborating effectively with external IT, System Responsible Engineer, or platform teams.

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We're developing Project Sunrise, a constellation of orbital data centers designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged at an unprecedented scale.

To meet the compressed timeline of this ambitious program, we need to move with exceptional velocity. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be the engine that drives this pace. You will be responsible for building and managing the critical Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure that serves all three of our core software teams: Flight Software, Ground & Operations Software, and the On-Orbit Compute Platform. Your mission is to create a unified, automated, and frictionless path from a developer's keyboard to our test labs and operational environments, enabling rapid, reliable delivery across the entire program.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable CI/CD pipelines for a diverse set of software domains, including embedded flight software and cloud-native ground systems.
  • Own the infrastructure that supports automated testing, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Manage the program's source code repositories, artifact registries, and build environments.
  • Champion infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automation to ensure our development and test infrastructure is repeatable, scalable, and robust.
  • Collaborate with engineers across all software teams to understand their workflows and build the tools and integrations they need to be productive.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of the CI/CD system to ensure fast feedback loops for developers.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on DevOps best practices, guiding teams on how to effectively integrate with the development platform.

descriptionHtml:
Enlighten, honored as a Top Workplace from USA Today, is a leader in big data solution development and deployment, with expertise in cloud-based services, software and systems engineering, cyber capabilities, and data science. Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.

We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done—while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
  • 10% 401k benefit.
  • Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
  • Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $115,199.00 - $150,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, AWS and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 1-2 days a week) with a great team.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support the development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Assist in automating deployment processes and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to ensure the reliability and rapid scaling of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to seamlessly integrate their applications into the operational infrastructure.
  • Monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, and help resolve them to maintain high availability.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to optimize system performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, constantly exploring innovative ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Top Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of one or more of the following:
    • Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
    • AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
    • Configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
    • Application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Comfortable operating in a terminal-based environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Must have a DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e. Security+) or willing to obtain within 60 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 1-2 days per week at our Columbia, MD office. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.
Preferred Requirements

  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, Helm, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Experience or familiarity with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.
  • Experience or familiarity with K9s, AWS CLI is a plus.
  • Work could possibly require some on-call work.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

descriptionHtml:
At Rite-Hite, your work makes an impact. As the global leader in loading dock and door equipment, we design and deliver solutions that keep our customers safe, secure, and productive. Here, you’ll find innovation, stability, and the chance to grow your career as part of a team that’s always looking ahead.

Core Responsibilities

Platform Engineering and Automation

  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines that support automated build, test, and deployment workflows using GitLab CI/CD and standardized Git workflows.
  • Support reusable pipeline templates, infrastructure modules, and automation patterns that enable consistent software delivery across teams.
  • Assist in improving deployment speed, reliability, and quality through automation and tooling enhancements.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures and work with engineering teams to resolve build, deployment, and environment issues.

Cloud Infrastructure and Kubernetes Operations

  • Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, with a primary focus on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Support the deployment, operation, and maintenance of Kubernetes environments, particularly Google Kubernetes Engine.
  • Package, configure, and deploy Kubernetes applications using Helm charts and established deployment standards.
  • Assist software engineering teams with cloud-native application deployment needs, runtime configuration, and environment troubleshooting.
  • Help maintain reliable, scalable, and secure development, test, staging, and production environments.

Reliability, Monitoring, and Incident Response

  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to support system performance, availability, and operational visibility.
  • Support tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and related observability platforms.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, incident response, and root cause analysis for production and non-production systems.
  • Assist in improving system reliability by identifying recurring issues and contributing to remediation efforts.
  • Support operational procedures that improve uptime, resilience, and service quality.

Security and Compliance Enablement

  • Apply secure-by-design practices across CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, and Kubernetes environments.
  • Support secrets management, access controls, least-privilege IAM, and secure configuration practices.
  • Help integrate vulnerability scanning, configuration validation, and compliance checks into software delivery workflows.
  • Maintain clear documentation and repeatable processes to support auditability, compliance, and operational consistency.
  • Collaborate with security, IT, and platform stakeholders to remediate infrastructure and deployment-related security findings.

Collaboration and Documentation

  • Work closely with software engineers, QA, and platform stakeholders to understand delivery needs and reduce friction in the development lifecycle.
  • Document infrastructure configurations, deployment procedures, runbooks, troubleshooting steps, and operational standards.
  • Contribute to DevOps best practices, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies, planning discussions, and technical reviews as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This role does not have direct reports.
  • This role is expected to contribute as an individual contributor and collaborate closely with engineering, QA, IT, and security teams.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field required; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or related roles.
  • Experience supporting production or production-like cloud environments.
  • Experience working with modern software delivery pipelines and automation tools.

Knowledge / Skill Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes; experience with Google Kubernetes Engine is preferred.
  • Experience with Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience using Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Experience with GitLab, Git-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider.
  • Experience packaging or deploying applications using Helm is preferred.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, Bash, or similar.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and load balancing.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with software engineering, QA, IT, security, and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Familiarity with distributed tracing tools such as Google Cloud Trace.
  • Experience supporting security, compliance, or regulated environments.
  • Prior experience working in agile or product-driven development environments.
  • Familiarity with containerization, Docker, Kubernetes manifests, and Helm charts.
  • Relevant cloud, DevOps, or Kubernetes certifications are a plus.

WHY JOIN RITE-HITE DIGITAL SOLUTIONS?

At Rite-Hite, you’ll be part of a technology-driven organization that is transforming how industrial safety, productivity, and service solutions are delivered worldwide. As a DevOps Engineer, you will directly influence the reliability, security, and scalability of platforms that support thousands of customers and critical industrial operations.

You’ll work alongside talented engineers, product leaders, and platform teams to build modern, cloud-native systems with real-world impact—bridging digital innovation with physical environments where safety and uptime matter most.

What We Offer

At Rite-Hite, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work:

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life and disability insurance. A robust well-being program with an opportunity to receive an extra day off and more.
  • Financial Security: A strong retirement savings program with 401(k), company match, and profit sharing.
  • Time for You: Paid holidays, vacation time, and personal/sick days each year.

Join us and build a career where you’re supported – at work and beyond.

Rite-Hite is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. In accordance with VEVRAA, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for protected veterans. We are also committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace for the safety of our employees and customers.

- Experience supporting security, compliance, or regulated environments.

descriptionHtml:
About Sphinx

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better.

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

About The Role

Sphinx is hiring an Associate DevOps Engineer to join our team building a cutting edge communications platform for US government satellites. We're looking for a Junior DevOps Engineer to help take our build and deployment automation to the next level. As a Junior DevOps Engineer you will help build the development and deployment infrastructure used by our Space Communications team, which provides infrastructure for a wide variety of US Government satellites.

What You'll Be Focusing On

  • Supporting AWS-hosted and on-premises Kubernetes environments.
  • Helping maintain reliable, secure, and highly available platform infrastructure.
  • Maintaining and improving GitLab CI/CD pipelines to support software delivery.
  • Developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Assisting with Kubernetes application deployments using Helm.
  • Troubleshooting infrastructure, platform, and application issues across AWS and Kubernetes environments.
  • Partnering with software engineers to improve deployment automation and developer workflows.
  • Continuously improving platform observability, automation, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Supporting software deployments into classified environments.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience working in Linux environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Python or Go through professional work, internships, coursework, or personal projects.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, or other cloud-native technologies.
  • Experience using Git for source control.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and adapt quickly.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government TS/SCI clearance

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF

  • You enjoy building and automating technical solutions.
  • You like digging into complex technical problems and figuring out how things work.
  • You’ve built projects outside of the classroom or workplace because you’re curious and enjoy learning.
  • You’re comfortable collaborating with teammates and asking questions when you need help.
  • You take ownership of your work and are eager to continuously improve your technical skills.
  • You’re excited to work on mission-critical software that supports national security

LOCATION

This role is a hybrid role based in Colorado Springs, CO that offers flexibility while supporting collaboration on classified work. This role will require onsite work as needed to support secure program requirements.

Compensation

This role is between $75,000 and $112,000 base salary.

Benefits

Compensation includes competitive salary, meaningful equity ownership, profit sharing, employer 401(k) contribution, and 100% employer covered medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents.

ELIGIBILITY

Must be a US Citizen.

Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. TS/SCI security clearance.

EEO STATEMENT

At Sphinx Defense, we are devoted to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Sphinx Defense is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position requires eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.

descriptionHtml:
“In 36 months, agentic AI systems will be an operating reality across major institutions. We intend to be central to it.” — Dr. Jim Rebesco, Cofounder and CEO, Striveworks


The government’s demand for AI is growing far faster than the systems required to support it. Fewer than 15% of federal AI programs have reached sustained production, despite billions of dollars invested. The models perform in testing, but they degrade in the real world. And when performance drops, trust goes with it.


Striveworks was built to solve that problem.


What you’ll build

Since 2018, we have delivered the most trusted AI systems operating in real-world use cases—providing a layer of assurance underneath hundreds of deployed models that monitors performance, manages drift, and sustains systems long after they leave the lab.


As a Senior DevOps Engineer based at Schofield Barracks, you will own what you deploy. That means maintaining, optimizing, and enhancing the environments that national security customers depend on. You’ll deploy custom K8s clusters, manage IaC automation, and serve as the operational link between platform developers and customer-facing teams. In this role, you will bring junior DevOps teammates along as you go, and you will have the latitude to explore better solutions when you find them.


What it’s like here

We lead with trust, treat each other with respect, and use candor consistently, kindly, and constructively. We care deeply about our work, and we find genuine satisfaction in doing it well. Above all, we take ownership—because we feel the weight of collective results personally. We are looking for people who share these values and are eager to put them into practice.


What we’re looking for

6+ years of direct, hands-on experience in:

  • Microservices deployment in Kubernetes
  • Diagnosing and resolving issues within containerized environments
  • Helm Chart and Kustomizations development/deployment
  • Python and/or Golang programming, or other general purpose programming languages
  • Automation and IaC, e.g., Terraform
  • Cloud infrastructure: AWS and Azure
  • Managing and troubleshooting Linux systems, e.g., networking and bash scripting
  • Active Secret (or above) US security clearance and US citizenship


The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:

  • Experience with DOD networking, tools, infrastructure, security requirements, and policies
  • Proficiency with US federal information system security policies including STIGs, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-53, CMMC, and ICD 503
  • Experience with software deployments to unclassified, CUI, and classified DOD networks
  • Experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD for GPU-enabled server administration and deployment
  • Experience deploying or maintaining CNCF projects
  • Experience with NAS and SAN technologies
  • Experience with K8s and cloud-native applications in DDIL environments


This role is hybrid/on site at customer sites at Schofield Barracks in Oߵahu, Hawaiߵi. You will be expected to travel up to 30% of the time, including some international travel.


Compensation

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $220,000–$270,000/year. Striveworks’ total compensation package includes a competitive base salary, equity grants, and cash bonuses.


Benefits include:

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance
  • Voluntary life, long-term disability, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • HSA and FSA (including dependent care FSA) plans
  • 401(k) plan
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid parental leave


Ready to build systems that work for a mission that matters? Let’s talk.


Striveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, belief, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity or expression), national origin, social or ethnic origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factors. Striveworks will not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.


If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation in the application process, please contact People Operations at hr@striveworks.us.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete an employment eligibility verification form upon hire.


Striveworks is a participating employer in the E-Verify program.

Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, Payments Technology team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Execute software design, development, and technical troubleshooting, using creative approaches to solve complex problems.
  • Write secure, high-quality production code and maintain algorithms that integrate reliably with existing systems.
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Create architecture and design artifacts for complex applications, ensuring software development meets design constraints.
  • Analyze large, diverse datasets and develop visualizations and reports to identify patterns and drive continuous improvement.
  • Improve coding practices and system architecture by proactively identifying hidden problems and emerging trends.
  • Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines, and administer GitHub Enterprise, GitHub, and Bitbucket for repository management and integrations.
  • Automate repetitive tasks with Python or other scripting languages; monitor platform performance, availability, and security, and troubleshoot proactively.
  • Support software releases, environments, and production operations, contribute to engineering communities and events, and foster a diverse, inclusive, and respectful team culture.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or a related role.
  • Practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and maintaining operational stability.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or another programming or scripting language, with experience developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment.
  • Experience with modern programming and database query languages, and an overall understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, CI/CD, application resiliency, security, and pipeline implementation.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes in areas such as cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or mobile.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Spinnaker, Bitbucket, Terraform for resource provisioning, GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude, and monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, and Dynatrace.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
  • Exposure to cloud technologies
  • Experience using Groovy to script declarative Jenkins pipelines
  • Familiarity with security best practices in cloud-native DevOps environments
  • One or more domain-specific certifications (e.g., AWS Solution Architect, Terraform Associate, Certified Jenkins Engineer, etc.)

Additional Requirements

A Government Security Clearance, including Public Trust clearance, will be required for this position as a condition of employment. The selected candidate must successfully complete a comprehensive background screening to obtain the necessary clearance. This process includes, but is not limited to:

  • Fingerprints
  • Credit check
  • Proof of U.S. Citizenship, Acceptable documents may include a U.S. passport, certificate of naturalization, or original/certified birth certificate.
  • Verification of employment history
  • Educational background
  • Criminal record check
  • Tax filing history (possibly)
  • References
  • Information on relatives including citizenship
  • 7 Year Travel History
  • 7 Year Residence History
  • Government interview completion and favorable background investigation.
  • Other relevant verifications as mandated by federal requirements

Employment is contingent upon the candidate's ability to attain and keep all applicable clearance requirements. Failure to maintain required clearance(s) following being hired may result in termination of employment.

Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Summary

The DevOps Engineer I supports the reliability, security, and delivery of cloud infrastructure and the systems that run Spring Venture Group's platforms. This is an entry-level DevOps position with defined scope, structured oversight, and a clear path to broader ownership.

The team applies a measured, controlled approach to change. Work is peer-reviewed, automated where it improves safety, and deployed in a manner that can be audited and rolled back.

About Spring Venture Group

Spring Venture Group is a leader in Medicare health insurance distribution. The company helps consumers select health coverage that fits their needs and supports them in making informed decisions about their health and financial well-being.

Customer trust depends on technology that performs consistently. The DevOps team designs, improves, and supports the cloud platforms and delivery systems on which internal and customer-facing applications are built.





Job Description

Position Overview

The DevOps Engineer I designs, modernizes, and supports core cloud infrastructure and the pipelines used to deliver it. The position works with proprietary platforms and current third-party tools, including AI-assisted coding tools for research, drafting, and routine technical tasks.

Primary focus areas are system reliability, delivery pipeline quality, and a secure operating baseline. The engineer collaborates with developers and senior DevOps engineers, operates under guidance, and assumes expanded responsibility as technical experience develops.

Assignments are of limited to moderate complexity and are performed under oversight. Typical work includes improving a pipeline, implementing a backup or monitoring control, remediating a security finding, and supporting developer deployments.

*Work authorization: Spring Venture Group is unable to sponsor this position now or in the future. Candidates must be a U.S. citizen or a lawful permanent resident (green card holder).*

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver infrastructure initiatives and engineering requests to required quality standards, applying sound technical judgment and approved AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve automated build, packaging, and deployment processes.
  • Implement automated infrastructure capabilities, including backups, security scanning, and system monitoring.
  • Apply DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering practices to improve process quality across the change lifecycle, from code commit through production release.
  • Collaborate with the DevOps Manager, DevOps Team Leads, senior engineers, and software development teams. Seek guidance as needed and document technical decisions and procedures.
  • Implement security and vulnerability remediations identified by the DevOps team, and escalate newly identified risks promptly.
  • Use AI coding assistants for research, drafting, and routine tasks. All AI-generated output is reviewed, tested, and deployed through the standard reviewed pipeline.
  • Manage and implement company tools, solutions, and platforms, including:
    • CI/CD: GitHub, GitHub Actions, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodePipeline, and related deployment tooling
    • Infrastructure as Code: AWS CDK and AWS CloudFormation
    • Observability: Datadog, Amazon CloudWatch, and OpenTelemetry
    • Automation: Python, Bash, Node.js, and similar scripting languages
    • AI assistants: Approved AI coding and analysis tools used for software development, data gathering, and analysis
  • Support developer teams in local and cloud environments, including containerized (Docker, Amazon EKS) and serverless workloads as applicable.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to triage, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues of varying scope and complexity.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Representative Work

  • Improve a CI/CD pipeline to increase deployment reliability for a development team.
  • Convert a recurring manual check into a documented, reviewed automation.
  • Reduce alert noise by refining Datadog or CloudWatch monitors.
  • Close a security finding through an infrastructure change that is version-controlled and reproducible.
  • Support senior engineers on CDK or CloudFormation updates to shared modules.
  • Document incident findings and contribute to corrective actions.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to draft scripts or summarize documentation, with results validated before use in any non-development environment.

Operating Principles

  • Controlled change. Releases are kept small and reviewable. Rollback procedures are defined before deployment.
  • Security by default. Least-privilege access, reviewed infrastructure code, timely remediation of findings, and no secrets in source code or chat logs.
  • Automation with defined value. Manual processes are documented first, then automated where the return is clear.
  • Accountability for changes. AI-assisted tools accelerate drafting and research. The engineer is accountable for all changes that are merged and deployed.
  • Human review of decisions. AI tools are used extensively for data gathering and analysis. Decision points remain under human review.
  • Structured development. Mentorship, code review, and oversight are part of the role, supporting progression to more complex work.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; or
  • One (1) year of hands-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Systems Administration roles.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Proficiency with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC) tooling, and application and infrastructure hosting.
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or a comparable language.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a methodical approach to root-cause analysis.
  • Proficiency with AI assistants for software development and engineering tasks.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including status reporting and risk escalation.
  • Collaborative working style and receptiveness to technical feedback.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/Amazon EKS) or serverless architectures on AWS.
  • Familiarity with Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable observability platforms.
  • Experience with vulnerability remediation or compliance-driven operations.
  • Experience with configuration or build tools such as Ansible or Jenkins. Useful background; current delivery is based on GitHub Actions, AWS services, and infrastructure as code.

Behavioral Expectations

Spring Venture Group behaviors applicable to this role:

  • Be Aware: Emotional intelligence
  • Be Open & Honest: Communication
  • Be a Team Player: Teamwork and collaboration
  • Be Accomplished: Drive for results
  • Be the Example: Develop self and empower people
  • Be Forward Thinking: Strategic thinking
  • Be a Problem Solver: Continuous improvement





Additional Information

  • Competitive compensation Medical, Dental and Vision benefits after a short waiting period
  • 401k matching program
  • Generous paid time off program with an additional company break during the holidays
  • Annual Volunteer Time Off (VTO) and a donation matching program
  • Life Insurance Employee Assistance Program (health & well-being on and off the job) Rewards and Recognition
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Training program and ongoing support throughout your entire Spring Venture Group career
  • Diverse, inclusive & welcoming culture
  • Optional enrollment options include HSA/FSA, AD&D, Spousal/Dependent life insurance, Short Term/Long Term Disability, Travel Assist, and Legal plans

Spring Venture Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Knightscope (NASDAQ: KSCP) is a security technology company building the nation's first Autonomous Security Force — autonomous machines, AI-driven software, and elite security professionals operating as one integrated managed service. The Company is on a mission to make the United States of America the safest country in the world. One Team. One Force.

Job Summary

Knightscope is standing up a centralized Engineering Services function to support the full product portfolio: Signals, K7/Nav, H1, K5, K3, K1-family, KSOC, KEMS, and OpenExO. This role owns the shared DevOps and platform foundation every one of those programs depends on. You will consolidate today's fragmented pipelines into one durable platform, engineered to make every program faster, safer, and more consistent.

About The Role

Knightscope is standing up a centralized Engineering Services function to support the full product portfolio: Signals, K7/Nav, H1, K5, K3, K1-family, KSOC, KEMS, and OpenExO. This role owns the shared DevOps and platform foundation every one of those programs depends on. You will consolidate today's fragmented pipelines into one durable platform, engineered to make every program faster, safer, and more consistent.

  • Design, build, and operate the shared CI/CD pipeline serving Signals, K7/Nav, and Legacy.
  • Own the cloud infrastructure that runs Knightscope's SaaS platforms and internal tooling.
  • Standardize containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code across programs.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance on platform hardening.
  • Partner with Fleet and Release Automation on OTA delivery connected to cloud pipelines.

Nice to Have

Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

About The Role

Machina Labs is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing software engineering team and help build the infrastructure that powers our advanced robotics manufacturing platform.

In this role, you will design, scale, and own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment systems that support our robotics software platform. You will play a key role in defining how we deploy, secure, monitor, and manage systems across multiple environments, enabling reliable and scalable operations for our robotics and manufacturing systems.

This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer to lead infrastructure strategy, streamline development workflows, and partner closely with software engineers to deliver highly reliable systems. You will be hands-on from day one and help shape the DevOps function as the company grows.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues and help define operational best practices.

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. Work you'll do

As a Delivery Management Engineer II on the Deloitte AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for...

  • Deploy, configure, integrate, and maintain mission-critical toolchains.
  • Collaborate with enterprise software engineering and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) teams on multidisciplinary engineering efforts.
  • Deliver robust, cloud-hosted engineering applications that meet project requirements.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and application delivery through infrastructure as code and continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the reliability, security, and performance of engineering platforms.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years of experience in a cloud environment
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC), including Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline development using Jenkins, GitLab, or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with application programming interface (API) integrations
  • Active Secret security clearance required
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Experience with Python or Java
  • Experience working on a Digital Engineering team

descriptionHtml:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Baxter is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to support enterprise cloud platforms that securely connect medical devices and clinical applications with Baxter and third-party systems. This role will design, automate, deploy, and support cloud infrastructure across multiple environments. The successful candidate will bring strong technical skills, personal ownership, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a regulated healthcare environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • Build and support Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) infrastructure, including clusters, node pools, namespaces, workloads, resource configurations, ingress, networking, and scaling.
  • Develop and maintain Helm charts, Kubernetes manifests, and environment-specific configurations.
  • Develop and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and related automation tools.
  • Support Azure services including PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Cosmos DB, Azure Managed Redis, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, App Configuration, and Azure Container Registry.
  • Support platform components and services such as Traefik, RabbitMQ, VerneMQ, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Plan and implement infrastructure changes associated with platform releases and application integrations.
  • Evaluate infrastructure dependencies, service versions, support timelines, and upgrade requirements as part of infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, networking, performance, and application-integration issues across non-production and production environments.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational dashboards using Azure-native and platform observability tools.
  • Apply security best practices involving managed identities, secrets management, role-based access, network controls, vulnerability management, and least privilege access.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation plans, impact assessments, deployment specifications, and Jira work items.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operational teams to coordinate changes, validate deployments, resolve incidents, and improve platform reliability.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve automation, standardization, resilience, scalability, and delivery efficiency.
  • Take ownership of assigned work from planning through implementation, validation, documentation, and closure.

Qualifications And Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service.
  • Strong experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and practices.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, YAML, containerization, and microservices-based platforms.
  • Experience developing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Azure networking, including virtual networks, subnets, routing, load balancers, private endpoints, DNS, and network security controls.
  • Experience supporting production-grade cloud infrastructure and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar languages.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan work, communicate risks, follow through on commitments, and collaborate across teams.

Join Baxter International's technology team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge medical products that enhance patient care worldwide. As a DevOps Engineer, your role will be pivotal in driving continuous improvement, innovation, and reliability in our software delivery processes. If you are passionate about leveraging the latest DevOps tools and technologies, we welcome you to apply and be part of our mission to save and sustain lives.

Baxter is committed to supporting the needs for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a required minimum number of days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in-person in support of our Mission. The flexible workplace policy is subject to local laws and legal requirements. At its discretion, Baxter may decide to adjust, suspend, or discontinue as business needs change.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $120,000-$165,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

US Benefits At Baxter (except For Puerto Rico)

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Baxter US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits | Baxter
