descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

About The Role

As a DevOps Engineer at EliseAI, you will own the systems and processes that support reliable software deployment across multiple environments. You’ll be responsible for managing configuration, maintaining deployment workflows, and ensuring operational consistency as our infrastructure scales. This role requires close collaboration across engineering, product, and platform teams to support end-to-end delivery—from development through production. You’ll help build the foundation for how we deploy, monitor, and scale our systems as the company continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve infrastructure using AWS and modern DevOps practices
  • Design and implement monitoring, alerting, and incident response systems to ensure high availability
  • Automate deployment pipelines and manage CI/CD workflows
  • Collaborate with engineers to identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability issues
  • Improve system security and auditability across environments
  • Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to enhance operations

Requirements

  • 3+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience, preferably at a high-growth startup
  • Strong AWS experience, including services like EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, and IAM
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (preferably Python) and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform)
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and ability to debug and optimize complex systems
  • Experience with CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions or similar
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and take ownership of large initiatives from day one
  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company
  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
  • Fully paid parental leave
  • Commuter benefits
  • 401k benefits
  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $230,000 - $320,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

Job Number: R0253780

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to leverage your Cloud DevOps expertise in a high impact role? Booz Allen has an opportunity to showcase your talents by supporting the United States Air Force. We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the team – You’ll work in a Cloud or Software Engineering role, working with teams to leverage and expand your client’s capabilities.

You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be able to translate customer needs, and assist others in migration and solutioning of mission critical capabilities. You’ll be responsible for working with current and new software development teams - understanding their architecture and development environment tooling to develop onboarding paths to your client’s platform.

Organizations are rapidly evolving their cloud environments and ensuring those environments run securely, reliably, and efficiently is critical. As a DevOps Engineer, you will operate and optimize cloud platforms, automate infrastructure, and support mission focused teams as they deploy, scale, and maintain cloud-native solutions. You’ll strengthen your technical skills while helping clients achieve operational excellence across their cloud ecosystems.

You’ll work in a dynamic, large team environment supporting a large–scale government program, using next–gen tools, standards, and processes, including Kubernetes, Terraform, Terragrunt, and Python. You’ll design and develop automation pipelines to drive rapid delivery of functionality using CI/CD tools such as GitLab. You’ll utilize state of the art diagnostic tools and monitoring systems to provide analysis on Web application errors, including the identification and investigation of application behavior through code and log analysis and business logic.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 1+ years of experience with operating cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Experience with container technologies, including Docker or Kubernetes
  • Experience with scripting for automation, including Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub or GitLab
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure or Configuration as code, including Ansible, Terraform, or CloudFormation
  • Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems and cloud-native applications
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Ability to obtain an AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified CloudOps, or Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert Certification within 60 days of hire date
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT Level II or IAT Level III Certification within 30 days of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Linux or Windows Server
  • Experience with network fundamentals
  • Experience with automation tools such as GitLab and GitHub
  • Knowledge of Generative AI best practices, prompt engineering, agentic, and agentic workflows
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering


Clearance: 

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,500.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

About The Role

As a DevOps Engineer at EliseAI, you will own the systems and processes that support reliable software deployment across multiple environments. You’ll be responsible for managing configuration, maintaining deployment workflows, and ensuring operational consistency as our infrastructure scales. This role requires close collaboration across engineering, product, and platform teams to support end-to-end delivery—from development through production. You’ll help build the foundation for how we deploy, monitor, and scale our systems as the company continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve infrastructure using AWS and modern DevOps practices
  • Design and implement monitoring, alerting, and incident response systems to ensure high availability
  • Automate deployment pipelines and manage CI/CD workflows
  • Collaborate with engineers to identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability issues
  • Improve system security and auditability across environments
  • Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to enhance operations

Requirements

  • 3+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience, preferably at a high-growth startup
  • Strong AWS experience, including services like EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, and IAM
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (preferably Python) and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform)
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and ability to debug and optimize complex systems
  • Experience with CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions or similar
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and take ownership of large initiatives from day one
  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company
  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
  • Fully paid parental leave
  • Commuter benefits
  • 401k benefits
  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $230,000 - $320,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0246681

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps engineer, you’re eager to build, automate, manage, and secure cloud environments that help development teams deliver modern web applications quickly and reliably. We need you to help us strengthen DevOps capabilities supporting our web application teams and solve some of our clients’ toughest technical challenges.

As a DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll use your technical skills to drive mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll work alongside software engineers developing applications using technologies such as React, Node.js, and Python, while helping design and improve cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, networking, and deployment processes that support those applications. You’ll work with technologies such as GitHub and GitHub Actions to automate builds, testing, and deployments across environments. You’ll support containerized Linux workloads using Docker and Azure Container Registry, and help deploy applications using Azure services such as Azure Container Apps, Azure Web Apps, and Azure Functions.

Using your DevOps and Azure knowledge, you’ll help improve application reliability, deployment consistency, security, and developer experience. You’ll also support cloud architectures that use secure networking patterns, including Azure Virtual Networks (VNets), private endpoints, and private connectivity between application services and supporting resources. You’ll collaborate with developers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to identify opportunities for automation, troubleshoot deployment and infrastructure issues, and establish repeatable patterns that make it easier for application teams to build and operate secure cloud-native solutions.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience developing tools, automation, and processes that improve DevOps or DevSecOps maturity, including automated builds, testing, deployments, and release management across environments
  • 2+ years of experience troubleshooting, triaging, and resolving CI/CD pipeline, deployment, or cloud infrastructure issues
  • Experience with Git-based software development workflows and CI/CD platforms such as GitHub and GitHub Actions
  • Experience deploying or supporting applications in Microsoft Azure
  • Experience with containerization using Docker, including Linux-based container builds
  • Experience developing, deploying, or supporting cloud-native web applications
  • Experience creating solutions to complex technical problems within a collaborative development team environment
  • Knowledge of cloud security, networking, and application deployment concepts
  • Bachelor’s degree or 5+ years of experience in DevOps in lieu of a degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Azure Container Apps, Azure Web Apps, or Azure Functions
  • Experience working with Azure Container Registry
  • Experience implementing Azure networking patterns using VNets, private endpoints, private DNS, or related private networking capabilities
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, and supporting applications developed using React, Node.js, or Python
  • Experience creating reusable deployment pipelines, infrastructure patterns, or developer tooling across multiple application teams
  • Experience troubleshooting open-source and commercial development tools in public cloud environments
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration technologies
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code and automated cloud environment provisioning
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, including automated security scanning and secure software supply chain practices
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python or Linux shell scripting


Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

companySlogan: Securing U.S. critical minerals. Powering America’s energy future.
descriptionHtml:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

 

Senior DevOps Engineer 

 

Redwood Materials is looking for motivated and talented DevOps engineers to help architect, build, and deploy infrastructure and applications in a hybrid AWS and Kubernetes environment. These applications will cover use cases from web integrations with auto manufacturers to predictive machine controllers to new battery-based energy products. The ideal candidate is someone experienced with creating, managing, and supporting both AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes (self-hosted and AWS EKS based) using infrastructure-as-code tools. This is an opportunity to join during a critical growth phase and build green field software experiences and capabilities which will have a significant impact on the company’s day-to-day operations and ability to scale.

 

Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Leverage existing in-house AWS architectures and design new ones where needed, using the CDK tool kit to manage and create AWS resources.
  • Operationalize workloads in AWS and Kubernetes, helping to design and implement monitoring solutions and deployment pipelines.
  • Enhance existing and implement new build/test/deploy automated pipelines.
  • Partner with on-prem counterparts to drive hybrid infrastructure projects.
  • Apply industry best practices (automation through infrastructure-as-code, security, etc.)
  • Perform root cause analysis of production errors and resolve technical issues.
  • Author and maintain detailed design documents and system architecture diagrams.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps engineer or in a similar software engineering role developing solutions in AWS.
  • Similar hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes workloads.
  • Solid knowledge and experience with AWS services: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, VPC, DynamoDB, etc.
  • Solid knowledge and experience with Kubernetes and containerization: configuring and managing clusters, helm chart development and deployment, building containers, working with docker, etc.
  • Experience automating AWS solutions using infrastructure-as-code tools, such as CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.
  • Fluency in Python strongly desired.
  • Experience with Linux, Git.
  • An understanding of security best practices, and the experience, to know when and where to apply them.
  • Working knowledge of databases (relational and non-relational) a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage production workloads (debugging, monitoring, alerting).

 

Working Conditions:

  • Infrequent night/weekend work if production systems are down and require immediate attention. (No formal on-call rotation; part of shared team responsibility.)

 

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

 

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

descriptionHtml:
L2T is seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure supporting mission-critical applications and enterprise systems. This position is responsible for driving DevOps best practices across the software development lifecycle, enabling continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), automating infrastructure management, and improving system reliability, performance, and security. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in cloud and on-premises environments, infrastructure as code, container orchestration, and cybersecurity-focused operations while serving as a technical leader and mentor within the engineering organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provisioning Design and maintain automated, hands-off provisioning of physical and virtual hosts, from network boot through a fully configured, compliant system.
  • Configuration management Define system state as code, enforce it consistently across environments, and eliminate configuration drift.
  • CI/CD Build and maintain pipelines that test, package and deploy both application and infrastructure code; improve speed and reliability of releases.
  • Workflow automation Find manual, repetitive operational tasks and replace them with reliable, auditable automation and tooling.
  • Identity and access Operate centralized identity services — directory, authentication, certificate authority and access policy — including replication, integration and lifecycle management.
  • Containers Build, secure and run containerized workloads, including image builds, registries and runtime management.
  • Content delivery Manage internal distribution of software, packages and artifacts — repository mirrors, caching and delivery to hosts across sites.
  • Security and hardening Apply and maintain hardening baselines, mandatory access controls, host firewalls and least-privilege practices; support audit and compliance requirements.
  • Reliability Participate in troubleshooting and incident response, lead root-cause analysis, and fix underlying causes rather than symptoms.
  • Collaboration and knowledge sharing Contribute to architecture and engineering standards, share expertise through pairing and design and code reviews, and write the runbooks and design notes the team relies on.
  • 10+ years in systems, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a track record of applying DevOps practices infrastructure as code, version control for everything, peer review, automated testing and continuous delivery.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to team-wide technical standards and design decisions.
  • Deep administration experience with enterprise Linux, preferably Red Hat-family distributions.
  • Hands-on experience with automated OS provisioning and installation at scale.
  • Production experience with at least one configuration management tool.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with a mainstream platform.
  • Solid scripting and programming skills in Python, plus shell.
  • Working knowledge of directory services and authentication LDAP, Kerberos, and PKI/certificate management.
  • Experience building and running containers.
  • Practical Linux security experience mandatory access control, host firewalls, and hardening to a recognized baseline.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across OS, network and application layers.
  • Clear written communication and a habit of documenting work.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

On a mission to deliver affordable, delightful healthcare for all, First Stop Health provides connected, whole-person virtual care to employers 24/7 through app, website, or phone in all 50 states. First Stop Health prioritizes an engaging and easy-to-use experience, setting people on healthier journeys through care at multiple stages. We are proud to be recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

First Stop Health offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes various health and medical coverage options, dental and vision coverage, disability and life coverage, making healthcare easily accessible. For those that choose to waive medical coverage a monthly medical waiver allowance will be provided.

First Stop Health offers a remote-first work environment and flexible paid time off, including Summer Fridays. Furthermore, the employer match 401k plan and monthly phone stipend demonstrates the company's commitment to employee financial well-being. The First Stop Health membership benefit is another added perk for employees and provides our virtual care solutions -- Urgent Care, Mental Health, and Primary Care -- from their very first day!

Job Description

First Stop Health runs a growing AWS platform. It is a set of containerized microservices on ECS, event streaming on Kafka, and a long-running Django/Celery application that we are steadily moving onto modern delivery practices. Everything we run in dev, staging and production is defined as code and shipped through automated pipelines.

You will be the newest member of a small, hands-on cloud team. You will own well-scoped pieces of the platform from the start, and take on larger ones as you prove out. You will write Terraform, maintain GitHub Actions pipelines, keep services healthy and help make releases boring. Responsibilities

  • Write and review Terraform for AWS resources (ECS Fargate, IAM, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, ALB, Cloud Map, MSK, RDS) using reusable modules and per-environment stacks.

  • Operate containerized services: monitor service health, read logs to diagnose failures, investigate failed deployments and unhealthy targets, and document what you learn.

  • Help keep us audit-ready: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, backups, encryption and access reviews, working with our compliance tooling (Vanta).

Requirements

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in cloud, DevOps, platform or site reliability work, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions.
  • Comfort with Docker and containerized workloads.

  • Scripting in Bash or Python, and fluency with JSON and YAML, including tools such as jq.
  • Willingness to join a rotating on-call schedule, and a calm, methodical approach to incidents.
  • Clear written communication, and the habit of checking your work against logs and real state rather than assumptions.

  • Experience with Atmos, Terragrunt or another tool for managing Terraform across many accounts and stacks, and with Cloud Posse components or Geodesic.
  • Experience with ecspresso, AWS CDK or CloudFormation, or other ECS deployment tooling.
  • Familiarity with AWS Organizations and multi-account patterns: IAM Identity Center (SSO), SAML or Entra ID federation, Transit Gateway, VPC design and DNS delegation.
  • Experience with AWS security and compliance services (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, AWS Backup, WAF) and with compliance platforms such as Vanta, in support of SOC 2 or HIPAA-style controls.
  • Exposure to Aurora/RDS Postgres, ElastiCache (Redis), SQS, DMS or Lambda.
  • Experience with self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, pre-commit hooks, terraform-docs and architecture decision records (ADRs).
  • Exposure to Kafka or managed streaming (MSK), or change data capture with Debezium.
  • Familiarity with Datadog or a similar observability platform.
  • Experience running Django or Celery applications in production, or working with PostgreSQL / Aurora.
  • Understanding of cross-account access patterns (for example, cross-account ECR pulls) and OIDC federation.
  • Experience in a regulated environment such as healthcare, and an understanding of why data-handling discipline matters.
  • An AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate, DevOps Engineer Professional or similar).

Tools you’ll work with

  • Cloud: AWS (ECS Fargate, ECR, MSK, Aurora/RDS, ElastiCache, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, IAM Identity Center, CloudWatch)
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Atmos, Geodesic, pre-commit, terraform-docs
  • Delivery: GitHub Actions (including OIDC and reusable workflows), ecspresso, Docker
  • Streaming and data: Kafka (MSK), Debezium, PostgreSQL
  • Observability, security and compliance: Datadog, PagerDuty, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Vanta
  • Applications you will support: Medplum-based services, a Django/Celery monolith, and Kong

How We Work

  • Production changes are gated. Plan, human review, then apply. Nothing reaches production as a side effect of other work.
  • Evidence over assumption. We diagnose from logs and real service state, and we report outcomes honestly, including failures.
  • Security by default. Least-privilege IAM, encrypted storage, private-by-default buckets, and no secret values in output.
  • Build once, promote everywhere. The artifact tested in dev is the artifact that reaches staging and production.
  • Write it down. Runbooks, pull-request descriptions and lessons learned are part of the job.
  • Review is normal. Infrastructure changes are reviewed by a peer before they ship.
  • Shared on-call. The team rotates production on-call through PagerDuty, so no one carries it alone.

Why join us

  • Real ownership of production infrastructure, with a team that reviews and teaches.
  • Meaningful work: reliable systems that support members' access to care.
  • A modernization effort in progress, so you will see the full arc from legacy to automated delivery.

ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organization spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with relevant careers.

Role Summary:

We are hiring a DevOps Engineer to own the delivery pipeline and operational automation for LSEG's internal observability platform - a high-ownership role with direct impact on how the platform gets built and delivered!

The platform is initially deployed in Azure but is developed to be hosting-agnostic and portable. Future deployments may include other cloud providers or on-premises environments, and the delivery and infrastructure patterns must support that flexibility from the beginning.

The focus of this role is making sure every component of the platform can be deployed, scaled, updated, and rolled back in a controlled and repeatable way - regardless of where it runs. This means owning CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, GitOps workflows, and container operations, and working closely with the Lead Engineer and SRE team to support both engineering velocity and operational stability.

This is a central role in how a strategic observability platform gets built, shipped, and operated across a global enterprise - with the chance to use the platform you help build to supervise the pipeline itself!

What You will be Doing:

  • Develop, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for all platform components, covering testing, validation, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment.
  • Implement and evolve GitOps workflows, including branching strategy, environment promotion, approval gates, and rollback patterns.
  • Supervise the health and performance of the delivery pipeline itself, using the observability platform where possible.
  • Evaluate and introduce tooling improvements that increase deployment safety, pipeline reliability, and developer experience.
  • Infrastructure and operations:
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, including module design, remote state management, environment separation, and secrets handling.
  • Operate container and orchestration infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, including stateful workloads such as ClickHouse and Redis.
  • Manage secrets securely across pipelines and environments, ensuring credentials are never stored in version control or state files.
  • Develop delivery and infrastructure patterns that work with Azure as the primary environment and remain portable to other cloud providers or on-premises deployments.
  • Collaboration and improvement:
  • Partner with the Lead Engineer on infrastructure build decisions and with the SRE team on operational runbooks and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain clear documentation for deployment processes, environment configuration, and onboarding guides for new engineers.

What You will Bring:

  • Experience crafting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with ownership of the full pipeline from commit to production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, including module design, state management, secrets handling, and environment separation.
  • Experience with GitOps practices, including pull-request-driven deployments, environment promotion, and version-controlled configuration.
  • Container and orchestration experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, including stateful workloads.
  • Secrets management experience using tools such as HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, with the ability to compose patterns that remain portable across providers or to on-premises environments.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with engineering and SRE teams about pipeline design, deployment state, and operational risk.
  • Desirable skills and experience:
  • Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including compute, networking, storage, and identity and access management.
  • Experience with on-premises Kubernetes deployments or hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure patterns.
  • Experience with other cloud providers such as AWS or GCP, particularly where multi-cloud or provider-agnostic patterns were required.
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ClickHouse, or Cribl from a deployment or operational perspective.
  • Experience instrumenting CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure with observability tooling.
  • Experience in a regulated, financial services, or large enterprise technology environment.

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

descriptionHtml:
Octus

Octus is a leading global provider of credit intelligence, data, and analytics. Since 2013, tens of thousands of professionals across hedge fund, investment banking, management consulting, and law firm verticals have come to rely on Octus to make better, faster, and more confident decisions in pace with the fast-moving credit markets.
For more information, visit: https://octus.com/

Working at Octus

Octus hires growth-minded innovators and trailblazers across the globe to drive our business and culture. Our core values – Action Oriented, Customer First Mindset, Effective Team Players, and Driven to Excel – define an organizational ethos that’s as high-performing as it is human. Among other perks, Octus employees enjoy competitive health benefits, matched 401k and pension plans, PTO, generous parental leave, gym subsidies, educational reimbursements for career development, recognition programs, and much more. 

Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Octus, you will play a crucial role in the development, implementation, and maintenance of the cloud infrastructure for our products. This position involves close collaboration with Application Developers, Data Engineers, SRE, Security, and IT professionals to automate and streamline operations and processes. Your contributions will be essential in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems and applications.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.
  • Effectively prioritize workload with a constant focus on increasing developer efficiency.
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, performance, and cost-effectiveness. Experience with AWS is a plus.
  • Work closely with SRE to develop and maintain monitoring and alerting systems to ensure the health and performance of our systems and applications.
  • Work closely with Security to implement and enforce security best practices across our infrastructure and applications.
  • Collaborate with software developers to optimize application performance and reliability.
  • Participate in the planning and execution of disaster recovery and business continuity strategies.
  • Effectively communicate with stakeholders to provide updates on project statuses, issues, and recommendations.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide system support.

 

Core Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience in a DevOps role.
  • At least 2+ years of experience with Terraform.
  • Expert knowledge of cloud concepts and services (EC2, ECS, S3, RDS, A/ELB, EBS, VPC, Route53 or equivalent).
  • Expert level knowledge of Linux. Strong scripting skills for automation and tooling.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, diagnose, resolve & document RCA of incidents.
  • Good knowledge of database configuration, concepts, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Thorough understanding of Security principles and experience in designing, implementing, monitoring proper controls.
  • Extensive experience with Infrastructure-as-code & configuration management tools (Terraform, SaltStack or equivalent).
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes, ECS including managing microservices architectures.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Github Actions or equivalent.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog, Cloud Watch or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skill, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

At Octus, we consider a range of factors in connection with compensation decisions, including experience, skills, location, and our business needs and limitations. As a result, compensation may vary within and across similar roles and positions. Please note that the salary range information below is a good faith estimate for this position and actual compensation for any individual may fall outside this range if warranted by the circumstances applicable to that individual. If we identify a role that would be suitable for a broader range of skills and experience such that we would consider hiring at multiple levels then the range listed below may reflect that breadth.

The salary range estimate for this position is $165,000 - $190,000.

The actual compensation will be at Octus' sole discretion and will be determined by the aforementioned and other relevant factors.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Octus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse work environment where all individuals are valued, respected, and treated fairly. We believe that diversity enriches our workplace and enhances our ability to innovate and succeed.

descriptionHtml:
Erias Ventures was founded to serve its customers with an entrepreneurial mindset. We value creative problem-solving, open communication, and empowering our employees to make decisions and put forth new ideas.

Our staff includes technical experts working across multiple disciplines, bringing diverse perspectives to every project. We are seeking engineers who wish to grow their careers and want to become part of a technically strong and growth-oriented company focused on bringing innovative solutions to the difficult mission problems facing our customers.

Description We seeking are seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. This role currently supports a customer onsite in San Antonio, TX.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS
  • Support development and deployment of non-cloud (Edge) infrastructure of on-premise and portable equipment
  • Automate deployment processes and ensure reliability and scalability of services
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate their applications into the infrastructure
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and resolve issues as necessary
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to ensure high availability and performance
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, continuously exploring new ways to improve our infrastructure
  • Seamlessly transition between hands-on execution and team guidance, treating mentorship and team leadership as inherent components of senior-level impact
  • Other duties as assigned

Clearance

A current Top Secret (TS) level U.S. Government Security clearance is required; U.S. citizenship required. Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI level Security Clearance is required.

Experience

Nine plus (9+) years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or seven (7) years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and thirteen (13) years relevant experience.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure
  • Proficient in configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible
  • Experience with application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management
  • Ability to develop in multiple programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools
  • Must be comfortable in a terminal-based environment
  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a tech lead, mentor, or manager for engineering teams
  • Must be willing/able to help open/close the workspace during regular business hours as needed
  • Maintain a standard 40-hour, 5-day on-site work week in San Antonio, TX. Flexibility is essential to accommodate any changes in the schedule

Desired Skills

  • A current active TS/SCI clearance is highly desired
  • Experience with big data technologies like: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc
  • Experience with containers, EKS, Diode, CI/CD, and Terraform are a plus

Benefits

Erias Ventures provides a complete package of wealth, health, and happiness benefits. The expected salary range for this position, depending on education and years of experience is $150,000 - $250,000.

Wealth Benefits

  • Above Market Hourly Pay
  • 11% Roth or Traditional 401k with Immediate Vesting and Deposit
  • Spot Bonuses for Assisting with Business Development and Company Growth
  • Professional Development Bonuses for Certificates and Degrees

Health Benefits:

  • Company subsidized Medical Coverage
  • 100% Company Paid Vision and Dental Coverage
  • 100% Company Paid Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, and Group Life Insurance
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement

Job Title: Azure Platform Engineer

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Revision Date: 11/12/26

Role Type: Remote or Hybrid (Jacksonville/Nashville)

Reports To: Senior Director of Cloud Operations

About Mosai

Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at https://www.mosai.com/

Position Summary

The Azure Platform Engineer builds and supports the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automation that form the internal platform our engineering teams use to deliver software reliably and securely. Working hands-on with AKS, Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure Bicep, and application and transport-layer networking (OSI layers 4–7), you will partner with software development, operations, and quality assurance teams to improve continuous integration, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation, and release reliability. You will work under the guidance of senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined projects and tasks.

In this role, you will help build and run the AKS-based platform that supports reliable product delivery, scalable cloud infrastructure, and consistent, self-service deployment standards across engineering teams, while growing your technical skills.

Job Duties

  • Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including cluster configuration, scaling, upgrades, and ingress, and escalate complex issues as needed.
  • Maintain platform tooling and processes across AKS, Azure, Azure DevOps, and Azure Bicep, collaborating with software development, operations, and quality assurance teams to streamline continuous integration, continuous delivery, and automation, with guidance from senior team members.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Azure Bicep to provision and manage cloud resources in Azure, supporting scalability, performance, and security.
  • Build, maintain, and improve Azure DevOps pipelines for building, testing, and deploying applications, including pipeline configuration, integrations, and security.
  • Apply secure DevOps practices, including secrets management, least-privilege access, and vulnerability scanning in pipelines and infrastructure, in support of security and HIPAA compliance requirements.
  • Support and troubleshoot application and network traffic at OSI layers 4–7, including TCP/UDP load balancing, TLS/SSL certificates, HTTP/HTTPS routing, DNS, and Kubernetes ingress, working with Azure networking services such as Azure Load Balancer and Application Gateway, and escalating complex issues to senior engineers.
  • Configure and use monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (such as Datadog, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics) and participate in the on-call rotation to respond to and resolve production incidents and pipeline or infrastructure issues.
  • Participate in code and pipeline reviews and learn from senior engineers to build technical skills and follow best practices.
  • Build and document reusable platform components, such as pipeline templates, Bicep modules, and Helm charts, that give development teams self-service deployment capabilities on AKS.
  • All other job-related duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 3+ years of DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure experience, including Azure provisioning, automation, access controls, and production support.
  • Experience with Git, including branching, merging, and resolving merge conflicts.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, including pipeline creation, configuration, integration, and release automation.
  • Working experience with Azure Bicep (or similar IaC tools such as Terraform or ARM templates) for provisioning and managing Azure resources.
  • Knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, or other relevant technologies.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Kubernetes, with Docker and containerization.
  • Working knowledge of networking at OSI layers 4–7, including TCP/UDP, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, load balancing, and reverse proxies.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to participate in and contribute to the team's on-call rotation, including occasional after-hours support.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Experience with Helm and AKS cluster operations such as node pools, upgrades, and autoscaling (ideal candidate)
  • Experience with Azure networking and traffic management services (Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Front Door, Azure Firewall), Kubernetes ingress controllers, or service mesh
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana, or Prometheus
  • Familiarity with secure DevOps practices (secrets management, least-privilege access, vulnerability scanning) and HIPAA or other compliance requirements in a healthcare environment
  • Azure (e.g., AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-700) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD) certifications are a plus.

Physical Demands of Our Work Environment

  • This position uses a computer and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The in-office noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office. Frequent interruptions may be encountered throughout the workday.
  • The employee is required to stand or sit, talk, and hear frequently, and to use repetitive keying or hand motions.
  • The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment

  • This position is open to applicants who currently reside in, or are willing to work from, one of the following states: FL, GA, IA, IN, KY, MI, MO, MS, NC, NE, NM, PA, SC, TN, TX. The Company reserves the right to update the list of eligible states at any time.
  • Occasional travel required
  • Ability to work weekends, nights, or be on-call as a regular part of the job

Mosai is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status, If you are unable to submit an application because of a incompatible assistive technology or disability, please contact us at careers@mosai.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

Mosai is an E-verify employer. Your eligibility to work in the United States will be verified through the E-verify system if you apply and are selected for a position.

  • Be aware of employment fraud. All email communications from Mosai or its hiring managers originate from @mosai.com or addresses. We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about the validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


Principal DevOps Engineer

Boston, MA | Hybrid | Onshape


Onshape, a PTC SaaS business, is redefining how professional engineers design, collaborate and manage product data in the cloud. Our platform brings the best of modern SaaS collaboration to 3D CAD — think SolidWorks meets GitHub meets Google Docs — and is used globally by teams building the next generation of products.

We are looking for a Principal DevOps Engineer to help scale and operate the global cloud platform behind Onshape’s collaborative CAD and data management service. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, building automation, improving reliability and keeping large-scale SaaS systems secure, performant and resilient.

You will work closely with a highly technical team in Boston’s Seaport District to create a low-touch, highly automated cloud environment. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, deeply hands-on with Linux and cloud operations, comfortable digging into code and infrastructure, and excited to raise the bar for deployment, monitoring, security and operational excellence across a global SaaS platform.


Why This Role Matters

Operate and evolve the cloud platform behind a globally used SaaS product. Focus on AWS infrastructure, automation, Linux operations, Kubernetes platforms, security, compliance, and operational excellence. This role is distinct from SRE and is centered on infrastructure and platform operations rather than Java application reliability.


What You Will Own

  • Large-scale AWS cloud infrastructure operations
  • Terraform and configuration management using Ansible/Puppet
  • Linux fleet management and automation
  • Kubernetes and cloud-native platform operations
  • Operational tooling, observability implementation and platform supportability
  • Security, compliance, GovCloud, ITAR and FedRAMP support
  • Cloud scalability, capacity planning and cost optimization
  • Technical leadership and mentoring across engineering teams


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and improve cloud infrastructure supporting thousands of cloud resources
  • Build low-touch, highly automated operational environments
  • Eliminate manual operational toil through engineering
  • Manage infrastructure as code and configuration management standards
  • Improve deployment consistency, disaster recovery and operational readiness
  • Partner with security teams on hardening and compliance initiatives
  • Create self-service capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster
  • Influence platform standards and operational best practices


Required Experience

  • 10+ years in Cloud Operations, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering or DevOps
  • Strong AWS experience at production scale
  • Expert Linux administration and troubleshooting
  • Terraform expertise
  • Ansible, Puppet or Chef experience
  • Kubernetes operational experience
  • Python, Bash or Go automation skills
  • Production on-call and incident response experience


Preferred Experience

  • MongoDB, Elasticsearch or similar platforms
  • GovCloud, FedRAMP or ITAR environments
  • GitOps and platform engineering experience
  • Cloud cost optimization and FinOps
  • Java application operational support


Why Candidates Join

  • Principal-level technical impact without people management
  • Large-scale SaaS challenges
  • Strong engineering culture
  • Opportunity to eliminate toil through automation
  • Hybrid flexibility in Greater Boston


This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future sponsorship from PTC.


Compensation (CIP)

PTC carefully considers a wide variety of factors when determining compensation. The anticipated annual salary range for this position is between $118,000 - 190,000. The salary range reflects a good-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Additionally, candidates may be eligible for a performance-based bonus. Employees also have the opportunity to become a PTC shareholder through our employee share purchase program (ESPP), which allows for the purchase of discounted PTC stock. Certain roles may also be eligible for participation in our equity programs. Employees may be eligible for medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off and sick leave, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) contributions and employer match, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage and, if you are an office-assigned employee, a generous commuter subsidy. All total rewards and benefits programs are subject to applicable plan eligibility and other terms and conditions.

For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits, please visit our Careers Page.

Applications will be accepted on an on-going basis.


At PTC, we believe in the power of diverse ideas and perspectives. As a global company that values and respects all identities, cultures, and perspectives, we strive to create an inclusive PTC for ALL through an environment where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to bring their true, authentic selves to work. Proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, ethnicity, ancestry, marital status, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits and our AI usage, please visit our Careers Page (https://www.ptc.com/en/careers/united-states-careers). Applications will be accepted on an on-going basis until the opportunity is filled.


PTC endeavors to make ptc.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact PTC's Talent Acquisition team at TalentAcquisition@ptc.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."
