descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job Description

Are you excited about applying machine learning to real-world software problems in Legal, Tax, Compliance, and News? Thomson Reuters Labs is seeking a Cloud & DevOps Engineer II who enjoys solving problems in collaboration with a global team.

We experiment, we build, we deliver. TR Labs supports the organization and our customers through applied research and development of new product features and internal developer tools. We innovate across Legal, Tax & Accounting, Government, and Reuters News, and we invest in long-term research that can shape the future of the industry.

As a Cloud & DevOps Engineer II, you will join the Cloud and DevOps team, a central platform function serving engineering and research teams across Labs. Our mission is to enable everyone to deliver better software, faster.

Key Responsibilities

As a Cloud & DevOps Engineer II, You Will

  • Build and operate: Design, deploy, and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation, with reproducible deployments and well-managed software delivery in support of Labs as a Research and Development function.
  • Deliver with ownership: Take ownership of your work from design through ongoing support. In a fast-paced, dynamic environment, turn complex platform problems into right-sized solutions with clear scope, and deliver them on time.
  • Cloud operations and support: Handle day-to-day cloud operations and support for engineering and research teams, including monitoring, debugging, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution, and document what you learn.
  • Partner with research: Work closely with research scientists and research engineers to turn their experiments into reliable, secure, scalable cloud solutions, including AI/ML workloads.
  • Enable developers: Build internal developer tools, automation, and documentation that make teams more productive.
  • Secure and optimize: Apply AWS security best practices, including least-privilege IAM and compliance requirements. Run security scanning with tools such as Snyk, and identify opportunities to reduce cloud cost through FinOps practices.
  • Innovate and grow: Try new approaches, learn new technologies, and iterate based on feedback. Communicate your work clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; a Master's degree is a plus
  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience using AWS to solve platform engineering and software delivery problems
  • Practical experience with AWS services including ECR, ECS, Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, SageMaker, and Bedrock
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and AWS CodeBuild
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and CloudFormation
  • Strong Python skills for automation, scripting, and building AWS Lambda functions, plus Bash scripting
  • Understanding of AWS security fundamentals, including least-privilege IAM and network design
  • Ability to break down ambiguous problems into manageable pieces and deliver iteratively
  • Strong critical thinking and debugging skills: you can troubleshoot across code, infrastructure, networking, and permissions to find root causes and fix them
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with complex problems and time-managed delivery
  • A strong sense of ownership: you take responsibility for outcomes, follow through without close direction, and raise risks early
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including working with research scientists and engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch
  • Knowledge of cloud security and code security practices, including security scanning tools such as Snyk
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing cloud resource utilization and cost
  • Understanding of machine learning concepts and workflows
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Codex

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and govern enterprise-wide Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and Configuration Management frameworks to ensure secure, consistent, and repeatable infrastructure deployments.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks, Salt states, and other automation artifacts to manage configuration drift, enforce standards, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Define and manage the desired state of servers, virtual machines, containers, cloud resources, and platform services across hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Architect and evolve Configuration Management strategies, standards, and governance models that support scalability, compliance, and business continuity requirements.
  • Build scalable, idempotent, and auditable automation pipelines for infrastructure provisioning, configuration deployment, patch management, and compliance enforcement.
  • Collaborate with cloud, platform, security, and engineering teams to integrate Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration Management practices into enterprise DevOps and CI/CD workflows.
  • Establish automated compliance controls, configuration validation processes, and reporting capabilities to support security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize configuration management platforms, provide technical leadership on automation best practices, and mentor engineers on Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
  • Five to six years of relevant experience


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Configuration Management platforms such as Ansible Automation Platform (preferred), Salt, Chef, or Puppet.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions within large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure automation, configuration drift management, system compliance, and desired-state configuration principles.
  • Experience building scalable automation frameworks for provisioning, configuration management, patching, and operational governance.
  • Proficiency with Linux and Windows Server administration, including automation of operating system configuration and lifecycle management.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with CI/CD pipelines, source control platforms (Git), and DevOps toolchains.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including automation of cloud infrastructure resources.
  • Strong troubleshooting, scripting, and problem-solving skills with experience using automation languages and tools such as Python, YAML, PowerShell, or Bash.


Location expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
  • Basic term and optional term life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave
  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
  • Adoption assistance
  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law


Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

Nice to Have:

descriptionHtml:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About The Role

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own build and deployment automation for Vannevar Labs. Your decisions today will have a large impact on the company’s future. We believe that simple systems are easier to understand, maintain, and scale. You will be making trade-offs as you work to ensure that our systems are prepared to operate in both commercial and high-side environments at scale — being able to effectively communicate these trade-offs with your teammates is a must.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, maintain, and be responsible for overall platform health, scaling and planning.
  • Developing self-service tools and automating things to improve data engineering efficiency.
  • Build logging and monitoring tools to visualize the state of the platform and improve our SRE practices.
  • Play a critical part in implementing a secure, robust and high availability DevOps pipeline.
  • Work with the team to continue the build out of a multi-account AWS environment.
  • Automate build & deployment processes.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, software engineering.
  • Experience crafting CI/CD processes and automation.
  • Deep knowledge in AWS cloud technology.
  • Experience with PLG stack, Datadog, or other enterprise monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code technologies such as Terraform and Pulumi.
  • Proficient with containerization technologies like Docker.
  • Excellent with Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.
  • Experience working in an agile scrum environment and also an ability to work independently.
  • Able to quickly learn new and existing technologies.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical capabilities.
  • U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position will require the ability to access U.S. only data systems and export-controlled data.
  • TS/SCI with FSP Clearance required
  • Ability to commute/travel to DC customer site up to 50% of the time

Additional Qualifications (Nice To Haves)

  • Experience working in AWS GovCloud.
  • Experience in data processing with the Department of Defense and/or the IC.
  • Experience building CD/CI systems in Github Actions.
  • Passion for DevSecOps.
  • Experience working with Elasticsearch/Opensearch.
  • Have worked hardening and delivering software applications.
  • Experience with modern web services architectures.
  • Experience with relational database systems, including SQL and relational design.
  • Knowledge of advanced networking concepts such as overlays, VPNs, and zero trust networks.
  • Strong collaboration and negotiation skills and must be able to work on multi-functional projects with internal partner engineering teams

The base salary range for this position is $160,000 - $240,000. We hire engineers at multiple levels based on their experience, technical capabilities, and scope of responsibility. This range reflects the base salaries we typically expect to offer for this role, with individual offers determined by the candidate's qualifications and level.

Equity is offered in addition to base salary.

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 100% remote first culture. You can work from anywhere in the US and all full time employees have WeWork access
  • Unlimited PTO including competitive vacation and holiday schedules
  • Lifestyle stipends - Monthly mental health, wellness & fitness stipend, in-home office setup stipend and family planning assistance
  • Salary top-up during military reserve duty
  • Fully paid parental leave
  • Child and pet care reimbursement during travel

Vannevar is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't feel like you're a perfect fit. If you're passionate about contributing to our mission, we'd love to hear from you!

IMPORTANT NOTICE

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all applicants. Official emails from the company will come from an @vannevarlabs.com domain. Under no circumstances will a legitimate representative from our company contact you to request passwords, financial information, or other sensitive personal data. Please be vigilant of potential scams.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

We are seeking a Junior Automation & OpenShift Engineer to support enterprise automation and container-platform capabilities in secure, mission-critical environments. This role supports automation and deployment activities using Rundeck, Ansible, and Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP).

The successful candidate will work under the guidance of senior engineers and collaborate with Platform Engineering, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and application teams. This is an opportunity for an early-career technologist to develop hands-on experience with infrastructure automation, OpenShift operations, CI/CD, GitOps, scripting, and security-focused operational practices.

Key Responsibilities May Include

  • Assist with the development, testing, and maintenance of Rundeck jobs, workflows, runbooks, and operational automation.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and reusable automation content under senior-engineer guidance.
  • Support OpenShift Container Platform installation, configuration, upgrades, and day-two operational activities.
  • Help automate deployment and configuration tasks across Linux and Windows environments using Ansible, Rundeck, Bash, Python, and/or PowerShell.
  • Assist with deployment pipelines, GitOps configuration, Helm charts, and related source-controlled configuration repositories.
  • Troubleshoot automation, deployment, OpenShift workload, access-control, networking, storage, and container-image issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including runbooks, standard operating procedures, deployment guides, and troubleshooting articles.
  • Support secure and compliant platform operations, including security-hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and audit-documentation activities.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, and application teams to coordinate automation and deployment work.

Basic Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% in support of customer sites, deployment activities, training, and team collaboration.
  • 0–2 years of relevant experience in software development, systems administration, DevOps, cloud/platform engineering, or IT automation; internships, technical coursework, labs, and personal projects may be considered.
  • Foundational knowledge of Linux operating systems, system-administration concepts, and command-line tools.
  • Experience with at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with source-control concepts and tools such as Git.
  • Basic understanding of automation, configuration management, deployment processes, or job-scheduling concepts.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative, remote, or distributed technical team.

Desired Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Exposure to or hands-on experience with Rundeck, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform (AAP), Ansible, or similar automation and orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, Podman, or other container-platform technologies.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, GitOps, Helm, YAML-based configuration, or tools such as Argo CD, OpenShift GitOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or OpenShift Pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Windows server administration, automated Windows configuration, or system provisioning.
  • Exposure to enterprise security and compliance practices, including RBAC, least privilege, STIGs, NIST controls, vulnerability remediation, or compliance documentation.
  • Exposure to air-gapped, classified, or otherwise highly controlled computing environments.
  • Familiarity with virtualization, networking, or storage concepts, including KubeVirt, VMware, DNS, load balancing, persistent storage, or container networking.
  • Relevant technical certifications or training, such as RHCSA, Red Hat Ansible Automation training, Kubernetes/OpenShift training, CompTIA Security+, or comparable credentials.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $101400.00 - $188200.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $91200.00 - $169400.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $81100.00 - $150500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $72900.00 - $135500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.
At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

descriptionHtml:
Description

The DevOps Engineer at Hyper Solutions plays a critical role in designing, operating, and maintaining the cloud infrastructure, release pipelines, and operational practices that support Hyper's software products. This position is responsible for AWS infrastructure, infrastructure automation, release management processes, incident response procedures, and the engineering on-call rotation.


Working closely with Engineering, Security, and Quality leadership, the DevOps Engineer helps establish reliable, scalable, and well-governed infrastructure and operational processes. This role owns the technical systems and documented procedures that support incident response, release management, and infrastructure changes, ensuring operational policies are version-controlled, reviewed, and maintained alongside engineering code.


This position is well-suited for a systems-oriented engineer who enjoys solving infrastructure challenges, establishing reliable operational practices, and taking ownership of both technical systems and the processes that support them.


Core Responsibilities

  • Design and manage the engineering on-call rotation, including scheduling, escalation procedures, and supporting tools
  • Own incident response processes including triage, severity classification, escalation, and post-incident reviews
  • Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting reliable software releases and rollback procedures
  • Architect, operate, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices
  • Develop and maintain AWS environment structures, account strategies, access controls, and infrastructure governance
  • Establish and maintain operational policies for on-call coverage, incident response, and release management
  • Ensure operational policies are version-controlled, reviewed, and updated through established engineering processes
  • Support infrastructure scalability, reliability, and security as Hyper's software product portfolio grows


Additional Responsibilities

  • Improve infrastructure automation and deployment practices to ensure changes are repeatable, reviewed, and auditable
  • Evaluate monitoring, alerting, and incident management tools to improve operational visibility and response
  • Partner with product engineering teams to integrate new workloads, including IoT analytics platforms, into the existing cloud architecture
  • Collaborate with Security and Quality leadership to align infrastructure and operational standards
  • Review infrastructure and pipeline changes contributed by other engineers
  • Maintain operational documentation including runbooks, escalation procedures, and architecture decisions


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong production experience with Terraform, including infrastructure state management and risk considerations
  • Deep knowledge of AWS services including IAM, Organizations, Service Control Policies, VPC, ECS, and RDS
  • Experience developing and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and OIDC federation
  • Experience managing production incidents, including triage, severity assessment, escalation, and resolution
  • Experience developing and maintaining documented operational policies and procedures
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with observability and secrets management platforms such as Datadog and Doppler

Job Title

Senior DevOps Engineer

Location:

OH - Columbus

What You'll Do

Digital Disbursements (DD) is a fintech company, led by a team with deep industry experience and a strong track record of value creation. We operate in the digital payments space and have a proven product-market fit. We specialize in helping bring B2C payments to the digital age and are poised for significant growth in the months ahead. Digital Disbursements was acquired by Western Alliance Bank (NYSE:WAL) in January 2022 and operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of WAL.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll provide expertise in a suite of technical tools and products in a given domain to ensure solutions are safe, secure, compliant and reliable. You'll identify develop and support needs, as well as taking on design responsibilities supporting project tasks. As the Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll facilitate dialogue and activities to ensure team collaboration including teams outside of your domain. You'll develop effective presentations and narratives for their teams.

This is a full-time position (no contract, 1099, or C2C) which requires you to be in office 5-days per week. You must be located in or within a commutable distance from Portland, OR or Columbus, OH.

  • Assist to author and maintain complex infrastructure-as-code templates (Serverless Framework, CloudFormation, TypeScript) for AWS.
  • Implement changes consistently across multi-account, multi-environment, multi-region.
  • Implement and analyze AWS logging, metrics, and alerting..
  • Support AWS core services, networking, security, performance, and troubleshooting, e.g. VPC networking, IAM, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, WAF, RDS, etc.
  • Enforce least-privilege access control (IAM Roles & Policies, database, etc.).
  • Ensure environmental parity by identifying and resolving drift from IaC templates.
  • Assist to define, implement, and author documentation on standards and policies.
  • Research security vulnerabilities, best-practices, and new technologies and turn that research into detailed recommendations.
  • Assist with PR validation and release events.
  • Partner with Dev and QA teams to implement and mature automated testing.

What You'll Need

  • 7+ years of related experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in related field required.
  • Strong experience configuring and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub, AWS.CodePipeline/CodeBuild) for application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Strong working experience with AWS.
  • Experience in an environment subject to governance and audits (e.g. SOC2, PCI, SOX).
  • Experience with troubleshooting pipeline failure and deployment errors with root-cause analysis.
  • Solid Git fundamentals (PRs, branching, merging).
  • Advanced speaking and writing communication skills.
  • May require up to 25% travel.

Benefits You’ll Love

We offer all the important things you'd want — like competitive salaries, an ownership stake in the company, medical and dental insurance, time off, a great 401k matching program, tuition assistance program, an employee volunteer program, and a wellness program. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bolster your business knowledge, learning the ins and outs of how successful companies operate and manage their finances, giving you invaluable hands-on experience to help grow your career!

About The Company

Digital Disbursements is a subsidiary of Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Western Alliance Bancorporation. Serving clients nationwide, Western Alliance Bank includes six legacy bank brands — Alliance Association Bank, Alliance Bank of Arizona, Bank of Nevada, Bridge Bank, First Independent Bank and Torrey Pines Bank — that remain part of the company’s heritage.

Western Alliance Bancorporation is committed to equal employment and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, color, religion, age, nation origin, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetic information. Western Alliance Bancorporation is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process and/or need an alternative method of applying, please email HR@westernalliancebank.com or call 602-386-2488. When contacting us, please provide your contact information and state the nature of your accessibility issue. We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests that involve a reasonable accommodation in the application process.

Job Description Summary:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer 2, you will drive efforts to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of AWS cloud infrastructure and services. You will work extensively with Kubernetes (EKS), Helm charts, Kafka, and cloud-native solutions, while also ensuring stability for legacy Java applications running on EC2. You will focus on automation, cost optimization, and applying site reliability engineering (SRE) principles.

What you'll do

  • Architect and manage secure, scalable cloud infrastructure with a strong focus on automation and efficiency.
  • Lead Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development using Terraform, Helm, and Ansible.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Kubernetes applications and traditional EC2 workloads.
  • Implement and enhance observability solutions using DataDog, ensuring real-time monitoring and proactive issue resolution.
  • Drive Kubernetes-based containerization and orchestration initiatives.
  • Work with Kafka to design and optimize event-driven architectures.
  • Work with developers to build platform features that enable self-service and increase velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm, and Kafka.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python, Bash). Experience with one other high-level language such as Java or Golang preferred.
  • Familiarity with healthcare-specific technologies such as FHIR and HL7 and their common implementation patterns (such as HL7 VPN networking requirements)
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, security, and scalability best practices.
  • Experience with troubleshooting and optimizing large-scale cloud infrastructures.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

For over forty years, HarbourVest has been home to a committed team of professionals with an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to deliver impactful solutions to our clients and investing partners. As our global firm grows, we continue to add individuals who seek a collaborative, open-door culture that values diversity and innovative thinking.

In our collegial environment that’s marked by low turnover and high energy, you’ll be inspired to grow and thrive. Here, you will be encouraged to build on your strengths and acquire new skills and experiences.

We are committed to fostering an environment of inclusion that promotes mutual respect among all employees. Understanding and valuing these differences optimizes the potential of both the individual and the firm.

HarbourVest is an equal opportunity employer.

This position will be a hybrid work arrangement. You will receive 18 remote workdays per quarter to use at your discretion, subject to manager approval. For example, you may choose to work in the office 4 days per week and take one remote day weekly (typically 13 weeks per quarter), leaving 5 additional remote days to be used as needed.

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Cloud Engineer to join our Quantitative Investment Science organization. This role is ideal for a technology professional with a strong passion for data, automation, and modern DevOps practices who thrives in sophisticated, high-impact environments.

The successful candidate will collaborate with quantitative researchers, data and application engineers, vendors, and IT partners. They will develop, deploy, and support robust CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based environments. You will play a critical role in supporting the full application and data lifecycle—from development through production—within our Azure-based Investment Data Analytics Platform. Your contributions will directly enhance development efficiency, system reliability, and operational excellence across the organization.

The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Enjoys building software, automation, and platforms that improve developer productivity and system reliability with a strong engineering mindset.
  • Has strong experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and Git based development workflows.
  • Writes clean, maintainable scripts in Bash, PowerShell, and Python for automation and operations.
  • Has experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, preferably in Microsoft Azure, along with containerization and deployment practices.
  • Can support production systems through troubleshooting and root cause analysis, and collaborates effectively across engineering and business teams..

What you will do:

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, approval, and deployment workflows.
  • Build internal tools, services, and automation to improve developer experience and operational efficiency.
  • Design and support IAC solutions for Azure cloud resources, networking, storage, and compute.
  • Implement and manage containerized application deployments using technologies such as Docker.
  • Drive observability, incident response, and production support while partnering with engineering teams to improve reliability and release processes.

What you bring:

  • Strong experience with scripting and automation (Bash, PowerShell, Python), CI/CD systems, and Git-based workflows.
  • Experience with Azure cloud services, IAC tools (Terraform, Bicep, or similar), and container technologies.
  • Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, and operational support for production systems.
  • Experience with modern data platforms, including Snowflake and analytics focused environments.
  • Strong testing, communication, and collaboration skills with a track record of delivering complex engineering initiatives.

Education Preferred:

  • Bachelor of Arts (B.A) / Bachelor of Science (B.S) degree or equivalent experience

Experience:

  • 6+ Years of DevOps experience in cloud-based software delivery
    • Experience working within the financial services or investment management industry preferred
Base Salary Range

$150,000.00 - $160,000.00

This USD base salary range represents only one component of total compensation for this role and is provided in accordance with local requirements. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, which is determined based on individual and overall firm performance. In addition to salary and bonus eligibility, total compensation may include participation in long-term reward programs (typically for more senior-level roles). We also offer a comprehensive total rewards package that may include retirement contributions, health insurance, income protection, paid time off and leave benefits as well as well-being programs. Our total rewards offerings are influenced by several business factors, and eligibility for certain components will vary by position and geography. Please note the posted ranges do not apply outside the U.S. and should not be converted to other currencies as a proxy for compensation in other countries.

Job Description:

Deliver simple solutions to complex problems as a Senior DevOps Engineer at GDIT. Here, you'll tailor cutting-edge solutions to the unique requirements of our clients while making the end user's experience your priority and we'll make your career growth ours.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Senior DevOps Engineer you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Senior DevOps Engineer joining our team to support our intel customer in Springfield, VA or St. Louis, MO.

HOW A SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

A Senior DevOps Engineer will drive faster, more reliable software delivery by strengthening the practices, automation and operational discipline that helps teams ship with confidence. This role will bridge development and operations to remove friction, improve collaboration, and ensure releases reach users with less disruption and greater consistency. In addition, the position will enhance observability, monitoring, and incident response to accelerate issue detection and recovery, while also improving system configuration management and documentation to support scalability, resilience, and long-term operational excellence.

  • Configure CI/CD for multiple web applications

  • Advises hardware engineers on machine characteristics that affect software systems, such as storage capacity, processing speed, and input/output requirements.
  • Prepares reports on analyses, findings, and project progress, and presents results to management and/or customer personnel.

Required:

  • Knowledge of including monitoring & logging and network & security for containers
  • Experience deploying and managing databases, interacting with DBs via SQL and ORMs
  • Comfortable writing Python and BASH to create systems tooling
  • Ability to contribute code updates/tweaks to existing code repositories
  • Experience with software system design with the ability to create application architecture diagrams for new applications
  • Experience integrating security components with applications and databases
  • One or more technical certification (Network +, Security +, CISSP, etc)

  • An understanding of reverse proxies such as Nginx, Traefik or Apache HTTP Server (WebGate), HAProxy, or Envoy.

  • Experience in System Engineering and project/program management.

descriptionHtml:
Mixed-Cloud Platform & Release Engineering

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to help build, operate, and continuously improve the CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure that support our mobility products. This is a hands-on individual contributor role responsible for the reliability, security, and velocity of build and release automation across a hybrid environment that includes Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises data centers.

You will work alongside a team of DevOps engineers, SREs, and release engineers, partnering closely with Software Engineering, QE, Architecture, and Information Security to help hundreds of microservices ship safely multiple times per day. Success in this role is measured by your contributions to deployment frequency, change failure rate, mean time to recovery (MTTR), platform availability, and the security posture of the delivery pipeline.

Essential Responsibilities

CI/CD & Release Engineering

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines supporting hundreds of microservices and applications, including pipeline-as-code standards, build artifacts, container images, and deployment automation across Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
  • Contribute to measurable improvements in DORA metrics: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and time to restore service.
  • Implement and maintain release patterns (blue/green, canary, feature flags), rollback procedures, and pre-production validation gates.
  • Partner with QE to embed automated testing — unit, integration, contract, performance, and security — into pipelines so that quality is enforced before production.

Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure Operations

  • Build and operate infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and on-premises data centers, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and connectivity between environments (VPN, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, peering, and transit).
  • Manage and support Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, and on-prem clusters), container registries, service meshes, ingress controllers, and supporting middleware.
  • Write and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform and platform-native tooling (CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep); participate in drift detection, peer review, and policy-as-code on all infrastructure changes.
  • Support capacity planning, cost optimization (FinOps), and rightsizing efforts across cloud and on-prem footprints.

Observability, Reliability & Incident Response

  • Build and maintain the observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, and synthetic monitoring — and help define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for critical services.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and act as an incident responder for production events, contributing to root-cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion.
  • Support chaos engineering exercises, game days, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity exercises to validate the resilience of hybrid systems.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with Information Security to implement shift-left security practices: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container image scanning, and IaC policy scanning in every pipeline.
  • Manage secrets, certificates, and identity infrastructure across cloud and on-prem environments (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, IAM, RBAC).
  • Help maintain audit readiness for SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and other regulatory frameworks applicable to mobility and payments processing by producing evidence of pipeline controls, access management, and change governance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Software Engineering to ensure new services are built with pipeline, observability, and infrastructure templates from day one — not bolted on later.
  • Work with Architecture to align platform direction with the broader technology roadmap, including migrations between legacy and modern platforms.
  • Document runbooks, pipeline standards, and infrastructure patterns so that knowledge is shared across the team.
  • Respond to system issues, participate in high-priority incident calls, and support emergency activities outside of standard hours as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Hands-on experience operating production systems in at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, or on-premises data centers, with an interest in developing depth across a hybrid environment.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms, specifically Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions (or comparable: Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI), including writing and maintaining pipeline-as-code.
  • Working experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef a plus).
  • Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes — EKS, AKS, or self-managed) and container build/registry workflows (Docker, ACR, ECR, Harbor).
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation in one or more of: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Working knowledge of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Azure Monitor / CloudWatch.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and respond to production incidents.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills.

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to help build, operate, and continuously improve the CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure that support our mobility products.   • Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to our DevOps processes and tools.
  • Participate in a team on-call rotation, currently approximately one week every twelve weeks, supporting production reliability and incident response.
  • Leverage AI development tools as force multipliers for software design, implementation, testing, and documentation while maintaining reliability, security, and engineering quality.
  • Contribute to shared engineering standards, documentation, and best practices for AI-first development.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, a related engineering field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, SRE, or cloud operations, with demonstrated ownership of production systems

  • Strong proficiency with Amazon Web Services
  • Strong proficiency with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong proficiency with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform and CloudFormation
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols
  • The ability to communicate and collaborate with team members and other colleagues
  • Active U.S. Government security clearance

Nice To Have

  • Experience with high availability systems and database replication
  • Experience with microservices architectures
  • Success delivering and maintaining complex software systems in production environments
  • Experience automating infrastructure with zero downtime deployments
  • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack
  • Experience with secure cloud operations, least-privilege IAM, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and audit-ready infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting government, regulated, or compliance-driven environments.
  • Certification in relevant technologies (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator)

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0253441

DevOps Platform Engineer

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference? What if you could find a position that is tailor made for your mix of development, engineering, and communication skills? Efficient software development teams make the most of their time by limiting the activities that take developers away from writing their code. That’s why we need an experienced DevSecOps engineer like you to help us shorten the time it takes to get critical tools developed and into the hands of digital citizens and mission workers who need them to drive innovation in the nation.

As a DevSecOps engineer on our team, you’ll use your development experience to streamline our software development lifecycle from requirements to monitoring in production. You’ll incorporate open-source tools, automation, and cloud resources to cut down on tedious, boring tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best: innovate. You’ll implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting. This is an opportunity to build your experience in modern, cloud-native software development.

You’ll work in a dynamic, large team environment supporting a large-scale government program, using next-gen tools, standards, and processes, including Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform, Terragrunt, and Python. In this role, you’ll design and develop DevOps pipelines to drive rapid delivery of functionality using CI/CD tools like GitLab, Jenkins, Ansible, or AWS CodeDeploy. You’ll use state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and monitoring systems to provide analysis on web application errors, including the identification and investigation of application behavior through code and log analysis, and business logic.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, or site reliability engineering role
  • 3+ years of experience deploying containerized applications
  • 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience with Agile methods and practices
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, including Terraform, or Configuration-as-Code, including Ansible
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT Level II or III Certification within 30 days of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with AI, ML, and LLM implementations
  • Experience with AI, ML, and LLM security such as Hidden Layer
  • Experience automating, monitoring, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters in a production environment
  • Experience with GitOps tooling, including Flux or Argo CD, and Kustomize
  • Experience implementing cloud-native solutions to accelerate application development
  • Experience with Identity Authentication and Authorization, including Single-Sign-On, SAML, or OpenID
  • Knowledge of Linux or UNIX administration and automation
  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or AWS Certified Developer - Associate Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

descriptionHtml:
Enlighten, honored as a Top Workplace from USA Today, is a leader in big data solution development and deployment, with expertise in cloud-based services, software and systems engineering, cyber capabilities, and data science. Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.

We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done—while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
  • 10% 401k benefit.
  • Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
  • Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $100,173.00 - $140,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, AWS and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 1-2 days a week) with a great team.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support the development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Assist in automating deployment processes and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to ensure the reliability and rapid scaling of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to seamlessly integrate their applications into the operational infrastructure.
  • Monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, and help resolve them to maintain high availability.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to optimize system performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, constantly exploring innovative ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Top Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of one or more of the following:
    • Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
    • AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
    • Configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
    • Application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Comfortable operating in a terminal-based environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Must have a DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e. Security+) or willing to obtain within 60 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 1-2 days per week at our San Antonio, TX office. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.
Preferred Requirements

  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, Helm, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Experience or familiarity with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.
  • Experience or familiarity with K9s, AWS CLI is a plus.
  • Work could possibly require some on-call work.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

descriptionHtml:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will work on the DevOps team contributing to the software development life-cycle of the Plex family of products. You will report to the Manager, Plex DevOps & Product Security Engineering and work and have a hybrid schedule working at home for a portion of the week and in office for the remainder.

Your Responsibilities

  • Run applications and services built on distributed cloud architectures
  • Build and maintain a robust suite of monitors, alerts, automation and remediation plans for software systems running in a production environment
  • Build and customize Docker images running our applications and services
  • Automate frequent, repetitive tasks
  • Help strengthen our focus on software quality, stability, and availability
  • Help mature our CI/CD pipeline and streamline the workflow with automation

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires 5+ years of relevant experience in software operations / automation
  • Bachelor's in computer science or related area.
  • Experience configuring and monitoring CI/CD tools (examples: Azure Pipelines, Travis CI, GitLab, CircleCI, Bamboo, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Experience configuring and monitoring applications running on a cloud provider (examples: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
  • Familiarity with one or more scripting languages (examples: bash, PowerShell, Chocolatey)
  • Familiarity with at least two different programming languages (examples: Go, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust)
  • Experience configuring and monitoring applications running on Kubernetes
  • Experience with container and cluster technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Flux, Helm, etc.)
  • Experience with pull request-based development methodology (GITHub Enterprise, GITLAB, Azure Repositories, etc.)
  • Familiarity with one or more database technologies (examples: SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB)
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Experience with configuration as code (Terraform, Puppet, Ansible, Azure Arm, AWS Cloud Formation, etc.)
  • Experience with secrets and certificate management software (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, Venafi, AppViewX, etc.)
  • Experience with distributed storage and data systems (e.g. Kafka, Druid, Mongo, Redis)Experience with Azure and other Microsoft technologies
  • Experience with Artifact management technologies (Artifactory, Sonatype, etc.)
  • This position requires access to technical data controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined under 22 C.F.R.
  • 120.62, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, protected individuals (asylees and refugees), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status.

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

Responsibilities

The OUX Infra Engineer owns the infrastructure foundation that the Octave Unified Experience (OUX) platform runs on. This role is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the Kubernetes-based infrastructure, database layer, Microsoft Fabric integration points, and the Refold MCP service that together enable Platform Studio and all OUX shell applications to function reliably at scale, across multi-tenant customer environments. This is a platform infrastructure role with a product engineering sensibility — the infrastructure you build directly determines what developers and customers can do on the platform.

  • Design, deploy, and operate the Kubernetes infrastructure underpinning the OUX platform — cluster configuration, namespace strategy, resource management, autoscaling, and multi-tenancy isolation
  • Own the PostgreSQL database layer for the OUX platform — schema design, provisioning, backup and recovery, performance tuning, and migration strategy for the ontology tool and Platform Studio backend services
  • Build and maintain the Microsoft Fabric integration infrastructure — service principal configuration, workspace provisioning, lakehouse connectivity, and Fabric API authentication patterns for the platform's data pipeline triggers
  • Deploy and operate Refold as the platform's MCP tool configuration service — maintaining the Refold API surface, its integration with the agentic framework, and the infrastructure reliability guarantees the MCP Designer tool depends on
  • Design and implement the tenant provisioning infrastructure — automated onboarding of new customer tenants, namespace isolation, credential management, and per-tenant resource quotas
  • Own infrastructure security posture: network policies, secrets management (Azure Key Vault), certificate lifecycle, and the ingress/reverse proxy layer
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, Terraform, or Helm) and application deployment across environments
  • Instrument the infrastructure layer with observability tooling — metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and cost-per-tenant dashboards feeding the platform's commercial reporting
  • Collaborate with the OUX UI Engineer on security architecture — AuthN/AuthZ integration (Ory, Azure AD), CORS policy, and penetration testing remediation

Education / Qualifications

  • 5+ years in platform or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on production Kubernetes experience (AKS strongly preferred)
  • Strong proficiency with PostgreSQL — schema design, performance tuning, HA configuration, and operational management
  • Hands-on experience with Azure infrastructure services: AKS, Azure Key Vault, Azure Container Registry, Azure Monitor, and Azure networking
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric administration — workspace management, capacity configuration, service principal access, and API-based provisioning
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools (Bicep, Terraform, or Pulumi) and GitOps practices
  • Experience designing and operating multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure — namespace isolation, resource quotas, and tenant lifecycle management
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes security primitives — RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, and secrets management
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable)
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2/OIDC and enterprise identity integration patterns

Preferred:

  • Experience with Refold or comparable MCP service infrastructure
  • Familiarity with Ory (Hydra, Kratos) for identity and access management
  • Background in industrial or capital project software infrastructure environments
  • Experience with FinOps tooling and cost-per-tenant attribution in cloud environments

26WD101941

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the Revit Cloud work sharing team. Our cloud services help architects and engineers collaborate on complex building projects around the world.

You will build and operate reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure across numerous environments and regions, and improve the automation and practices that keep it running. You will work on complex challenges while collaborating closely with engineering, platform, security, and operations partners. Your work will directly support service availability, customer trust, and operational effectiveness.

Responsibilities

Build and Deliver

  • Design, implement, and evolve infrastructure and supporting services across multiple environments and regions
  • Use Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices to deliver secure, maintainable changes and support infrastructure modernization
  • Contribute to technical and architectural decisions, balancing reliability, scalability, security, cost, and delivery needs

Operate and Protect

  • Maintain the availability, performance, and resilience of customer-facing cloud services through monitoring, on-call participation, and incident response
  • Investigate complex production issues, distinguish root causes from symptoms, and implement sustainable fixes
  • Apply secure operational practices and partner with security, Trust, and compliance specialists to meet evolving requirements and minimize customer disruption

Improve and Automate

  • Build automation and repeatable processes that improve operational consistency across many environments and regions
  • Improve observability, runbooks, recovery readiness, operational workflows, and cloud resource efficiency to reduce risk and manual effort
  • Share knowledge, contribute to reviews and retrospectives, and collaborate across teams to improve how services are built and operated

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in DevOps, site reliability, cloud infrastructure, or a related engineering discipline, including hands-on operation of production cloud services
  • Practical experience with AWS, infrastructure automation or Infrastructure as Code, and scripting or programming for operational tasks
  • Working knowledge of software delivery practices, cloud security fundamentals, monitoring, and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • Ability to take ownership of complex work, make informed technical trade-offs, communicate clearly, and work effectively both independently and with others
  • Relevant experience may come from different technical stacks and environments; familiarity with every tool or service is not required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Operating highly available SaaS services or infrastructure deployed across multiple regions
  • Working with tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, Kubernetes, or AWS services including EC2, ECS, RDS, IAM, and CloudWatch
  • Applying SRE practices, improving cloud efficiency, or using AI-assisted tools and reusable agents/workflows to streamline engineering tasks
  • Experience working in agile teams
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams

  • You take responsibility for reliable outcomes, communicate risks early, and seek practical solutions that protect customers
  • You bring curiosity and openness to different perspectives, contribute constructively to decisions, and make space for others to participate
  • You simplify complex operations, learn from incidents, share what you learn, and help teammates and partner teams succeed

Why Join Us?

Revit Cloud Worksharing supports collaboration on complex building projects worldwide. You will help evolve critical cloud services, tackle meaningful distributed-systems challenges, and work with partners who value customer success, collaboration, and continuous improvement. If that work interests you, we encourage you to apply.
