descriptionHtml:
Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.

Section 1: Position Summary

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will provide technical leadership and architectural direction for DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud‑native engineering practices across multiple agile teams. You will partner closely with architects, engineers, security, and infrastructure teams to design scalable, secure, and highly automated delivery platforms that enable teams to ship software faster and more reliably.

This role is ideal for a hands‑on technical leader who enjoys working at both the strategic and tactical levels—setting standards, guiding teams, and occasionally rolling up their sleeves to solve complex engineering problems or lead proofs of concept.

You will also serve as a champion of DevOps and DevSecOps culture, continuously improving developer experience, platform reliability, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Provide architectural oversight and technical direction for DevOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering practices across multiple scrum teams.
  • Partner with Application and Program Architects to align DevOps solutions with business and product strategy.
  • Define and evolve standards for build, deployment, infrastructure, and environment management.
  • Design reusable reference architectures, templates, and patterns for consistent adoption across teams.

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation

  • Lead the design and implementation of automated CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, and deployment workflows.
  • Establish best practices for source control, branching strategies, and release management.
  • Design Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions for provisioning and managing environments.
  • Embed security and compliance controls directly into pipelines (DevSecOps).

Cloud, Containers & Platform Engineering

  • Drive adoption of containerized and cloud‑native architectures using Kubernetes‑based platforms.
  • Ensure platforms meet standards for scalability, resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide teams on service networking, API management, load balancing, and traffic management.
  • Support high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.

Reliability & Production Support

  • Provide Level‑3 support for complex production incidents and reliability challenges.
  • Partner with operations and engineering teams to improve observability, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve system stability and operational maturity.

Mentorship & Culture

  • Mentor and coach engineers on DevOps practices, tools, and architectural decision‑making.
  • Promote a culture of automation, ownership, continuous improvement, and quality.
  • Model strong collaboration, communication, and engineering discipline.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Research emerging tools, technologies, and practices to improve the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Build consensus and introduce cost‑effective solutions that increase delivery speed, quality, and reliability.
  • Continuously optimize DevOps platforms and processes based on measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands‑on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Build & Release, or Engineering Operations roles.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting DevOps architecture in enterprise‑scale production environments.
  • Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery.
  • Hands‑on experience deploying and troubleshooting applications in Linux and Windows environments.
  • Advanced automation and scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.
  • Deep expertise in Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform).
  • Proficiency with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Microservices and cloud‑native architectures
    • Networking, load balancing, caching, and service discovery
    • Security, secrets management, and certificate management
    • High availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS cloud services.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and guide technical direction across teams.

Preferred / Nice To Have

  • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, etc.).
  • Experience with NGINX / NGINX Plus, Consul, and Redis.
  • Exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and reliability metrics.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise platforms (BPM, CRM, Portals, Content Management).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Additional Technical Experience (Nice To Have)

  • Java ecosystem experience (JDK, Spring Boot, Struts)
  • JavaScript frameworks such as Angular, React, or Node.js
  • Experience with monolith, microservices, and event‑driven architectures
  • Experience with Test‑Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing frameworks

Why Join Us

  • Work on large‑scale, mission‑critical systems with real customer impact
  • Influence architecture and DevOps strategy across multiple teams
  • Partner with strong engineering and architecture leadership
  • Be part of a culture that values quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

The national average salary range for this role is $110K-170K in base pay, exclusive of any bonuses and benefits. This base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salary offered will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, performance, and internal pay alignment. We do not anticipate that candidates hired will begin at the top of the range however, from time to time, it may occur on a case-by-case basis.  Other rewards and benefits may include: 401(k) match, Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid-Time-Off, etc.  For more information, please visit careers.ascensus.com/#Benefits.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

Be aware of employment fraud. All email communications from Ascensus or its hiring managers originate from @ascensus.com or @futureplan.com email addresses. We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

  • Proven ability to independently manage priorities and plan effectively across multiple upcoming development cycles (sprints), anticipating future dependencies and resource needs
  • Proven track record building strong stakeholder relationships, with excellent interpersonal and presentation skills to effectively communicate and influence
  • Experience or interest in the following skills is also a plus:
  • Deployment of blockchain nodes (e.g., experience with configuration of Ethereum miners)
  • Application orchestration
  • Service mesh technology (e.g., Istio)
  • Managing IoT devices as part of an Operational Technology system

  • Creative problem solvers who respectfully challenge the status quo in the pursuit of excellence
  • People who lead discussions with curiosity and value diverse perspectives
  • Eager to explore new ideas, understand the power of feedback, and constantly seek opportunities to grow and develop their skills
  • Strong team players who thrive in collaborative environments and celebrate the success of others
Benefits

What can VIA do for you?

VIA offers competitive benefits, flexible work options, and individualized mentoring and growth opportunities. Here are just a few of our VIAneers’ favorite perks:

  • Compensation: 
    • This role offers a salary range of $165,000-$195,000 USD per year
    • 401K plan with up to 5% employer contribution
  • Health: A fully funded, top-tier health benefits plan, including vision and dental coverage, fully covered from day one, for your whole family
  • Family Support: Up to 24 weeks paid parental leave, a 4-week paid ramp-back program, and a $10K family forming benefit (covering fertility treatments, adoption, and surrogacy)

  • Remote work: Ability to enjoy the best of both worlds with flexibility to work from home as needed, as well as access to three well-located offices, designed for collaboration and stocked with everything you could need
    • Opportunities to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 2 months per year

    • A dedicated wellness advisor to help you navigate the programs and opportunities available at VIA
  • Transit: Benefits to support commuting costs
  • Connection: In-person events to foster team bonding and collaboration across different teams

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0249382

DevOps Engineer, Mid

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to use your technical skills to make an impact on national defense? As a DevOps engineer on our team, you will develop testing pipelines, create automatic processes, and oversee multiple systems to support teams performing classified development and analysis. This role is a blend of DevOps, architecture management, and analysis support, offering you multiple avenues for growth with both technical and leadership opportunities. Our multi-disciplinary team of Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) professionals operates in small groups where your contributions matter. We are looking for lifelong learned and motivated, independent thinkers who can contribute to a fast-paced, team environment focused on client delivery. Ultimately, the support you provide will help the acquisition community make informed decisions pertaining to future combat systems, furthering the mission of the Department of War (DoW).

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 1+ years of experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience scripting or automating using Bash and Python in an industry or academic setting
  • Experience with Linux, GitHub, or GitLab
  • Ability to oversee image registries and server-based runners
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field


Nice If You Have:

  • 1+ years of experience in designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • 1+ years of experience with scripting or automating using Bash, Python, or PowerShell
  • 1+ years of experience with Linux and Git, GitHub, or GitLab
  • Experience with container technologies, including Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of radar principles, signal processing, and EW
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming principles
  • Top Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science preferred; or Master’s degree in Computer Science a plus


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. Work Model

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Job Number: R0253971

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

DevOps engineering requires a specific mix of development, engineering, and communication skills. As a DevOps engineer, you know that these skills create efficiency and effectiveness so you can quickly deliver the best solutions for clients. We’re looking for a DevOps engineer like you to help develop critical tools and get them into the hands of those who need them most.

As a DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll help streamline the software development lifecycle, from requirements to monitoring in production. You’ll incorporate open-source tools, automation, and cloud resources to cut down on tedious tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best: create. You’ll work with the team to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting. This is an opportunity to sharpen your skills in the latest automation, infrastructure, and cloud-based development while developing software that will make a mission-forward impact.

Build your experience with the software development lifecycle on a team that works together to make the best software solutions. Work with us as we develop tools to transform the future.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • Experience automating CI/CD pipelines with tools, including Jenkins or GitLab
  • Experience automating infrastructure provisioning with tools such as CloudFormation or Terraform
  • Experience with configuration management tools
  • Experience working with application development teams across the software development lifecycle, and creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative team environment
  • Experience hosting applications on commercial cloud providers, including AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Experience with containerization tools, including Kubernetes or Docker
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python and Linux Shell Script
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT Level II or IAT Level III Certification within 30 days of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Maven, Gradle, or NPM
  • Knowledge of creating and improving continuous automation across multiple technical stacks
  • Knowledge of triaging and resolving issues related to both open-source and commercial tools in public cloud environments


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps Engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges. As an experienced Platform DevOps Engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change.

On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process. You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience with containerization, including building images and orchestrating deployments in Kubernetes
  • 2+ years of experience managing tools deployed with Helm, and with automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef
  • Experience with AWS cloud building and supporting DevOps tools and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Experience developing custom applications and supporting them in a production environment
  • Knowledge of container networking, monitoring, and storage solutions
  • Knowledge of container security technologies, and evaluating and mitigating or resolving vulnerability findings
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of hire date

Job Number: R0253921

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Today’s dynamic technology landscape demands constant and rapid innovation. To facilitate this transformation, we must ensure continuous integration and application development. That’s why we need an experienced DevOps engineer like you who’s eager to design, test, and program critical applications for our clients who need them most.

As a Software Factory DevOps Engineer on our team, you’ll pipeline our software development from requirements to testing in production. You’ll incorporate automation and cloud resources to minimize repetitive tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best—innovate. You’ll work together with fellow professionals to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting.

This is an opportunity to broaden your experience in software engineering while helping to develop software that will completely transform workflows and make a real impact. Here, we invest in technology, and we’ll invest in you. With access to continuing education resources, tuition assistance opportunities, and technology development programs, you’ll keep your skills sharp as you work at the leading edge of technology.

Work with us as we build and test tools to transform the future.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience in the development of tools and processes to drive DevOps or DevSecOps maturity by automating builds, regression testing, monitoring, and pushing releases across environments
  • 2+ years of experience troubleshooting, triaging, and resolving issues for CI/CD pipeline failures or slowness
  • Experience building enterprise cloud-native solutions in Azure, AWS, GCP, or OCI
  • Experience with automation, writing Terraform IaC and Shell scripting
  • Experience working with Agile application development teams across the software development lifecycle, and creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative team environment
  • Experience with DevOps platforms, application level, pipeline build and development, and automation to support build and testing
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of experience in DevOps in lieu of a degree

descriptionHtml:
As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in designing, operating, and improving shared cloud and DevOps platform services used by multiple customer mission teams. This role supports Linux-based environments, AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, and load balancing, containerized services using Docker or Podman, and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or GitLab. This role provides reliable, secure, and reusable platform capabilities while customer teams retain ownership of their application-specific pipelines, releases, and delivery processes.  

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Engineer, administer, automate, and sustain shared platform services that support multiple customer teams.
  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot shared Linux-based cloud and DevOps services used by multiple customer mission teams.
  • Provision, configure, troubleshoot, and optimize AWS infrastructure and services, including EC2, S3, RDS, and Elastic Load Balancing capabilities.
  • Support the operation of containerized services and workloads.
  • Configure, administer, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins and/or GitLab.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts, configuration patterns, deployment procedures, and reusable technical solutions to improve platform reliability and repeatability.
  • Integrate shared platform tooling with source control, artifact repositories, authentication/authorization services, security tooling, monitoring, logging, and ticketing systems as applicable.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Active TS/SCI (with ability to obtain a CI Poly).
  • 4-10+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, platform operations, cloud infrastructure, site reliability, automation, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems in production or mission environments.
  • Experience supporting AWS infrastructure (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Security Groups, and/or Load Balancing).
  • Experience building, running, troubleshooting, and/or supporting containerized workloads (e.g., Docker and/or Podman).
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines from scratch (e.g., GitLab and/or Jenkins).
  • Experience with Git-based source-control workflows.
  • Ability to automate infrastructure and processes using Python and/or Bash.

Role Openings

This role has a few openings that the candidate will be assessed for best placement:

  • Level 1: 4-7 years of experience
  • Level 2: 8-9 years of experience
  • Level 3: 10+ years of experience

SALARY RANGE: $170,000 - $260,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including: 

  • The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
  • The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
  • Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
  • This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:
    • Performance-based bonuses
    • Company-paid training and/or certifications
    • Referral bonuses

Application Deadline:  Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

Additional Compensation: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

Benefits: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Parental Leave and dependent care
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said, we are big fans of our people. That’s why we offer a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We're developing Project Sunrise, a constellation of orbital data centers designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged at an unprecedented scale.

To meet the compressed timeline of this ambitious program, we need to move with exceptional velocity. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be the engine that drives this pace. You will be responsible for building and managing the critical Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure that serves all three of our core software teams: Flight Software, Ground & Operations Software, and the On-Orbit Compute Platform. Your mission is to create a unified, automated, and frictionless path from a developer's keyboard to our test labs and operational environments, enabling rapid, reliable delivery across the entire program.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable CI/CD pipelines for a diverse set of software domains, including embedded flight software and cloud-native ground systems.
  • Own the infrastructure that supports automated testing, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Manage the program's source code repositories, artifact registries, and build environments.
  • Champion infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automation to ensure our development and test infrastructure is repeatable, scalable, and robust.
  • Collaborate with engineers across all software teams to understand their workflows and build the tools and integrations they need to be productive.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of the CI/CD system to ensure fast feedback loops for developers.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on DevOps best practices, guiding teams on how to effectively integrate with the development platform.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Software Engineering role with a focus on infrastructure.
  • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CI/CD for both embedded C/C++ projects and cloud-native services.
  • Deep knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools like Ansible, Terraform, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience managing and integrating test automation frameworks into CI pipelines.
  • Familiarity with artifact management systems (e.g., Artifactory, Nexus).
  • A strong passion for developer experience and a relentless drive to automate everything.

Special Mentions

  • Travel may be required up to 10% of the time.
  • Relocation assistance available.

Base Pay Range For

VA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80 CO applicants is $150,931.00 - $211,303.05 WA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.

Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com.   • Monitor and support all installed systems and infrastructure.

  • Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools.

  • United States Citizenship
  • Level 2: Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of relevant experience; 0 years with a Master's. 4 additional years of experience in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and provisioning technology.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or equivalent DoD 8570 IAT/IAM II certification
  • Administration experience with Linux or related operating systems.
  • Experience in an Agile software development framework

  • Terraform
  • Ansible
  • CloudFormation
  • Azure Bicep/ARM templates
  • Pulumi
  • OpenTufo
  • Kubernetes administration
  • AWS administration
  • Flux
  • Helm
  • DynamoDB
  • NATS configuration
  • Big Bang (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki)
  • Jenkins/GitLab/Bamboo

Secondary Level Salary Range: $118,000.00 - $176,500.00

Description

We are seeking a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer with expertise in cloud-based environments, automation, continuous monitoring, and cybersecurity. The ideal candidate will focus on the creation of the Impact Level 6 environment, operational stability, security, and performance of infrastructure and applications while driving the adoption of modern DevOps practices. This role is critical to support day-to-day system operations in an IL6 environment and ensuring compliance with industry security standards and organizational requirements. The position is located in Huntsville, Al.

The DevOps Engineer will play a central role in creating and maintaining a cloud based IL6 Environment using proven templates created in IL5. Key responsibilities include ensuring critical systems remain resilient, implementing robust security controls, and improving system performance and delivery pipelines for production environments.

Key Focus Areas

  • Environment creation Uplift cloud environment from Impact Level 5 to Impact Level 6. Creation of the AppFac and all supporting tools in impact level 6.
  • System Maintenance and Cybersecurity Manage and secure Linux and Windows systems, addressing vulnerabilities to maintain compliance with cyber risk frameworks.
  • Automation Drive efficiency by designing IaC workflows, automating configurations, and streamlining manual tasks for system maintenance and deployments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuous Monitoring & Troubleshooting
    • Implement tools and processes for the continuous monitoring of infrastructure, pipelines, and applications.
    • Use monitoring and logging platforms to analyze system health and performance, troubleshoot issues, and resolve incidents quickly.
    • Contribute to essential maintenance of the platforms by weekly upgrading and patching of the application factory and its underlying infrastructure.
  • Linux & Windows Maintenance
    • Creation of Cloud Based environment in Impact Level 6
    • Manage, maintain, and troubleshoot both Linux and Windows systems, ensuring peak performance, scalability, and reliability.
    • Perform regular patches, upgrades, and system hardening to address vulnerabilities and improve overall system security.
    • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring compliance with security policies and best practices.
    • Automate configurations for sustainable management at build time of the environment.
  • Infrastructure Automation
    • Uplift and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows for infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using tools like Gitlab, Packer, Terraform, Ansible, bash and python scripts.
    • Perform updates, patches, and cyber review for self-hosted Amazon AMI with focus on automation and hardening of components.
  • DevOps Pipeline Enhancement
    • Creation of Application Factory Pipeline in Impact Level 6 to emulate an existing pipeline in Impact Level 5
    • Collaborate with devops and development teams to ensure uptime and smooth usage of pipelines for application development in Gitlab
    • Perform continuous patching of pipeline tools to ensure cybersecurity standards are maintained.
  • Cybersecurity/Compliance
    • Apply a security-first mindset to all aspects of environment and pipeline management.
    • Conduct vulnerability assessments and remediate risks through patching, configuration, and process improvement.
    • Ensure systems and processes adhere to compliance frameworks, including CIS, NIST, ISO, and DoD regulations for air gapped IL5 environments.
Implement security controls such as Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), secure namespaces, and strong monitoring/auditing pr

Qualifications

Must have at least five years overall experience , with a BS degree

  • Must have a secret clearance but TS is preferred.
  • Must have a Security Plus or any other credential that meets IAT Level 2
  • Must be located in Huntsville, AL
  • Mid-Senior level Engineer that has worked in AWS cloud, Cloud Automation, Kubernetes, and has good troubleshooting abilities.

Target salary range $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

The Opportunity:

As a DevOps engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

descriptionHtml:
Enlighten, honored as a Top Workplace from USA Today, is a leader in big data solution development and deployment, with expertise in cloud-based services, software and systems engineering, cyber capabilities, and data science. Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.

We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done—while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
  • 10% 401k benefit.
  • Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
  • Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $100,173.00 - $130,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 1-2 days a week) with a great team.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Support development and deployment of non-cloud (Edge) infrastructure of on-premise and portable equipment.
  • Automate deployment processes and ensure reliability and scalability of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate their applications into the infrastructure.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and resolve issues as necessary.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, continuously exploring new ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
  • Proficient in configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Experience with application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in multiple programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Must be comfortable in a terminal-based environment.
  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.
  • Must have a DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e. Security+) or willing to obtain within 60 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 1-2 days per week at our San Antonio, TX office. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with big data technologies like: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Experience with K9s, AWS CLI and other AWS services like SNS, SQS and Diode is a plus.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0252586

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Today’s dynamic technology landscape demands constant and rapid innovation. To facilitate this transformation, we must ensure continuous integration and application development. That’s why we need an experienced DevOps engineer like you who’s eager to design, test, and program critical applications for our clients who need them most.

As a Software Factory DevOps Engineer on our team, you’ll pipeline our software development from requirements to testing in production. You’ll incorporate automation and cloud resources to minimize repetitive tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best—innovate. You’ll work together with fellow professionals to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting.

This is an opportunity to broaden your experience in software engineering while helping to develop software that will completely transform workflows and make a real impact. Here, we invest in technology, and we’ll invest in you. With access to continuing education resources, tuition assistance opportunities, and technology development programs, you’ll keep your skills sharp as you work at the leading edge of technology.

Work with us as we build and test tools to transform the future.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in the development of tools and processes to drive DevOps or DevSecOps maturity by automating builds, regression testing, monitoring, and pushing releases across environments
  • 3+ years of experience troubleshooting, triaging, and resolving issues for CI/CD pipeline failures or slowness
  • Experience building enterprise cloud-native solutions such as Azure, AWS, GCP, or OCI
  • Experience with automation, writing Terraform IaC and Shell scripting
  • Experience working with Agile application development teams across the software development lifecycle and creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative team environment
  • Experience with DevOps platforms, application level, pipeline build and development, and automation to support build and testing
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree or 8+ years of experience in DevOps in lieu of a degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience developing enterprise cloud-native solutions involving Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD
  • Knowledge of creating and improving continuous automation across multiple cloud service providers and technical stacks
  • Knowledge of triaging and resolving issues related to both open-source and commercial tools in government cloud environments
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Linux Shell Script, PowerShell, and Python
  • Secret clearance
  • Master’s degree
  • Security+ Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos, we offer competitive benefits, including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more. Join us and make a difference in National Security!

Job Summary

This DevOps Engineer role provides mission critical system support to our customer. You will closely work with the Development team as well as other technology stakeholders to maintain, develop and support IC enterprise products – legacy and new products – in an Agile SAFe environment. The role will also work collaboratively with software engineering to deploy and operate systems. Additionally, this role will help automate and streamline operations and processes; as well as build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring and operations, and troubleshoot and resolve issues in dev, test, and production environments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Supports software deployments, cloud infrastructure baselines, and operational availability of production systems.
  • Managing, building, configuring, administering, operating and maintaining all components that comprise the DevOps environment.
  • Defining enterprise Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment processes and best practices
  • Codifying DevOps best practices across the enterprise
  • Developing and maintaining scripts to automate tool deployment to an AWS cloud environment and other tasks.
  • Scripting and maintaining build environments.
  • Working with project teams to integrate their products into the DevOps environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience setting up one or more of the following tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Katalon Studio.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting issues with two or more of the following tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Katalon Studio.
  • Demonstrated experience working within a software development team and supporting developers and developer activities.
  • Bachelors degree with 8 or more years of prior relevant work experience or Masters with 6 or more years of prior relevant work experience. Will consider additional work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • To be considered must have an active TS/SCI with polygraph security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Associate Certification (Developer, Solution Architect, or Sys Ops Administrator)
  • AWS Professional Certification (DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect)
  • Demonstrated experience in container orchestration using Docker, Vagrant, Kubernetes, or AWS ECS/ECR
  • Demonstrated experience with Languages including Java, Python, JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, and Unix shell Scripting
  • Demonstrated experience with Ansible, or Puppet.

DevOps Platform Engineer

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference? What if you could find a position that is tailor made for your mix of development, engineering, and communication skills? Efficient software development teams make the most of their time by limiting the activities that take developers away from writing their code. That’s why we need an experienced DevSecOps engineer like you to help us shorten the time it takes to get critical tools developed and into the hands of digital citizens and mission workers who need them to drive innovation in the nation.

As a DevSecOps engineer on our team, you’ll use your development experience to streamline our software development lifecycle from requirements to monitoring in production. You’ll incorporate open-source tools, automation, and cloud resources to cut down on tedious, boring tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best: innovate. You’ll implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting. This is an opportunity to build your experience in modern, cloud-native software development.

You’ll work in a dynamic, large team environment supporting a large-scale government program, using next-gen tools, standards, and processes, including Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform, Terragrunt, and Python. In this role, you’ll design and develop DevOps pipelines to drive rapid delivery of functionality using CI/CD tools like GitLab, Jenkins, Ansible, or AWS CodeDeploy. You’ll use state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and monitoring systems to provide analysis on web application errors, including the identification and investigation of application behavior through code and log analysis, and business logic.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, or site reliability engineering role
  • 3+ years of experience deploying containerized applications
  • 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience with Agile methods and practices
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, including Terraform, or Configuration-as-Code, including Ansible
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT Level II or III Certification within 30 days of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with AI, ML, and LLM implementations
  • Experience with AI, ML, and LLM security such as Hidden Layer
  • Experience automating, monitoring, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters in a production environment
  • Experience with GitOps tooling, including Flux or Argo CD, and Kustomize
  • Experience implementing cloud-native solutions to accelerate application development
  • Experience with Identity Authentication and Authorization, including Single-Sign-On, SAML, or OpenID
  • Knowledge of Linux or UNIX administration and automation
  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or AWS Certified Developer - Associate Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.
  • Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We're developing Project Sunrise, a constellation of orbital data centers designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged at an unprecedented scale.

To meet the compressed timeline of this ambitious program, we need to move with exceptional velocity. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be the engine that drives this pace. You will be responsible for building and managing the critical Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure that serves all three of our core software teams: Flight Software, Ground & Operations Software, and the On-Orbit Compute Platform. Your mission is to create a unified, automated, and frictionless path from a developer's keyboard to our test labs and operational environments, enabling rapid, reliable delivery across the entire program.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable CI/CD pipelines for a diverse set of software domains, including embedded flight software and cloud-native ground systems.
  • Own the infrastructure that supports automated testing, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Manage the program's source code repositories, artifact registries, and build environments.
  • Champion infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automation to ensure our development and test infrastructure is repeatable, scalable, and robust.
  • Collaborate with engineers across all software teams to understand their workflows and build the tools and integrations they need to be productive.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of the CI/CD system to ensure fast feedback loops for developers.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on DevOps best practices, guiding teams on how to effectively integrate with the development platform.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Software Engineering role with a focus on infrastructure.
  • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CI/CD for both embedded C/C++ projects and cloud-native services.
  • Deep knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools like Ansible, Terraform, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience managing and integrating test automation frameworks into CI pipelines.
  • Familiarity with artifact management systems (e.g., Artifactory, Nexus).
  • A strong passion for developer experience and a relentless drive to automate everything.

Special Mentions

  • Travel may be required up to 10% of the time.
  • Relocation assistance available.

Base Pay Range For

VA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80 CO applicants is $150,931.00 - $211,303.05 WA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

descriptionHtml:
Enlighten, honored as a Top Workplace from USA Today, is a leader in big data solution development and deployment, with expertise in cloud-based services, software and systems engineering, cyber capabilities, and data science. Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.

We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done—while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
  • 10% 401k benefit.
  • Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
  • Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $100,173.00 - $130,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 2-3 days a week) with a great team.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Automate deployment processes and implement CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliability and rapid scaling of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to seamlessly integrate their applications into the operational infrastructure.
  • Monitor production systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve them rapidly to maintain high availability.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to optimize system performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, constantly exploring innovative ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge with one or more of the following:
    • Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
    • AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
    • Configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
    • Application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Comfortable operating in a terminal-based environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Must have or be able to obtain DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e., Security+) within 30 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 2-3 days per week at our San Antonio, TX office or on customer site as needed. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.
Preferred Requirements

  • Currently holds an active Top Secret security clearance and is willing/able to obtain an SCI read-in.
  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, Helm, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Experience with K9s, AWS CLI, AWS SNS, AWS SQS, and AWS Diode.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.
