Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.

  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.
  • Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. 40

$106,900 - $147,000 per year

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We're developing Project Sunrise, a constellation of orbital data centers designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged at an unprecedented scale.

To meet the compressed timeline of this ambitious program, we need to move with exceptional velocity. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be the engine that drives this pace. You will be responsible for building and managing the critical Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure that serves all three of our core software teams: Flight Software, Ground & Operations Software, and the On-Orbit Compute Platform. Your mission is to create a unified, automated, and frictionless path from a developer's keyboard to our test labs and operational environments, enabling rapid, reliable delivery across the entire program.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable CI/CD pipelines for a diverse set of software domains, including embedded flight software and cloud-native ground systems.
  • Own the infrastructure that supports automated testing, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Manage the program's source code repositories, artifact registries, and build environments.
  • Champion infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automation to ensure our development and test infrastructure is repeatable, scalable, and robust.
  • Collaborate with engineers across all software teams to understand their workflows and build the tools and integrations they need to be productive.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of the CI/CD system to ensure fast feedback loops for developers.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on DevOps best practices, guiding teams on how to effectively integrate with the development platform.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Software Engineering role with a focus on infrastructure.
  • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CI/CD for both embedded C/C++ projects and cloud-native services.
  • Deep knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools like Ansible, Terraform, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience managing and integrating test automation frameworks into CI pipelines.
  • Familiarity with artifact management systems (e.g., Artifactory, Nexus).
  • A strong passion for developer experience and a relentless drive to automate everything.

Special Mentions

  • Travel may be required up to 10% of the time.
  • Relocation assistance available.

Base Pay Range For

VA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80 CO applicants is $150,931.00 - $211,303.05 WA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0247215

DevOps Engineer, Senior

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a senior platform DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience working with deploying cloud resources on AWS
  • Experience with containerization, building images, and orchestrating deployments on Kubernetes
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code deployments
  • Knowledge of container networking, monitoring, and storage solutions
  • Knowledge of container security technologies, and evaluating and mitigating or resolving vulnerability findings
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, CISSP, or GSEC Certification within 4 months of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience with Kubernetes deployment orchestration tools such as ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience developing in Java or Python
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana or Elasticsearch, Kibana, and FluentD
  • Experience with the design, deployment, and management of cloud environments, including AWS or Azure
  • Experience using or migrating CI/CD pipeline solutions or tools, including Jenkins, Git, or TeamCity
  • Experience with system integration using a variety of protocols, including JSON, REST, and XML
  • Experience with scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby, and leveraging JSON, YAML, or XML for configuration
  • Knowledge of Linux or UNIX administration and automation
  • Knowledge of foundational system administration principles
  • Kubernetes Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Requisition Number: 31181

Required Travel: 0 - 10%

Employment Type: Full Time/Salaried/Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $96,951.00 - $138,502.00

Security Clearance: Ability to Obtain

Level of Experience: Mid

This opportunity resides with Uncrewed Systems (UxS), a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. Uncrewed Systems comprises unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs), unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) and autonomy software.

HII creates advanced unmanned solutions for defense, marine research and commercial applications. Serving customers in more than 30 countries, HII provides design, autonomy, manufacturing, testing, operations and sustainment of unmanned systems, including unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) and unmanned surface vessels (USVs).

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Come join HII!! Where hard stuff is done right!

In this role, you will bridge the gap between software development and production to ensure smooth, efficient, and reliable software delivery. You will automate workflows, manage infrastructure, and build CI/CD pipelines to accelerate development and deployment. By integrating tools, implementing monitoring systems, and fostering collaboration across teams, you will help the organization deliver high-quality software more quickly and with greater stability.

You will also establish and maintain tools that support release testing, including the integration and execution of automated unit, regression, and simulation tests. In addition, you will lead the software release process by guiding release approvals through the change control board and establishing standards for release packaging and deployment.

What You Will Be Doing.

The DevOps Engineer will collaborate with stakeholders to establish key processes and coordinate status, configuration management, and release of all Unmanned Systems-related software and tools for the software engineering group.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the building, releasing, and software configuration of the Unmanned Systems Group software
  • Responsible for planning, implementing, and maintaining Software Configuration Management, DevOps, and SecDevOps concepts, processes, and systems
  • Coordinate with the DevOps Lead to design, implement and maintain SCM, DevOps infrastructure and processes. Covers areas such as software builds, deployment, containerization, process automation, Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) orchestration, environment management, release procedures, and system administration
  • Provide strategic and architectural guidance to create organization-wide DevOps best practices
  • Applies knowledge of DevOps/SCM tools such as Gitlab, BlackDuck, Coverity, Jira, Confluence, Docker/Podman, virtualization tools and Python
  • Experience with Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) package management
  • Ensure software artifact integrity throughout release and deployment processes using JFrog Artifactory
  • Apply expertise to other parts of the business were appropriate. Work with internal groups and Business information systems (BIS) to find solutions to problems and make recommendations
  • Ensure processes, builds, releases, and infrastructure meet requirements for CMMI, QA, compliance, security, best practices, and business needs

What We Are Looking For..

  • 5 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; 0 years experience with PhD or Juris Doctorate in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a government clearance

Bonus points for..

  • Experience with underwater vehicles

Physical Requirements

Adequate visual acuity and manual dexterity for meeting the requirements Software Engineer family.

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

HII is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to build a new future. We offer competitive benefits such as best-in-class medical, dental and vision plan choices; wellness resources; employee assistance programs; Savings Plan Options (401(k)); financial planning tools, life insurance; employee discounts; paid holidays and paid time off; tuition reimbursement; as well as early childhood and post-secondary education scholarships. Bonus/other non-recurrent compensation is occasionally offered for qualified positions, and if applicable to this role will be addressed by the recruiter at the screening phase of application.

Why HII

We build the world’s most powerful, survivable naval ships and defense technology solutions that safeguard our seas, sky, land, space and cyber. Our workforce includes skilled tradespeople; artificial intelligence, machine learning (AI/ML) experts; engineers; technologists; scientists; logistics experts; and business administration professionals.

Recognized as one of America’s top large company employers, we are a values and ethics driven organization that puts people’s safety and well-being first. Regardless of your role or where you serve, at HII, you’ll find a supportive and welcoming environment, competitive benefits, and valuable educational and training programs for continual career growth at every stage of your career.

Together we are working to ensure a future where everyone can be free and thrive.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

Do You Need Assistance?

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to buildyourcareer@hii-co.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Reasonable accommodations are considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. Additionally, you may also call 1-844-849-8463 for assistance. Press #3 for HII Mission Technologies.

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Today’s dynamic technology landscape demands constant and rapid innovation. To facilitate this transformation, we must ensure continuous integration and application development. That’s why we need an experienced DevOps engineer like you who’s eager to design, test, and program critical applications for our clients who need them most.

As a Software Factory DevOps Engineer on our team, you’ll pipeline our software development from requirements to testing in production. You’ll incorporate automation and cloud resources to minimize repetitive tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best—innovate. You’ll work together with fellow professionals to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting.

This is an opportunity to broaden your experience in software engineering while helping to develop software that will completely transform workflows and make a real impact. Here, we invest in technology, and we’ll invest in you. With access to continuing education resources, tuition assistance opportunities, and technology development programs, you’ll keep your skills sharp as you work at the leading edge of technology.

Work with us as we build and test tools to transform the future.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

  • 5+ years of experience in the development of tools and processes to drive DevOps or DevSecOps maturity by automating builds, regression testing, monitoring, and pushing releases across environments

  • Experience building enterprise cloud-native solutions such as Azure, AWS, GCP, or OCI

  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Linux Shell Script, PowerShell, and Python

Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.
  • Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. $106,900 - $147,000 per year

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Humana is looking for a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer to design, implement, and support secure, compliant cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and GCP. You will ensure enterprise-scale software delivery through modern CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platforms, GitOps practices, automation, and developer self-service capabilities.

The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation), with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runners, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure platform services across the organization. You will also partner with cybersecurity teams to support application security projects, VIT/CVIT remediation, secret management, and emerging software supply chain security capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure.
  • Implement software supply chain security, artifact governance, dependency governance, vulnerability management, and secure software delivery practices across enterprise CI/CD ecosystems.
  • Provide dedicated expertise for emerging software supply chain security capabilities, including JFrog Curation and related governance controls.
  • Support application security initiatives, VIT/CVIT remediation efforts, secret remediation requirements, and enterprise compliance mandates.
  • Maintain security controls across Azure DevOps, GitHub, Build Agents, and GitHub Runner platforms that support enterprise software delivery.
  • Partner with security organizations to rapidly assess, prioritize, and remediate newly identified vulnerabilities impacting developer platforms and CI/CD services.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Lead platform modernization initiatives while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and operational stability are maintained.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, secret management, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting application security programs, VIT/CVIT remediation efforts, and enterprise compliance initiatives.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with managing, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement projects.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps maturity models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, compliance controls, and software supply chain security capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with software supply chain security governance frameworks, SBOM management, and dependency governance.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

40

Job Number: R0253018

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a DevOps engineer, you know how to set up cloud environments and provision computer networking, storage, and virtual networks—ultimately, how to “harness the cloud.” We’re looking for a DevOps infrastructure engineer like you to support our clients as they modernize their IT infrastructures and meet their most challenging missions.

As a DevOps infrastructure engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll work closely with cloud architects and engineers to manage server configuration for modern cloud solutions. This role entails the design, development, implementation, integration, and sustainment of our compute, network, and storage infrastructure. The position also focuses on platform modernization by incorporating emerging technologies to optimize performance and efficiency. Utilizing DevOps/DevSecOps methodologies, tools, and automation, the role is critical in streamlining processes, enhancing collaboration, and accelerating software release cycles.   • Platform Development and Optimization: Contribute to the architecture, design, integration, and support of platform and infrastructure environments across build, integration & test, and production stages. Focus on ensuring these environments are optimized for performance, reliability, and scalability within cloud-based ecosystems
  • Best Practices and Automation: Utilize industry and company best practices to enhance scalability, consistency, and infrastructure efficiency, while reducing deployment time and automating configuration management processes

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

As a member of a small, cross-functional team responsible for lunar network, IT, and communications infrastructure, you'll play a leading role in designing, automating, and sustaining the integration and mission operations environments for Blue Origin's lunar landers. This is a technically deep position focused on building robust CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code solutions, and DevOps practices that enable hardware-in-the-loop integration and reliable mission operations. You will drive collaboration across network engineers, system administrators, software developers, and multi-discipline teams to establish standards, define scalable processes, and ensure the infrastructure underpinning lunar lander development and operations meets the highest levels of reliability and performance.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate DevOps practices into the software development lifecycle seamlessly.

  • 7+ years professional experience minimum.
  • Experience with Linux, Docker, Continuous Integration and Delivery
  • Experience developing and owning CI/CD pipelines that deliver high quality work to customers continuously.
  • Experience improving stability through monitoring, analysis, thoughtful code reviews, and detailed feedback.
  • AWS knowledge - VPC, EC2, and EKS at a minimum
  • Experience implementing “infrastructure as code” and technologies used to achieve this (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Knowledge of software defined networking (VPC, Subnets, Firewalls, VPNs, etc.)
  • Experience deploying and managing of containerization technologies (such as Docker) and orchestration platforms (such as Kubernetes)
  • Experience with security practices within CI/CD pipelines, including secrets management, role-based access control (RBAC), and vulnerability scanning of container images and dependencies.
  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with GitLab
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Proven understanding of source control tools and concepts such as git workflows, versioning, branching.
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong experience in leading complex DevOps projects from inception to completion, involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Practical experience with deploying and managing application security measures in a cloud environment, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity standards.
  • Experience in engaging with end-users and stakeholders to gather requirements and feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to rapidly changing environments and new technologies quickly.
  • Experience with scripted and compiled languages such as C/C++.
  • Experience with unit testing and test-driven development.
  • Experience using configuration as code tools to manage physical workstations (Ansible, etc.)
  • Experience with Agile methodologies
  • Aerospace Industry experience with safety critical software and/or tools qualification activities
  • Experience with software assurance standards (e.g., DO-178C, NPR 7150.2D)
  • Familiarity with NIST 800-53 security controls and experience implementing or auditing systems against its requirements in a cloud or on-premises environment.

The DevOps Engineer designs and implements a fully automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) ecosystem, Internal Developer Portal (IDP), and secure cloud networking across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. The role also contributes to scalable cloud network architecture, self-service tooling, network-aware CI/CD pipelines, and integrated developer platform capabilities that standardize software delivery across the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities, as They Align to Ryan’s Key Results

Key Responsibilities

People

  • Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency.
  • Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices.

Client

Internal Developer Portal (IDP)

  • Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows.
  • Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load.
  • Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms.
  • Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata.
  • Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements.

Value

Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications.
  • Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines.
  • Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices.
  • Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability.

Cloud and Infrastructure Automation

  • Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy-as-code.
  • Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.

DevOps and Platform Best Practices

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation.
  • Six or more years of hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.

Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We're developing Project Sunrise, a constellation of orbital data centers designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged at an unprecedented scale.

To meet the compressed timeline of this ambitious program, we need to move with exceptional velocity. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be the engine that drives this pace. You will be responsible for building and managing the critical Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure that serves all three of our core software teams: Flight Software, Ground & Operations Software, and the On-Orbit Compute Platform. Your mission is to create a unified, automated, and frictionless path from a developer's keyboard to our test labs and operational environments, enabling rapid, reliable delivery across the entire program.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable CI/CD pipelines for a diverse set of software domains, including embedded flight software and cloud-native ground systems.
  • Own the infrastructure that supports automated testing, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Manage the program's source code repositories, artifact registries, and build environments.
  • Champion infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automation to ensure our development and test infrastructure is repeatable, scalable, and robust.
  • Collaborate with engineers across all software teams to understand their workflows and build the tools and integrations they need to be productive.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of the CI/CD system to ensure fast feedback loops for developers.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on DevOps best practices, guiding teams on how to effectively integrate with the development platform.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Software Engineering role with a focus on infrastructure.
  • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CI/CD for both embedded C/C++ projects and cloud-native services.
  • Deep knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools like Ansible, Terraform, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience managing and integrating test automation frameworks into CI pipelines.
  • Familiarity with artifact management systems (e.g., Artifactory, Nexus).
  • A strong passion for developer experience and a relentless drive to automate everything.

Special Mentions

  • Travel may be required up to 10% of the time.
  • Relocation assistance available.

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. Job Number: R0251296

DevOps Engineer, Mid

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps Engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a platform DevOps Engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience with AWS Cloud building and supporting DevOps tools and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • 3+ years of experience with containerization, building images, and orchestrating deployments in Kubernetes or EKS
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code environments, including automated server or network configurations, large-scale software deployments, or monitoring and testing
  • 2+ years of experience developing custom applications and supporting them in a production environment
  • Experience supporting an agile environment
  • Knowledge of container networking, monitoring, and storage solutions
  • Knowledge of container security technologies and evaluating, mitigating, or resolving vulnerability findings
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with identifying and implementing automation to improve user experience
  • Experience with scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby
  • Experience with system integration using a variety of protocols, including JSON, REST, and XML
  • Experience with leveraging JSON, YAML, or XML for configuration
  • Experience with the OWASP Software Assurance Maturity Model or DevSecOps Maturity Model
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Cloud Certification, including AWS, Certified Solutions Architect Associate Certification, Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect, or MCSE Cloud Platform and Infrastructure Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos, we offer competitive benefits, including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more. Join us and make a difference in National Security!

Job Summary

This DevOps Engineer role provides mission critical system support to our customer. You will closely work with the Development team as well as other technology stakeholders to maintain, develop and support IC enterprise products – legacy and new products – in an Agile SAFe environment. The role will also work collaboratively with software engineering to deploy and operate systems. Additionally, this role will help automate and streamline operations and processes; as well as build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring and operations, and troubleshoot and resolve issues in dev, test, and production environments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Supports software deployments, cloud infrastructure baselines, and operational availability of production systems.
  • Managing, building, configuring, administering, operating and maintaining all components that comprise the DevOps environment.
  • Defining enterprise Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment processes and best practices
  • Codifying DevOps best practices across the enterprise
  • Developing and maintaining scripts to automate tool deployment to an AWS cloud environment and other tasks.
  • Scripting and maintaining build environments.
  • Working with project teams to integrate their products into the DevOps environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience setting up one or more of the following tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Katalon Studio.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting issues with two or more of the following tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Katalon Studio.
  • Demonstrated experience working within a software development team and supporting developers and developer activities.
  • Masters with 15 or more years of prior relevant work experience. Will consider additional work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • To be considered must have an active TS/SCI with polygraph security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in science, technical, or engineering discipline.
  • AWS Associate Certification (Developer, Solution Architect, or Sys Ops Administrator)
  • AWS Professional Certification (DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect)
  • Demonstrated experience in container orchestration using Docker, Vagrant, Kubernetes, or AWS ECS/ECR
  • Demonstrated experience with Languages including Java, Python, JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, and Unix shell Scripting
  • Demonstrated experience with Ansible, or Puppet.

Description

Leidos is looking for our next TS/SCI-cleared DevOps Software Engineer to join a high-energy team building and deploying a cutting-edge technology stack in support of the DIA-NDOC (National Digital Exploitation OSINT Center) DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP). This role is part of a 10-year program supporting the DOMEX Data Discovery Platform (D3P) Modernization effort, where you’ll contribute to mission-critical capabilities alongside a collaborative, innovative, and growth-oriented team.

While the majority of work is performed on-site at our customer location in Bethesda, MD, we offer a flexible schedule and occasional opportunities for remote work.

As a DevOps Software Engineer, you’ll design, maintain, secure, and improve automated software build, test, artifact, and deployment pipelines to enable product teams to deliver software reliably through standardized, repeatable, and observable DevSecOps workflows.

You will work with a multidisciplinary group of developers, integrators, and system administrators to:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, security scanning, packaging, promotion, deployment, and release activities.
  • Implement standardized pipeline templates, reusable automation, and self-service delivery capabilities for product development teams.
  • Integrate automated unit testing, code-quality analysis, dependency scanning, container-image scanning, infrastructure/configuration validation, and other DevSecOps controls into CI/CD workflows.
  • Use Helm to configure Kubernetes deployments for new features and evolving requirements.
  • Manage and support source-control integration, branching strategies, build triggers, artifact repositories, container registries, versioning, and release-promotion processes.
  • Support GitOps, infrastructure-as-code, configuration-as-code, and automated environment provisioning practices.
  • Troubleshoot failed builds, pipeline errors, deployment failures, artifact issues, configuration drift, and CI/CD tool integration problems.
  • Monitor CI/CD pipeline health, performance, reliability, throughput, and failure trends; identify and implement improvements.
  • Provide support to the Platform Team for platform-related activities, such as deployment troubleshooting, Kubernetes configuration support, Elastic integration, observability, and automation.
  • Participate in Agile release planning, scrums, design sessions, bug triage, and related team activities.

To be successful in this role you need the following (required qualifications):

Qualifications

You’re enthusiastic, collaborative, and comfortable working with teammates across a range of technical backgrounds. You also meet the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Sciences, Systems Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years of relevant experience; 6+ years with a Master’s.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to obtain/maintain a TS/SCI with CI Polygraph.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for production software systems using platforms, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or equivalent.
  • Experience with source control and collaborative development workflows using Git, including branching, merge requests/pull requests, tagging, release branches, and code review processes.
  • Experience building and managing containerized applications using Docker or comparable container technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes deployment concepts, including manifests, secrets, namespaces, and Helm, or comparable tooling.
  • Experience with artifact repositories and container registries, such as Nexus, Artifactory, Harbor, GitLab Registry, or equivalent.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, static code analysis, dependency scanning, software composition analysis, container-image scanning, or security gates into delivery pipelines.
  • Experience developing automation using scripting or programming languages such as Bash, Python, PowerShell, Go, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, or deployment templating tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, or equivalent.
  • Ability to troubleshoot across application build, testing, packaging, containerization, deployment, networking, configuration, and environment layers.

You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:

  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes administration and operations.
  • Troubleshooting pod failures, networking issues, image pulls, scheduling constraints, and application connectivity
  • Experience supporting or administering at least one shared data or application platform service, such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, API gateways, or similar distributed services
  • Familiarity with infrastructure and platform automation tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Bash, Python, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of platform security practices
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools and practices
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Development experience (Bash, PowerShell, SALT, Python, Groovy, Java, etc.)

Leidos is looking for our next TS/SCI-cleared DevOps Software Engineer to join a high-energy team building and deploying a cutting-edge technology stack in support of the DIA-NDOC (National Digital Exploitation OSINT Center) DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP). This role is part of a 10-year program supporting the DOMEX Data Discovery Platform (D3P) Modernization effort, where you’ll contribute to mission-critical capabilities alongside a collaborative, innovative, and growth-oriented team.

While the majority of work is performed on-site at our customer location in Bethesda, MD, we offer a flexible schedule and occasional opportunities for remote work.

As a DevOps Software Engineer, you’ll design, maintain, secure, and improve automated software build, test, artifact, and deployment pipelines to enable product teams to deliver software reliably through standardized, repeatable, and observable DevSecOps workflows.

You will work with a multidisciplinary group of developers, integrators, and system administrators to:



- Design, develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, security scanning, packaging, promotion, deployment, and release activities.
- Implement standardized pipeline templates, reusable automation, and self-service delivery capabilities for product development teams.
- Integrate automated unit testing, code-quality analysis, dependency scanning, container-image scanning, infrastructure/configuration validation, and other DevSecOps controls into CI/CD workflows.
- Use Helm to configure Kubernetes deployments for new features and evolving requirements.
- Manage and support source-control integration, branching strategies, build triggers, artifact repositories, container registries, versioning, and release-promotion processes.
- Support GitOps, infrastructure-as-code, configuration-as-code, and automated environment provisioning practices.
- Troubleshoot failed builds, pipeline errors, deployment failures, artifact issues, configuration drift, and CI/CD tool integration problems.
- Monitor CI/CD pipeline health, performance, reliability, throughput, and failure trends; identify and implement improvements.
- Provide support to the Platform Team for platform-related activities, such as deployment troubleshooting, Kubernetes configuration support, Elastic integration, observability, and automation.
- Participate in Agile release planning, scrums, design sessions, bug triage, and related team activities.

To be successful in this role you need the following (required qualifications):

Qualifications

You’re enthusiastic, collaborative, and comfortable working with teammates across a range of technical backgrounds. You also meet the following qualifications:



- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Sciences, Systems Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years of relevant experience; 6+ years with a Master’s.
- Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to obtain/maintain a TS/SCI with CI Polygraph.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for production software systems using platforms, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or equivalent.
- Experience with source control and collaborative development workflows using Git, including branching, merge requests/pull requests, tagging, release branches, and code review processes.
- Experience building and managing containerized applications using Docker or comparable container technologies.
- Working knowledge of Kubernetes deployment concepts, including manifests, secrets, namespaces, and Helm, or comparable tooling.
- Experience with artifact repositories and container registries, such as Nexus, Artifactory, Harbor, GitLab Registry, or equivalent.
- Experience integrating automated testing, static code analysis, dependency scanning, software composition analysis, container-image scanning, or security gates into delivery pipelines.
- Experience developing automation using scripting or programming languages such as Bash, Python, PowerShell, Go, or equivalent.
- Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, or deployment templating tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, or equivalent.
- Ability to troubleshoot across application build, testing, packaging, containerization, deployment, networking, configuration, and environment layers.

You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:



- Knowledge of Agile methodologies
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes administration and operations.
- Troubleshooting pod failures, networking issues, image pulls, scheduling constraints, and application connectivity
- Experience supporting or administering at least one shared data or application platform service, such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, API gateways, or similar distributed services
- Familiarity with infrastructure and platform automation tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Bash, Python, or equivalent
- Working knowledge of platform security practices
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools and practices
- Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation.
- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
- Development experience (Bash, PowerShell, SALT, Python, Groovy, Java, etc.)
