Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems, Multi-Domain Operations, and Missile Defense Integration Business Unit (BU) has an exciting career opportunity for a Principal DevOps Engineer – Level 3 or a Sr. Principal DevOps Engineer – Level 4 to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. Our domain provides rewarding work that contributes to the latest advancements being made in the industry. The position is located on-site at Schriever Space Force Base in Colorado Springs, CO.

Position Overview

As a DevOps Engineer – Level 3 or 4, you will plan and evolve processes and infrastructure that support rapid maturation and deployment of capabilities while sustaining a stable security posture and incorporating ongoing stakeholder feedback. You will work in lab and development environments composed of virtual, containerized, and bare-metal systems, focusing on build and deployment workflows, automation, and robust operating system practices.

You will integrate development pipelines leveraging automation with test-driven development tools and continuous integration/test frameworks. You will implement provisioning and deployment techniques via packaging, automation scripts, or manual distribution. You will function with agile principles to execute efficiently in an environment of continuous feedback. In this role, you will collaborate closely with software developers, production operations, and other engineering teams to support build environments, development workflows, and OS-related issues, while enabling quick and efficient software development and delivery using tools like Kubernetes, SonarQube, Podman, and related DevOps toolchains.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and maintain build, integration, test, and deployment environments to enable rapid, reliable software delivery while ensuring security and stability.
  • Implement and support repeatable, scalable provisioning and deployment techniques (e.g., packaging, componentization, containerization, and cloud-based distribution) with effective configuration management, versioning, and traceability.
  • Monitor and improve software quality by implementing code quality and coverage metrics, integrating automated test suites, and enforcing quality controls across environments.
  • Collaborate closely with development, production operations, and other engineering teams to optimize workflows, resolve environment issues, and communicate/prioritize planned and unplanned work to minimize disruption.
  • Administer and support containerized, virtualized, and lab environments (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift, Podman, Docker), including rapid incident response, patching, system checkout, and restoration of critical services.
  • Perform system administration and hardware support duties, including troubleshooting OS, network, and hardware problems; coordinating repair or replacement; and documenting configurations, procedures, changes, and infrastructure inventories.

Seeking candidates who find satisfaction in working on challenging and diverse assignments in collaborative settings across all levels.

This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on qualifications listed below.

This requisition may be filled at either a Principal DevOps Engineer – Level 3 or a Sr. Principal DevOps Engineer – Level 4.

Basic Qualifications – Principal DevOps Engineer – Level 3

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline preferred from an accredited university and 5 years of related work experience, or a Master’s Degree in STEM and 3 years of related work experience, or 1 year of related work experience with a PhD in STEM. A high school diploma and 9 years of related work experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
  • Applicants must have a current, active in-scope U.S. Government issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
  • Ability and flexibility to work alternate shifts if required to support business needs.
  • Ability and willingness to travel 10% to support business needs
  • Strong understanding of Linux-based environments (Red Hat or similar enterprise distributions) in lab, development, or production settings, particularly as they relate to build, integration, and deployment workflows
  • Experience with scripting (e.g., Bash, Python, or similar) to automate configuration, deployment, and maintenance tasks
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and configuration automation (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, or similar)
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with engineers and technical leads on schedule-driven programs, including adherence to lockdown windows and configuration baselines

Basic Qualifications – Sr. Principal DevOps Engineer – Level 4

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline preferred from an accredited university and 8 years of related experience, or a Master’s Degree in a STEM discipline and 6 years of experience, or a PhD and 4 years of experience. A high school diploma and 12 years of related work experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
  • Ability and flexibility to work alternate shifts if required to support business needs.
  • Applicants must have a current, active in-scope U.S. Government issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
  • Ability and willingness to travel 10% to support business needs
  • Advanced experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, including integration of automated testing, code quality, and security scanning tools
  • Strong background in Linux-based development and test environments, with an emphasis on supporting scalable, automated build and deployment workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar), including pipeline configuration, build automation, and artifact management
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware) and applying security updates to virtualized and containerized environments
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning and security compliance tools, including application of OS/security patches and managing patch repositories in support of secure DevOps practices
  • Experience supporting build and deployment environments, including maintaining build scripts, installation media, and environment configuration for development and integration labs
  • Experience with or desire to learn the application, deployment, and sustainment of containerized environments
  • Experience with OpenShift, Podman, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Experience with SCM tools (e.g., Git, Bitbucket, or similar), including branching strategies and release management
  • Experience integrating code quality and coverage tools (e.g., SonarQube) into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with IDM/IPA and RSA for authentication and access control in development and lab environments

AI & Engineering/EaaS - DevOps Engineer III

Build and scale modern DevOps capabilities that help clients accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and modernize engineering operations. As a Senior Consultant in Engineering Foundry, AI & E/EaaS - DevOps, you will support the design, implementation, and optimization of cloud, automation, and platform engineering solutions across complex environments. This role blends technical delivery, client collaboration, and operational improvement to help organizations strengthen software delivery performance and business outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/1/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Engineering Foundry, AI & E/EaaS - DevOps on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for...

  • Designing, implementing, and supporting DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, and continuous integration and continuous deployment practices across client environments
  • Collaborating with client and Deloitte teams to assess current-state engineering processes and define target-state DevOps operating models, tooling, and workflows
  • Building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, platform services, and deployment automation using infrastructure as code and configuration management tools
  • Monitoring application and platform performance, identifying issues, and implementing improvements to reliability, scalability, security, and release quality
  • Contributing to project deliverables, technical documentation, environment standards, and implementation plans while supporting client-facing discussions and delivery milestones

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline
  • 6+ years of experience with DevOps engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure automation
  • 1 year of experience shipping an agentic system to production. This should include multi-step planning, tool use, memory and state management, ad multi-agent or orchestrator patterns.
  • 6+ years of experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • 4+ years of experience building and maintaining continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines
  • 4+ years of experience using infrastructure as code tools, such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager
  • 4+ years of experience with container platforms and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • 4+ years of experience supporting DevSecOps practices, including security scanning and policy enforcement in deployment pipelines
  • 4+ years of experience with scripting languages, such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • 4+ years of experience with monitoring and observability tools, such as Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana
  • 4+ years of experience working in consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery environments
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery models and cross-functional product or engineering teams
  • Experience with release management, environment strategy, and production support processes

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
  • Education/training allowances.

Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, AWS and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment on customer site (on average 2-3 days a week) with a great team.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Automate deployment processes and implement CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliability and rapid scaling.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to seamlessly integrate their applications into the operational infrastructure.
  • Monitor production systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve them to maintain high availability.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, continuously exploring new ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Top Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 9+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 7 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 13 years relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge with one or more of the following:
    • Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
    • AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
    • Configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
    • Application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Comfortable operating in a terminal-based environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Must have or be able to obtain DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e., Security+) within 30 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, averaging 2-3 days per week on customer site in Fort Meade, MD. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.
Preferred Requirements

  • Currently holds an active Top Secret/SCI security clearance.
  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, Helm, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Experience with K9s, AWS CLI, AWS SNS, AWS SQS, and AWS Diode.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

Become a part of our caring community

Humana is looking for a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer to design, implement, and support secure, compliant cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and GCP. You will ensure enterprise-scale software delivery through modern CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platforms, GitOps practices, automation, and developer self-service capabilities.

The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation), with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runners, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure platform services across the organization. You will also partner with cybersecurity teams to support application security projects, VIT/CVIT remediation, secret management, and emerging software supply chain security capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure.
  • Implement software supply chain security, artifact governance, dependency governance, vulnerability management, and secure software delivery practices across enterprise CI/CD ecosystems.
  • Provide dedicated expertise for emerging software supply chain security capabilities, including JFrog Curation and related governance controls.
  • Support application security initiatives, VIT/CVIT remediation efforts, secret remediation requirements, and enterprise compliance mandates.
  • Maintain security controls across Azure DevOps, GitHub, Build Agents, and GitHub Runner platforms that support enterprise software delivery.
  • Partner with security organizations to rapidly assess, prioritize, and remediate newly identified vulnerabilities impacting developer platforms and CI/CD services.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Lead platform modernization initiatives while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and operational stability are maintained.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, secret management, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting application security programs, VIT/CVIT remediation efforts, and enterprise compliance initiatives.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with managing, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement projects.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps maturity models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, compliance controls, and software supply chain security capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with software supply chain security governance frameworks, SBOM management, and dependency governance.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

40

Job Number: R0253597

DevOps Engineer, Mid

The Opportunity:

As a DevOps engineer, you know how to set up cloud environments and provision computer networking, storage, and virtual networks—ultimately, how to “harness the cloud.” We’re looking for a DevOps infrastructure engineer like you to support our clients as they modernize their IT infrastructures and meet their most challenging missions.

As a DevOps infrastructure engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll work closely with cloud architects and engineers to manage server configuration for modern cloud solutions. You’ll sharpen your skills within a DevOps framework to establish or provision virtual machines or networks and use cloud service providers to further your clients’ meaningful missions.

With access to our internal innovative labs, there’s no better place to expand your skills and explore different ways of solving our clients’ challenges. Whether helping to develop, deploy, or manage IT infrastructures for crucial server and network components, here, you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Experience writing Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with native services on AWS or Azure such as compute, storage, IAM, and networking
  • Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • Experience troubleshooting application, pipeline, and infrastructure issues in cloud environments
  • Knowledge of Linux and networking fundamentals DNS, TCP/IP, VPCs, VNets, load balancing, or firewalls
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices
  • DoD 8140 Certification such as Security+ Certification
  • Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Arch, or CKA Cloud or tooling-specific Certifications


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Join us. The world can’t wait.

This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance.   • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.

  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.

  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries.

  • Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

40

$106,900 - $147,000 per year

descriptionHtml:
About Sphinx

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better.

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

About The Role

The Sphinx Space Communications team is a small, engineering focused team that prioritizes delivering quality products and learning from each other. The team is distributed across the US, with a strong culture that balances independence with collaboration. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who are always looking to learn from each other.

Sphinx is hiring a DevOps Engineer to join our team building a cutting edge communications platform for US government satellites. We're looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to help take our build and deployment automation to the next level. As a DevOps Engineer you will help build the development and deployment infrastructure used by our Space Communications team, which provides infrastructure for a wide variety of US Government satellites. As an early hire on a small team, you will have an outsized role in determining what we build and how we work.

What You’ll Be Focusing On

  • Maintain and support existing bare-metal Kubernetes infrastructure and services.
  • Deploy and maintain bare-metal storage, virtualization and containerization platforms.
  • Ensure platform reliability, availability, and security across cloud environments.
  • Develop and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to support software delivery.
  • Build and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code solutions.
  • Create and manage Helm charts for Kubernetes application deployments.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, platform, and application issues across classified Kubernetes environments.
  • Partner with software and platform engineering teams to support operational needs and platform improvements.
  • Continuously improve system performance, automation, observability, and operational efficiency.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR A TRACK RECORD OF THE FOLLOWING

  • Experience maintaining and supporting production bare-metal Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience writing, maintaining, and optimizing GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Experience creating, deploying, and maintaining Helm charts for Kubernetes applications.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization and containerization platforms.
  • Experience troubleshooting applications and services running inKubernetes environments.
  • Proficiency with Python or Go for automation, tooling, and operational support.
  • Experience maintaining infrastructure while meeting performance, reliability, and security requirements.
  • Ability to support cross-functional engineering teams and respond to operational issues as needed.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF

  • You have hands-on production experience with Kubernetes (OpenShift preferred), Terraform, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • You have several years of experience operating and maintaining cloud-native infrastructure.
  • You are comfortable writing automation and tooling in Python or Go.
  • You have experience managing Kubernetes deployments using Helm.
  • You understand self-hosted storage and virtualization solutions.
  • You enjoy troubleshooting complex distributed systems and identifying root causes quickly.
  • You are comfortable working across multiple teams and supporting a variety of engineering initiatives.
  • Experience with tools such as Nexus, GitLab, Keycloak, OpenShift, Kyverno, Ceph/Rook, monitoring platforms, alerting systems, or network firewalls is a plus.
  • You thrive in hybrid environments and communicate effectively with teammates across distributed teams.

LOCATION

This role is a hybrid role based in Colorado Springs, CO that offers flexibility while supporting collaboration on classified work. This role will require onsite work as needed to support secure program requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

  • This role is between $140,000 - $170,000 base salary.
  • Quarterly bonus structure
  • Equity ownership in the company
  • 100% Premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and dependents
  • Health Savings Accounts
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k employer contribution plan
  • Generous paid time off policy

At Sphinx Defense, we are devoted to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Sphinx Defense is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position requires eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251300

DevOps Engineer, Senior

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a senior platform DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience working with deploying cloud resources on AWS
  • 3+ years of experience with containerization, building images, and orchestrating deployments on Kubernetes or EKS
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code deployments, including automated server or network configurations, large-scale software deployments, or monitoring and testing
  • Knowledge of container networking, monitoring, and storage solutions
  • Knowledge of container security technologies, and evaluating and mitigating or resolving vulnerability findings
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in a technical environment, or 10+ years of experience in a technical environment in lieu of a degree
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, CISSP, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience with Kubernetes deployment orchestration tools such as ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience developing in Java or Python
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana or ElasticSearch, Kibana, and FluentD
  • Experience with the design, deployment, and management of cloud environments, including AWS or Azure
  • Experience using or migrating CI/CD pipeline solutions or tools, including Jenkins, Git, or TeamCity
  • Experience with system integration using a variety of protocols, including JSON, REST, and XML
  • Experience with scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby, and leveraging JSON, YAML, or XML for configuration
  • Knowledge of Linux or UNIX administration and automation
  • Knowledge of foundational system administration principles
  • Kubernetes Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. The role also contributes to scalable cloud network architecture, self-service tooling, network-aware CI/CD pipelines, and integrated developer platform capabilities that standardize software delivery across the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities, as They Align to Ryan’s Key Results

Key Responsibilities

People

  • Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency.
  • Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices.

Client

Internal Developer Portal (IDP)

  • Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows.
  • Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load.
  • Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms.
  • Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata.
  • Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements.

Value

Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications.
  • Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines.
  • Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices.
  • Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability.

Cloud and Infrastructure Automation

  • Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy-as-code.
  • Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.

DevOps and Platform Best Practices

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation.
  • Six or more years of hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives for new tools and processes.
  • Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, security, and operations teams.
  • Clear, transparent communication style with a bias toward documentation and shared ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or implementing a commercial Internal Developer Portal, such as Harness IDP, Port, or a similar platform.
  • Experience implementing platform engineering concepts and developer self-service models.
  • Familiarity with service mesh, application programming interface (API) gateways, or cloud-native networking.
  • Experience implementing security automation and compliance guardrails.
  • Knowledge of observability platforms, including Datadog, Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK), and cloud-native tools.
  • Experience in multicloud or hybrid cloud environments.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related technical field.

Certificates and Licenses

  • Valid driver’s license required.
  • AWS and/or Azure certifications preferred; professional-level or specialty certifications preferred.
  • Additional certifications in DevOps, Kubernetes, or cloud technologies are a plus.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

  • Responsible for planning and evolving processes and infrastructure to execute programs supporting rapid capability maturation and deployment.
  • Integrates development pipelines leveraging automation with test-driven development tools and continuous integration/test frameworks.
  • Define and implement the build, deployment, provisioning, and monitoring standards for the program.
  • Ensures implementation of Software Configuration Management (SCM), code quality, and code coverage with automated testing for Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Work as part of an Agile development team to deliver end-end automation of deployment, monitoring, and infrastructure management framework.
  • Build and configure delivery environments supporting CD/CI tools using an Agile delivery methodology.
  • Create scripts and/or templates to automate infrastructure provisioning and management tasks.
  • Work closely with development teams to create an automated continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) system.
  • Work together with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution
  • Monitor and support all installed systems and infrastructure.
  • Develop custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks.
  • Contribute to the design of information and operational support systems.
  • Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools.
  • Oversee the company’s security, backup, and redundancy strategies.
  • Evaluate application performance, identify potential bottlenecks, develop solutions, and implement them with the help of developers.

This position offers a sign on bonus starting at $10,000.

Basic Qualifications

  • United States Citizenship
  • Must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope, with the ability to obtain and maintain SCI approval/access.
  • Must have an active U.S. Government CI Polygraph, current and within scope.
  • Bachelor’s degree with 12 + years of relevant experience; 10 years with a Master's; 8 years with a PhD; or 4 additional years of experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and provisioning technology.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or equivalent DoD 8570 IAT/IAM II certification
  • Administration experience with Linux or related operating systems.
  • Experience in an Agile software development framework
  • Experience with at least 1 of the preferred qualifications below

Preferred Qualifications

  • Terraform
  • Ansible
  • CloudFormation
  • Azure Bicep/ARM templates
  • Pulumi
  • OpenTofu
  • Kubernetes administration
  • AWS administration
  • Flux
  • Helm
  • DynamoDB
  • NATS configuration
  • Big Bang (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki)
  • Jenkins/GitLab/Bamboo

What We Can Offer You

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a work environment which encourages your growth and supports the mutual success of our people and our company. Northrop Grumman benefits give you the

flexibility and control to choose the benefits that make the most sense for you and your family.

Your benefits will include the following: Health Plan, Savings Plan, Paid Time Off and Additional Benefits including: Education Assistance, Training and Development, 9/80 Work Schedule (where available), and much more!

Primary Level Salary Range: $183,500.00 - $275,000.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

AI & Engineering/EaaS - DevOps Engineer III

Build and scale modern DevOps capabilities that help clients accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and modernize engineering operations. As a Senior Consultant in Engineering Foundry, AI & E/EaaS - DevOps, you will support the design, implementation, and optimization of cloud, automation, and platform engineering solutions across complex environments. This role blends technical delivery, client collaboration, and operational improvement to help organizations strengthen software delivery performance and business outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/1/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Engineering Foundry, AI & E/EaaS - DevOps on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for...

  • Designing, implementing, and supporting DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, and continuous integration and continuous deployment practices across client environments
  • Collaborating with client and Deloitte teams to assess current-state engineering processes and define target-state DevOps operating models, tooling, and workflows
  • Building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, platform services, and deployment automation using infrastructure as code and configuration management tools
  • Monitoring application and platform performance, identifying issues, and implementing improvements to reliability, scalability, security, and release quality
  • Contributing to project deliverables, technical documentation, environment standards, and implementation plans while supporting client-facing discussions and delivery milestones

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline
  • 6+ years of experience with DevOps engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure automation
  • 1 year of experience shipping an agentic system to production. This should include multi-step planning, tool use, memory and state management, ad multi-agent or orchestrator patterns.
  • 6+ years of experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • 4+ years of experience building and maintaining continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines
  • 4+ years of experience using infrastructure as code tools, such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager
  • 4+ years of experience with container platforms and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • 4+ years of experience supporting DevSecOps practices, including security scanning and policy enforcement in deployment pipelines
  • 4+ years of experience with scripting languages, such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • 4+ years of experience with monitoring and observability tools, such as Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana
  • 4+ years of experience working in consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery environments
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery models and cross-functional product or engineering teams
  • Experience with release management, environment strategy, and production support processes

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0249981

DevOps Engineer, Senior

The Opportunity:

As a DevOps engineer, you know how to set up cloud environments and provision computer networking, storage, and virtual networks, ultimately how to “harness the cloud”. We’re looking for an experienced DevOps infrastructure engineer like you to support our clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions.

As a DevOps infrastructure engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll work closely with cloud architects and engineers to manage server configuration for modern cloud solutions. You’ll apply your skills within a DevOps framework to establish or provision virtual machines (VMs) or networks and use cloud service providers to further your clients’ meaningful missions.

With access to our internal innovative labs, there’s no better place to further your skills and explore different ways of solving our clients’ challenges. Whether helping to develop, deploy, or manage IT infrastructures for crucial server and network components, here you’ll have the latest technology and brightest teammates at your fingertips.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, and software development
  • 5+ years of experience in the development of tools and processes to drive DevOps or DevSecOps maturity by automating builds, regression testing, monitoring, and pushing releases across environments
  • 2+ years of experience using Java, C++, Golang, or Python
  • 2+ years of experience capturing Infrastructure-as-Code, including CloudFormation, Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible, or Kubernetes
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience debugging existing code
  • Experience identifying, troubleshooting, and solving cloud-based network and system issues
  • Experience deploying, maintaining, and updating cloud Linux servers and Kubernetes clusters
  • Experience developing enterprise cloud-native solutions
  • Experience provisioning computer networking and storage, and setting up servers which the platform runs, including VMs or networks
  • Experience creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative team environment
  • Experience developing enterprise cloud-native solutions, involving Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Jenkins, or Azure, and writing scripts using Bash and Python
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks
  • Master’s degree in CS
  • AWS, Azure, GCP, Security Engineering, or Cyber Engineering Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

What We're Doing

Rotary and Mission Systems' Training, Logistics and Simulation (TLS) business is Lockheed Martin’s center of excellence for training and logistics products and services, serving the U.S. military and more than 65 international customers around the world. Based in Orlando, TLS develops programs that teach service men and women skills to accomplish their most challenging missions — flying the world’s most advanced fighter aircraft, navigating ships and driving armored vehicles.

TLS is the corporation’s hub for simulation, live-virtual-constructive capabilities, advanced training devices and full-service training programs. TLS also provides sustainment services such as supply chain and logistics IT solutions, spares and repairs, as well as automated test and support equipment.

THE WORK

This is a position for a Software Engineering Senior on our F35 Pilot Training Devices (PTD) Team.

As a key member of our Software Engineering team, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, and Azure DevOps
  • Containerize applications using Docker and Podman
  • Develop and maintain scripts using languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure smooth integration of code changes into the CI/CD pipeline
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with the CI/CD pipeline, including debugging and optimizing pipeline performance
  • Ensure compliance with security and regulatory requirements, including implementing security scanning and vulnerability management tools
  • Develop and maintain documentation for CI/CD pipelines, including pipeline architecture, configuration, and troubleshooting guides

This position will require the selected candidate to have or obtain an Interim Secret level U.S. government security clearance before starting with Lockheed Martin. U.S. citizenship is a requirement for consideration.

Why Join Us

Join us if you are passionate about saving lives through mission readiness. Be a part of a team that values speed, agility, affordability, and disruptive technologies.

If you are excited about transforming sustainment and training solutions and working with a talented team to reimagine the future, we invite you to contribute your skills and technical expertise to our mission.

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 2 or more years of experience in software development, with a focus on full stack web development and DevOps
  • Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with containerization and using tools such as Docker or Podman
  • Experience with scripting in languages such as Bash, PowerShell, and Python
  • Experience with Infrastructure As Code (IaC) and writing Ansible playbooks
  • Experience with container orchestration via Kubernetes or Openshift
  • Strong experience with object-oriented programming languages (such as C++, C#, Python, Ruby, Objective-C)

Desired Skills

  • Master's degree
  • Advanced Expertise in GitLab CI/CD, including advanced pipeline configuration, job artifacts, and dependency management
  • Advanced Expertise with GitLab Runner, including installation, configuration, and management of runners
  • Advanced Expertise with Python and bash scripting

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $81100.00 - $150500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

Rotary and Mission Systems' Training, Logistics and Simulation (TLS) business is Lockheed Martin’s center of excellence for training and logistics products and services, serving the U.S. military and more than 65 international customers around the world. Based in Orlando, TLS develops programs that teach service men and women skills to accomplish their most challenging missions — flying the world’s most advanced fighter aircraft, navigating ships and driving armored vehicles.

TLS is the corporation’s hub for simulation, live-virtual-constructive capabilities, advanced training devices and full-service training programs. descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0252586

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Today’s dynamic technology landscape demands constant and rapid innovation. To facilitate this transformation, we must ensure continuous integration and application development. That’s why we need an experienced DevOps engineer like you who’s eager to design, test, and program critical applications for our clients who need them most.

As a Software Factory DevOps Engineer on our team, you’ll pipeline our software development from requirements to testing in production. You’ll incorporate automation and cloud resources to minimize repetitive tasks and free up the team’s developers to do what they do best—innovate. You’ll work together with fellow professionals to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) to limit manual testing and troubleshooting.

This is an opportunity to broaden your experience in software engineering while helping to develop software that will completely transform workflows and make a real impact. Here, we invest in technology, and we’ll invest in you. With access to continuing education resources, tuition assistance opportunities, and technology development programs, you’ll keep your skills sharp as you work at the leading edge of technology.

Work with us as we build and test tools to transform the future.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in the development of tools and processes to drive DevOps or DevSecOps maturity by automating builds, regression testing, monitoring, and pushing releases across environments
  • 3+ years of experience troubleshooting, triaging, and resolving issues for CI/CD pipeline failures or slowness
  • Experience building enterprise cloud-native solutions such as Azure, AWS, GCP, or OCI
  • Experience with automation, writing Terraform IaC and Shell scripting
  • Experience working with Agile application development teams across the software development lifecycle and creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative team environment
  • Experience with DevOps platforms, application level, pipeline build and development, and automation to support build and testing
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree or 8+ years of experience in DevOps in lieu of a degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience developing enterprise cloud-native solutions involving Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD
  • Knowledge of creating and improving continuous automation across multiple cloud service providers and technical stacks
  • Knowledge of triaging and resolving issues related to both open-source and commercial tools in government cloud environments
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Linux Shell Script, PowerShell, and Python
  • Secret clearance

descriptionHtml:
An experienced Senior DevOps engineer is required to join the Technology Operations (TTO) team within LSEG Markets & Risk Intelligence. You will be part of a team that will help us build the future of financial services on blockchain technology. The team is responsible for the delivery and support of production environments which are typically housed within Azure, as well as integrating software changes into the enterprise environment as part of ongoing project work. The role includes participation in an on-call rota to ensure coverage during business hours, with plans to expand support coverage as the business scales. Occasional weekend work may be required to support release testing and deployment activities.

DMI (Digital Markets Infrastructure) is an ambitious project: large-scale, complex and uses a range of blockchain architecture patterns, with numerous stakeholders (internal and external) and use cases. The work is focussed on the tokenization of financial instruments, i.e. as digital assets. We seek candidates with a curiosity about financial markets with experience working on large projects. This is a chance to work on an ambitious project backed by the influential reach of the London Stock Exchange Group.

This opportunity sits within a true “build it, you run it” team, working on a cloud‑native product. The role offers hands-on ownership across the full lifecycle, from building and evolving the platform through to running and supporting it in production.

You’ll work closely with our development colleagues in the UK and Bucharest through agile sprints, contributing to design decisions, automation, reliability, and the continuous improvement of a critical trading service. Ensuring the availability of this service will be a key responsibility.

What you'll be doing:

  • Implement, handle, and optimise Cloud deployments and automations of DMI applications.
  • Develop and run container orchestration solutions using Kubernetes and similar technologies.
  • Implement, maintain, and optimise containerization for DMI services (e.g. via Docker).
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and scaling (e.g. Terraform).
  • Integrate security protocols into the DevOps lifecycle, ensuring adaptability against vulnerabilities.
  • Partner with software engineers, QA, and other teams to ensure efficient deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of applications.
  • Keep up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and guidelines in DevOps and cloud infrastructure.

What you'll bring:

  • Computer science, software engineering, or relevant technical background required.
  • 5 + years of professional experience in DevOps and infrastructure management.
  • 5+ years of specific experience with Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Proficient in Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.
  • Experience with the Azure cloud platform, handling workloads, provisioning & deployments.
  • Deep knowledge of security standards in cloud and DevOps contexts.
  • Proven knowledge of scaling, availability and cloud resiliency models, patterns and designs.
  • Ability to anticipate potential infrastructure challenges and provide innovative solutions.
  • Curiosity about new technologies and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Familiarity with blockchain/DLT desirable.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. descriptionHtml:
Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

  • Ensure user visible uptime and quality, providing operational and development expertise in making our systems fail rarely, and fast to fix when they do fail
  • Minimize manual involvement by imagining & implementing continuous improvements that create an operating environment, including the development of new tools, dynamically monitoring, alerting, & automated self-healing & recovery

The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented DevOps Engineer to join our team in Doral, FL.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for deployment and testing workflows.
  • Managing infrastructure as code (IaC) using provisioning and configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, software developers, and system administrators to streamline software delivery.
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing cloud and on-premise infrastructure performance and system availability.
  • Automating system baselines, system patching schedules, and central repository management controls.
  • Maintaining technical baseline configurations, configuration management items, and comprehensive engineering documentation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field with 3+ years of experience.
    • OR a master’s degree OR PhD and 1+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR an associate’s degree and 5+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR a high school diploma and 7+ or more years of relevant experience
  • Proven experience building, maintaining, and automating continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Strong proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Chef).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes). Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical documentation and infrastructure configurations.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant industry certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), or Docker Certified Associate.
  • Prior experience supporting U.S. Military Command operations or Department of Defense enterprise technical environments.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, automated vulnerability scanning, and DoD STIG compliance automation.
  • Demonstrated experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell.

Clearance Requirements

  • Must hold a current/active secret security clearance.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations
