Job Description




What’s it like to engineer the systems that protect the world?
 It is the professional satisfaction of knowing your technical expertise directly supports national security. At BAE Systems, you aren't just managing infrastructure; you are architecting the digital foundation of global defense.

As a

DevOps Software Engineer
, you will embark on a high-impact

career
 journey, serving as a key driver of efficiency within a large-scale enterprise system. In this

job
, you will automate complex workflows, leveraging CI/CD mastery to streamline the entire software delivery lifecycle.



Your Responsibilities


Your primary objective is to transition manual processes into scalable, automated workflows. You will design the sophisticated pipelines that allow our teams to build, test, and deploy software with precision and reliability.



Day-to-day Functions Include


  • Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines to support seamless continuous integration, delivery, and deployment.
  • Process Automation: Identify systemic manual bottlenecks and implement automation to significantly improve operational efficiency.
  • Tooling Management: Select, configure, and maintain the industry-leading tools that support software development and integrated testing.
  • Infrastructure Optimization: Implement and support automation tools while optimizing the underlying IT infrastructure to ensure peak performance.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure all system improvements and architectural changes maintain rigorous security standards.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with agile teams across the program, demonstrating ownership and persistence to achieve shared mission goals.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Clearance: Must possess an active TS/SCI clearance with an appropriate polygraph.
  • Experience: Minimum of 8 years of relevant DevOps experience, with at least 5 years focused on managing software development, deployment, and integrated testing tools.
  • Frameworks: 5+ years of experience working with CI/CD frameworks.
  • System Administration: Meaningful experience in system administration, primarily Windows, with supporting Linux experience.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with several of the following: Java, Groovy, Python, PowerShell, Batch, Bash, JavaScript, and AngularJS.
  • Tooling: Proficiency with IDEs (such as VS Code, Visual Studio, Eclipse, or WebStorm) and software source control/configuration management tools.
  • Virtualization: Experience working in virtualized environments, including managing virtual machines (VMs) and container-based platforms for automated deployment.
  • Professional Competencies: Strong understanding of software development principles, excellent verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to produce high-quality work independently within a fast-paced team environment.

MDOPS



Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Database Management: Experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQL Server.
  • Web Development: Experience with Spring Framework, AngularJS, JSON, HTML, XML, and XSLT.
  • Agile Methodology: Experience with Scrum or the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe); SAFe Agilist certification is highly desirable.


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $149603 - $254317

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • 10% 401k benefit.

  • Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $119,574.00 - $160,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 2-3 days a week) with a great team on customer site in San Antonio, TX.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Support development and deployment of non-cloud (Edge) infrastructure of on-premise and portable equipment.
  • Automate deployment processes and ensure reliability and scalability of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.]
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate their applications into the infrastructure.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and resolve issues as necessary.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, continuously exploring new ways to improve our infrastructure.

  • Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and ensure optimal resource utilization
  • Maintain documentation for infrastructure, configurations, and deployment processes
  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for production systems

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, etc.) preferred
  • Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role
  • Experience with version control systems (Git)
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and tools
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)
  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Understanding of networking concepts and protocols
  • Proficiency with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, etc.)
  • Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, Ruby, etc.)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251300

DevOps Engineer, Senior

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a senior platform DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience working with deploying cloud resources on AWS
  • 3+ years of experience with containerization, building images, and orchestrating deployments on Kubernetes or EKS
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code deployments, including automated server or network configurations, large-scale software deployments, or monitoring and testing
  • Knowledge of container networking, monitoring, and storage solutions
  • Knowledge of container security technologies, and evaluating and mitigating or resolving vulnerability findings
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in a technical environment, or 10+ years of experience in a technical environment in lieu of a degree
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, CISSP, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of hire date


Nice If You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience with Kubernetes deployment orchestration tools such as ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience developing in Java or Python
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana or ElasticSearch, Kibana, and FluentD
  • Experience with the design, deployment, and management of cloud environments, including AWS or Azure
  • Experience using or migrating CI/CD pipeline solutions or tools, including Jenkins, Git, or TeamCity
  • Experience with system integration using a variety of protocols, including JSON, REST, and XML
  • Experience with scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby, and leveraging JSON, YAML, or XML for configuration
  • Knowledge of Linux or UNIX administration and automation
  • Knowledge of foundational system administration principles
  • Kubernetes Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.
  • Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. descriptionHtml:
Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.

Overview

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to build and evolve the engineering platform supporting the software used in Joby's aircraft manufacturing operations. In this role, you'll own core infrastructure, software delivery pipelines, and developer tooling, creating reliable self-service capabilities that help engineers ship software without spending time on repetitive setup and operational work. You'll work closely with software engineering, QA, and IT to make software delivery faster, safer, and more predictable. You'll also help establish practical ways to use AI across development, testing, and operations. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on the reliability and pace of the systems that support aircraft design, production and operations.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the delivery system, from CI/CD pipelines to internal tools and self-service capabilities, that removes repetitive setup and operational work from developers' hands and shortens the path from idea to production
  • Build the pipeline foundations that enable fast, reliable automated testing: ephemeral environments, test data, parallelized execution, and quality gates, in partnership with QA and development teams
  • Design and operate a shared Kubernetes platform across cloud and on-premises factory sites, with the standardized deployment patterns that help teams onboard and ship consistently
  • Evaluate and integrate AI into development, testing, and operational workflows, including the infrastructure and guardrails needed to use AI-powered tools safely at scale
  • Own infrastructure as code, observability, incident response, and post-incident reviews for systems that production lines depend on
  • Embed security and compliance controls into the platform and pipelines so they are enforced automatically, keeping teams fast while maintaining security and compliance requirements

Required

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years in platform, DevOps, or SRE roles, with ownership of production systems used by multiple teams
  • Strong hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in running clusters in production.
  • Strong CI/CD, GitOps, and infrastructure-as-code background, ideally with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and Terraform
  • Proven software engineering experience building and maintaining production services, tools, and components in Python
  • Experience with a major cloud provider, preferably Azure, plus comfort with on-premises infrastructure
  • Security-minded approach to platform design and strong communication skills across functions and time zones

Desired

  • Experience building or scaling an internal developer platform used by multiple teams
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and agent workflows, and a view on how to apply them across an engineering organization
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, and with Proxmox or comparable on-premises virtualization
  • Experience safely exposing services to external users (API gateways, edge security, multi-tenancy)
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms
  • Exposure to regulated or audited environments (e.g., SOX) or to manufacturing / shop-floor systems

Additional Information

Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $124,300 - $196,400/yr.

The compensation package will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.

Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The DevOps Engineer designs and implements a fully automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) ecosystem, Internal Developer Portal (IDP), and secure cloud networking across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. The role also contributes to scalable cloud network architecture, self-service tooling, network-aware CI/CD pipelines, and integrated developer platform capabilities that standardize software delivery across the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities, as They Align to Ryan’s Key Results

Key Responsibilities

People

  • Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency.
  • Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices.

Client

Internal Developer Portal (IDP)

  • Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows.
  • Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load.
  • Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms.
  • Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata.
  • Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements.

Value

Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications.
  • Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines.
  • Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices.
  • Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability.

Cloud and Infrastructure Automation

  • Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy-as-code.
  • Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.

DevOps and Platform Best Practices

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation.
  • Six or more years of hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives for new tools and processes.
  • Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, security, and operations teams.
  • Clear, transparent communication style with a bias toward documentation and shared ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or implementing a commercial Internal Developer Portal, such as Harness IDP, Port, or a similar platform.
  • Experience implementing platform engineering concepts and developer self-service models.
  • Familiarity with service mesh, application programming interface (API) gateways, or cloud-native networking.
  • Experience implementing security automation and compliance guardrails.
  • Knowledge of observability platforms, including Datadog, Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK), and cloud-native tools.
  • Experience in multicloud or hybrid cloud environments.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related technical field.

Certificates and Licenses

  • Valid driver’s license required.
  • AWS and/or Azure certifications preferred; professional-level or specialty certifications preferred.
  • Additional certifications in DevOps, Kubernetes, or cloud technologies are a plus.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

  • Standard indoor working environment.
  • Occasional long periods of sitting while working at a computer.
  • Position requires regular interaction with employees at all levels of the Firm, as well as interaction with external vendors and clients as necessary.
  • Independent travel requirement: up to 10%.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage partnership, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with significant careers.

Role Summary

A Senior DevOps Engineer will work within the automation teams and alongside product teams to define, develop, test, and maintain the full CI/CD pipeline for cloud and on premises. This pipeline handles everything from the initial builds to automated testing and production deployment's. This is an opportunity to be part of development for our latest platform and you could be a critical part of our success in a global, high profile environment and with an enterprise level product with a global team.

The ideal candidate will be an individual that will take full ownership of problems and drive them through to completion. Must demonstrate dedication to improving the testing and Deployment of our solutions through automation and able to identify, propose, and drive improvements to meet this goal. Learning is also an important aspect of every member of the team, and continued learning is strongly encouraged and supported.

What You will Bring:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with CI/CD automation platforms such as Jenkins and Gitlab
  • Experience in containerization (Docker)
  • Experience in Linux
  • Experience with source code management tools such as GIT
  • Excellent communication skills (written and oral).
  • Strong collaboration and partnership (especially virtual).

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About The Role

A Principal DevOps Engineer works with developers and IT staff to oversee the code releases, combining an understanding of both engineering and coding. From creating and implementing systems software to analyzing data to improve the applications and environments, a DevOps Engineer increases productivity in the workplace. They understand the software development lifecycle and have a clear understanding of various automation tools for developing digital pipelines (CI/CD pipelines).

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Build CI/CD Pipelines: Create automated systems to test and deploy code quickly.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code: Use code to provision and scale cloud servers automatically.
  • Ensure Observability: Set up logging and monitoring tools to catch system errors early.
  • Lead Incident Response: Fix major production crashes and find the root cause of failures.
  • Mentor Team Members: Guide junior engineers and review their technical work.
  • Ensure uptime of 99.9% and 99% quality of service (degradation)

Required Knowledge And Experience

Requires a Bachelor's Degree and minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.

Nice To Have

  • Experience: Seven or more years working in DevOps, systems administration, or software support.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead projects and work with cross-functional teams.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Container Tools: Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for running apps.
  • Scripting Languages: Strong skills in Python, Bash, or Shell.
  • Monitoring Systems: Familiarity with NewRelic and OpenSearch.
  • Maintain and support infrastructure tools (JIRA, Jenkins)

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

descriptionHtml:
As a Sr. DevOps Engineer I, you’ll play a critical role in designing, operating, and improving shared cloud and DevOps platform services used by multiple customer mission teams.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Engineer, administer, automate, and sustain shared platform services that support multiple customer teams.
  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot shared Linux-based cloud and DevOps services used by multiple customer mission teams.
  • Provision, configure, troubleshoot, and optimize AWS infrastructure and services, including EC2, S3, RDS, and Elastic Load Balancing capabilities.
  • Support the operation of containerized services and workloads.
  • Configure, administer, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins and/or GitLab.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts, configuration patterns, deployment procedures, and reusable technical solutions to improve platform reliability and repeatability.
  • Integrate shared platform tooling with source control, artifact repositories, authentication/authorization services, security tooling, monitoring, logging, and ticketing systems as applicable.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Active TS/SCI with CI Poly.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, platform operations, cloud infrastructure, site reliability, automation, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems in production or mission environments.
  • Experience supporting AWS infrastructure (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Security Groups, and/or Load Balancing).
  • Experience building, running, troubleshooting, and/or supporting containerized workloads (e.g., Docker and/or Podman).
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines from scratch (e.g., GitLab and/or Jenkins).
  • Experience with Git-based source-control workflows.
  • Ability to automate infrastructure and processes using Python and/or Bash.

SALARY RANGE: $170,000 - $235,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including: 

  • The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
  • The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
  • Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
  • This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:
    • Performance-based bonuses
    • Company-paid training and/or certifications
    • Referral bonuses

Application Deadline:  Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

Additional Compensation: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

Benefits: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Parental Leave and dependent care
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said, we are big fans of our people. That’s why we offer a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

 What we want you to know:

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

 Not ready to apply now? 

Sign up to join our newsletter here.

The DevOps Engineer designs and implements a fully automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) ecosystem, Internal Developer Portal (IDP), and secure cloud networking across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. The role also contributes to scalable cloud network architecture, self-service tooling, network-aware CI/CD pipelines, and integrated developer platform capabilities that standardize software delivery across the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities, as They Align to Ryan’s Key Results

Key Responsibilities

People

  • Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency.
  • Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices.

Client

Internal Developer Portal (IDP)

  • Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows.
  • Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load.
  • Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms.
  • Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata.
  • Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements.

Value

Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications.
  • Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines.
  • Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices.
  • Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability.

Cloud and Infrastructure Automation

  • Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy-as-code.
  • Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.

DevOps and Platform Best Practices

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation.
  • Six or more years of hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives for new tools and processes.
  • Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, security, and operations teams.
  • Clear, transparent communication style with a bias toward documentation and shared ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or implementing a commercial Internal Developer Portal, such as Harness IDP, Port, or a similar platform.
  • Experience implementing platform engineering concepts and developer self-service models.
  • Familiarity with service mesh, application programming interface (API) gateways, or cloud-native networking.
  • Experience implementing security automation and compliance guardrails.
  • Knowledge of observability platforms, including Datadog, Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK), and cloud-native tools.
  • Experience in multicloud or hybrid cloud environments.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related technical field.

Certificates and Licenses

  • Valid driver’s license required.
  • AWS and/or Azure certifications preferred; professional-level or specialty certifications preferred.
  • Additional certifications in DevOps, Kubernetes, or cloud technologies are a plus.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

  • Standard indoor working environment.
  • Occasional long periods of sitting while working at a computer.
  • Position requires regular interaction with employees at all levels of the Firm, as well as interaction with external vendors and clients as necessary.
  • Independent travel requirement: up to 10%.

Build and Deliver

Operate and Protect

  • Investigate complex production issues, distinguish root causes from symptoms, and implement sustainable fixes
  • Apply secure operational practices and partner with security, Trust, and compliance specialists to meet evolving requirements and minimize customer disruption

Improve and Automate

  • Build automation and repeatable processes that improve operational consistency across many environments and regions
  • Improve observability, runbooks, recovery readiness, operational workflows, and cloud resource efficiency to reduce risk and manual effort
  • Share knowledge, contribute to reviews and retrospectives, and collaborate across teams to improve how services are built and operated

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in DevOps, site reliability, cloud infrastructure, or a related engineering discipline, including hands-on operation of production cloud services
  • Practical experience with AWS, infrastructure automation or Infrastructure as Code, and scripting or programming for operational tasks
  • Working knowledge of software delivery practices, cloud security fundamentals, monitoring, and troubleshooting distributed systems.

  • Applying SRE practices, improving cloud efficiency, or using AI-assisted tools and reusable agents/workflows to streamline engineering tasks
  • Experience working in agile teams
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams

The Ideal Candidate

  • You take responsibility for reliable outcomes, communicate risks early, and seek practical solutions that protect customers
  • You bring curiosity and openness to different perspectives, contribute constructively to decisions, and make space for others to participate
  • You simplify complex operations, learn from incidents, share what you learn, and help teammates and partner teams succeed

Why Join Us?

Revit Cloud Worksharing supports collaboration on complex building projects worldwide. You will help evolve critical cloud services, tackle meaningful distributed-systems challenges, and work with partners who value customer success, collaboration, and continuous improvement. If that work interests you, we encourage you to apply.

Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana's Cloud and DevOps Platform Engineering organization, where we build, secure, and operate the modern platforms that enable enterprise-scale software delivery across the company, including support for Humana Military initiatives. Our team is responsible for providing developers with reliable, secure, and scalable cloud, CI/CD, GitOps, and software supply chain capabilities that accelerate innovation while meeting the highest standards for security and compliance.

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting secure cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will provide technical leadership and ownership of key engineering platforms, including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure, helping to drive platform modernization, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and platform teams, you will advance Humana's software supply chain security strategy, enable scalable Kubernetes and GitOps practices, and deliver automation and self-service capabilities that empower development teams across the enterprise. This is an opportunity to make a broad organizational impact while helping shape the future of secure, reliable, and compliant healthcare technology delivery. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments.
  • Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise DevOps platforms.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models.
  • Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries.
  • Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks.
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

40

$106,900 - $147,000 per year

Overview

REI Systems’ mission is to deliver reliable, innovative technology solutions that advance Federal clients' missions and exceed their expectations. Our technologists and consultants are passionate about solving complex challenges that impact millions of lives. We take a Mindful Modernization® approach in delivering our services, including application modernization, grants management, case management systems, government data analytics, and advisory services. This approach, the REI Way, ensures mission impact by aligning our clients' strategic objectives with measurable outcomes through people, processes, and technology.

We offer the same commitment to our employees by providing professional development, meaningful projects, and flexibility to spend time with family and friends. We believe employees are at their best when fulfilled in both their professional careers and their personal lives. Learn more at www.REIsystems.com.

Employees voted REI Systems a Washington Post Top Workplace in 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025!

Responsibilities

 Associate DevOps Engineer

REI Systems is seeking an Associate DevOps Engineer to support the implementation, automation, and operation of enterprise cloud environments and software delivery platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to build hands-on experience with modern DevOps technologies while supporting mission-critical federal applications.

The Associate DevOps Engineer will work alongside experienced DevOps, software engineering, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to support CI/CD pipelines, AWS cloud environments, containerized applications, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, and production operations.

The ideal candidate has foundational hands-on experience with AWS, CI/CD, Kubernetes or Docker, scripting, Linux, Infrastructure as Code, and application support and is interested in developing deeper DevOps and cloud engineering expertise.

DevOps Engineering & Automation

  • Support the development, maintenance, and improvement of CI/CD pipelines and software delivery tools.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) used to provision and manage cloud environments.
  • Support the deployment and operation of containerized applications and microservices using technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, AWS EKS, and/or OpenShift.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Bash, Python, Groovy, or similar scripting languages.

Position Location: Tampa, Florida (Downtown)

Position Description: Altamira is seeking an expert Senior AWS DevSecOps Engineer to lead the design, build, and automation of our cutting-edge hybrid cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate is passionate about building secure, scalable, and highly available platforms on AWS and other cloud platforms utilizing cloud-native technologies. Your expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container orchestration with EKS, and CI/CD pipelines will be critical to empowering our development & data science teams with a robust, self-service platform. While our primary focus is AWS, experience in a hybrid environment with VMware is a plus. This position is at the customer site in Tampa Florida.

Required Experience

  • AWS Infrastructure & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure environments primarily within AWS. Implement and manage core AWS services, including networking (VPC, Transit Gateway), Kubernetes (EKS), compute (EC2, Lambda), storage (S3, EBS), and databases (RDS). Architect and operate containerized workloads using Amazon EKS, including cluster management, scaling, and security.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to automate all aspects of cloud resource provisioning and management. Develop, manage, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid and reliable software delivery. Master AWS IAM, creating and managing roles, policies, and permissions based on the principle of least privilege. Develop custom automation scripts and tooling (e.g., using Python, Go, or Bash) to streamline operations and eliminate manual processes, heavily focusing on the usage of API’s.
  • Security & Compliance: Integrate security best practices directly into the platform and pipelines (DevSecOps). Implement and enforce security controls, encryption, and access management to meet compliance standards such as DISA STIGs. Collaborate with security teams to implement robust monitoring solutions.
  • Team Enablement & Collaboration: Act as a cloud subject matter expert, providing guidance and support to development teams to optimize their use of the platform. Collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate new cloud-native technologies and recommend solutions that enhance efficiency and capability. Champion foundational best practices, including Git workflows and the proficient use of AI tools to accelerate development and problem-solving.
  • Must possess and maintain required DoD 8140 certifications.

  • Strong command of AWS IAM roles, policies, and security best practices.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline).
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, Linux/Unix administration, and security principles.
  • Proficiency with Git and modern GitOps workflows.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Deep understanding of advanced networking concepts, DNS, gateways in a hybrid/multi-cloud context.
  • Extensive expertise in advanced networking, including DNS management and gateway configuration, to support robust connectivity and integration across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  • Understanding of common authentication mechanisms, OIDC, OAuth2, LDAP, SAML.
  • Experience with VMware vSphere in a hybrid cloud context.
  • Experience with configuration man

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience (approx. 8+ years in cloud/software engineering).
  • Security Clearance: TS/SCI

Description

Leidos is looking for our next TS/SCI‑cleared DevOps Software Engineer to join a high‑energy team building and deploying a cutting‑edge technology stack in support of the DIA‑NMEC (National Media Exploitation Center) DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP). This role is part of a 10‑year program supporting the DOMEX Data Discovery Platform (D3P) Modernization effort, where you’ll contribute to mission‑critical capabilities alongside a collaborative, innovative, and growth‑oriented team.

While the majority of work is performed on‑site at our customer location in Bethesda, MD, we offer a flexible schedule and occasional opportunities for remote work.

What You’ll Do

As a DevOps Software Engineer, you’ll help design, deploy, and maintain a full‑stack, containerized microservices architecture. You’ll also support systems administration, installation, configuration, and the broader adoption of DevOps best practices across cross‑functional engineering teams. In this fast‑paced environment, you’ll collaborate closely with systems engineering, architecture, development, security, operations, and integration teams.

You will work with a multidisciplinary group of developers, integrators, and system administrators to:

  • Deploy, triage, and maintain a production big‑data pipeline built on Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, and Kafka
  • Enhance and maintain CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation to accelerate development and improve reliability
  • Design and support scalable, redundant infrastructure across physical and virtual environments
  • Use Helm to configure Kubernetes deployments for new features and evolving requirements

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

  • Assist in the design and deployment of CTI Database Platform services aligned with enterprise architecture standards

This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your Role at Baxter

As a Principal DevOps Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in the design, implementation, deployment, and support of cloud and platform engineering solutions that enable product development teams. You will partner across engineering functions to build scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure while helping drive operational excellence through automation, observability, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and support cloud infrastructure solutions that enable the development and operation of Baxter products and applications.
  • Manage infrastructure, platform, and deployment processes for product teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Implement and support observability, monitoring, and alerting solutions using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Azure Monitor.
  • Utilize tools, metrics, and best practices to monitor infrastructure, application, and process performance and drive proactive issue resolution.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities that improve operational efficiency, reliability, and engineering productivity.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams, provide technical guidance, and communicate project status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, or DevOps solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including cloud architecture, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.
  • Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies for scalable and repeatable infrastructure management.
  • Experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure architecture, including networking, compute, storage, security, resiliency, and scalability principles.
  • Experience implementing and supporting observability and monitoring solutions using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, or similar platforms.
  • Proven ability to solve complex technical problems, automate processes, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Baxter is committed to supporting the needs for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a required minimum number of days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in-person in support of our Mission. The flexible workplace policy is subject to local laws and legal requirements. At its discretion, Baxter may decide to adjust, suspend, or discontinue as business needs change.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $120,000-$165,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

US Benefits At Baxter (except For Puerto Rico)

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Baxter US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits | Baxter

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Zus Health is an AI-native healthcare data platform that brings fragmented patient information together to make it complete, current, and actionable. Through our nationwide data network, platform, and intelligent workflows, we help providers, value-based care organizations, payers, life sciences, and digital health companies drive business results, strengthen provider trust, and improve operational efficiency. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus is building the foundation for a more connected, precise, and effective healthcare system.

What We’re Looking For…

We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Engineering organization and help build, maintain, and scale the cloud infrastructure that powers the Zus platform. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, modern deployment practices, and is excited to build and support systems that process and deliver health records for millions of patients.

Our core infrastructure is foundational to everything we do at Zus. You’ll work closely with our Platform, Data, and Product Engineering teams to ensure our systems are reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective. You’ll help improve our AWS environment, automate infrastructure processes, and build tools that enable our engineers to develop and deploy software efficiently.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating across teams, and continuously improving the systems that power our platform.

As part of our team, you will...

  • Build, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure supporting the Zus platform and its applications.
  • Work with AWS services such as ECS, Fargate, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, RDS, and other cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with Platform, Data, and Product Engineering teams to support and standardize infrastructure needs, troubleshoot issues, and improve system performance.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Support, standardize, and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and developer tooling to help engineering teams ship software efficiently.
  • Monitor infrastructure performance and compliance, troubleshoot production issues, and contribute to improvements in system reliability and availability.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, optimize cloud costs, and improve infrastructure efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering and Security teams to implement cloud security best practices and maintain a secure environment that meets our compliance needs.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and ongoing improvements to infrastructure operations.
  • Contribute to infrastructure documentation, technical discussions, and engineering best practices.

You’re a good fit because you...

  • Have 3+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Have hands-on experience working with AWS or another major cloud provider, with a strong interest in deepening your AWS expertise.
  • Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Are familiar with containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes.
