descriptionHtml:
About Span

Span exists to help engineering organizations turn AI adoption into real effectiveness. As AI tools reshape how software gets built, the companies that continuously improve how their teams use AI in their day-to-day will pull ahead. We're the AI-native developer intelligence platform built for that moment. We're looking for people who want to shape how the next generation of high-performing engineering orgs operate.

We're a Series A company with a small, focused team that moves fast and ships things that matter. We’re proud to be helping forward-thinking orgs like Ramp, Carvana, Intercom, and OpenTable. We're honored to be backed by dozens of founders, CTOs, and CPOs we admire from Slack, Notion, Rippling, Fivetran, Coda, Adobe, and Square, as well as funds including Alt Capital, BoxGroup, Bling, Craft, and SV Angel.

About The Role

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to help build, scale, and maintain the infrastructure that powers Span.

You'll work closely with our engineering team to ensure our systems are reliable, secure, performant, and built to scale. From automating deployments and improving CI/CD pipelines to managing cloud infrastructure and strengthening observability, you'll play a critical role in making it easier for our engineers to build and ship great software.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, eliminating operational friction, and building systems that enable engineering teams to move faster.

What You'll Do

  • Own and scale our infrastructure: Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure to support our growing platform.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines: Build and optimize automated build, testing, and deployment workflows to help engineers ship quickly and confidently.
  • Automate everything: Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through infrastructure as code, scripting, and automation.
  • Strengthen reliability and observability: Implement and improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response processes to ensure system health and availability.
  • Optimize performance and costs: Monitor infrastructure utilization, identify inefficiencies, and improve performance while managing cloud costs.
  • Build secure systems: Partner with engineering and security stakeholders to implement infrastructure security best practices, access controls, and compliance requirements.
  • Enable developer productivity: Create tools, processes, and infrastructure that reduce friction and improve the developer experience.
  • Support production operations: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, investigate incidents, and implement long-term improvements.
  • Collaborate across engineering: Work closely with software engineers to support new features, architectural decisions, and evolving infrastructure needs.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
  • Strong experience managing cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of networking, Linux systems, cloud security, and infrastructure best practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting production systems and improving reliability.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to solving technical challenges.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
  • Experience supporting SaaS platforms or data-intensive applications.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure, workloads, or deployment patterns.
  • Experience with customer-managed cloud environments, including Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) architectures.
  • Experience with SOC 2 compliance and infrastructure security controls.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, databases, and high-volume data processing.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service infrastructure tooling.

descriptionHtml:
Altamira Technologies has a long and successful history providing innovative solutions throughout the U.S. National Security community. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, Altamira serves the defense, intelligence and homeland security communities worldwide by focusing on creating innovative solutions leveraging common standards in architecture, data and security. Altamira believes that our people and the culture of our company differentiate us from other companies.

Location: Dayton, OH

Position Description:

Candidate would need experience in Python programming, configuration/management tools such as Gitlab, containerization tools such as Docker and knowledge of microservices / container architectures (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), orchestration and automation. Must possess experience with designing and implementing AWS Cloud-based hosting solutions. Other skills to include: automated testing, automated deployments (CI/CD pipelines), and branching strategy and implementation.

Must Have:  

TS/SCI clearance

Bachelor's degree in CS or Computer Engineering

2+ years of experience developing tools and processes to drive DevOps, regression testing, monitoring, and pushing releases across environments

2+ years of experience troubleshooting, triaging, and resolving issues for CI/CD pipeline failures or slowness

Experience in Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, and Python or Golang

Experience developing enterprise cloud-native solutions

Experience working with application development teams across the software development life cycle and creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative team environment

Experience hosting applications on commercial cloud providers

Nice If You Have: 

Experience with Git, Bash

Experience creating and improving continuous automation across multiple technical stacks

Experience creating and improving continuous deployment tools built on Kubernetes

Experience bringing other organizations on board with DevOps, championing the adoption of DevOps processes, tools, and roles, and working with other development teams to recast work

Experience working in an agile software development environment

Experience working with the DoW

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, the scope of the position, relevant experience, education, certifications, internal equity, customer contractual requirements, security clearance requirements, and other legitimate business considerations.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 2-3 days a week) with a great team.

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Automate deployment processes and implement CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliability and rapid scaling of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to seamlessly integrate their applications into the operational infrastructure.
  • Monitor production systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve them rapidly to maintain high availability.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to optimize system performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, constantly exploring innovative ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge with one or more of the following:
    • Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
    • AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
    • Configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
    • Application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Comfortable operating in a terminal-based environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Must have or be able to obtain DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e., Security+) within 30 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 2-3 days per week at our San Antonio, TX office or on customer site as needed. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.
Preferred Requirements

  • Currently holds an active Top Secret security clearance and is willing/able to obtain an SCI read-in.
  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, Helm, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Experience with K9s, AWS CLI, AWS SNS, AWS SQS, and AWS Diode.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0253921

DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Today’s dynamic technology landscape demands constant and rapid innovation. To facilitate this transformation, we must ensure continuous integration and application development. That’s why we need an experienced DevOps engineer like you who’s eager to design, test, and program critical applications for our clients who need them most.

As a Software Factory DevOps Engineer on our team, you’ll pipeline our software development from requirements to testing in production. descriptionHtml:
This position is onsite (5 days a week)


Are you interested in leading the transformation of cancer care through putting world-leading scientific data and knowledge in the hands of doctors and other members of the medical team? Do you have a passion for solutions that empower patients to take charge of their care and bring world-class solutions to winning the cancer battle? If so, join our growing team at VieCure, the company that promises to revolutionize the way cancer care is delivered.


At VieCure, we are redefining the delivery of precision oncology through advanced clinical intelligence and innovative software platforms. Our cloud-based system leverages AI and real-time clinical data to support oncologists in delivering personalized, evidence-based care. As we continue to scale, our engineering team plays a critical role in building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our platform.


Role Overview

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer, Product and Technology. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of VieCure’s multi-tenant healthcare SaaS platform. This position combines cloud infrastructure engineering, CI/CD automation, infrastructure-as-code management, platform operations, security, compliance, and release management to support the continuous delivery of software solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Own CI/CD in Azure DevOps, consolidating duplicated pipelines into reusable, configuration-driven YAML templates with change detection. Implement build-once, promote-many deployment strategies, approval gates, rollback mechanisms, immutable tagging standards, and concurrency controls.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure using Terraform including module development, remote state management, pull request reviews, drift detection, and CI-driven deployment processes.
  • Container Platform Management: Administer Azure Container Registry and support Azure Container Apps, AKS, and App Service deployment platforms.
  • Multi-Tenant Platform Provisioning: Develop and maintain automated tenant onboarding, provisioning, configuration, feature flag, database, and resource management processes.
  • Identity, Security, and Compliance: Implement secure cloud architectures utilizing Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity, Key Vault, VNets, private endpoints, and least-privilege principles while supporting HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Build monitoring, logging, telemetry, dashboards, service-level objectives, and alerting solutions using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.
  • Reliability and Disaster Recovery: Define RTOs and RPOs and develop backup, restore, business continuity, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Release and Change Management: Own release governance, change control, deployment validation, and production readiness activities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Development, QA, Security, Operations, and Client Services teams.
  • Code Review and Engineering Standards: Promote infrastructure, automation, security, and DevOps best practices.
  • Documentation and Operational Readiness: Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, disaster recovery documentation, and engineering standards.


Requirements

  • Minimum of six years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum of three years supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
  • Deep experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines including YAML templates, environments, and deployment automation.
  • Strong experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Experience supporting Azure Container Registry, Azure Container Apps, AKS, and App Service.
  • Experience managing Azure SQL, geo-replication, storage services, and database deployment methodologies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity, Azure Key Vault, VNets, and private endpoints.
  • Experience designing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and observability frameworks.
  • Experience supporting HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, or similar regulated environments.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with .NET and Angular deployment pipelines preferred.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services and architecture.
  • Advanced proficiency with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline architecture.
  • Strong Terraform expertise including modules, governance, and state management.
  • Experience with Azure Container Registry, AKS, Azure Container Apps, and App Service.
  • Strong understanding of Azure SQL, Elastic Pools, Geo-Replication, and Azure Storage.
  • Experience with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and telemetry platforms.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, identity management, encryption, and network isolation.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, business continuity, and resilience engineering.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, audit controls, and PHI handling requirements.


Education / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, or AZ-400 are advantageous.
  • Additional cloud, automation, or security certifications are a plus.


Why VieCure

  • Mission-driven work in the healthcare space with real impact on patient outcomes
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking engineering culture
  • Competitive salary and benefits

descriptionHtml:
Short Description

Bowman has an opportunity for a DevOps Engineer to join our team remotely.

At Bowman, we believe in creating opportunities for aspiring people to thrive and achieve ambitious goals. That’s why a career at Bowman is more than a job. It is an opportunity to be part of a diverse and engaged community of professionals, to be treated as a respected and valued member of a motivated team and to be empowered to do exceptional work that advances the best interest of everyone involved. We recognize the importance of creating a work environment that is both rewarding to our employees and supportive of our unwavering commitment to provide unparalleled service to our clients.

Purpose

As a DevOps Engineer, you will support secure and reliable application delivery within a Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)–aligned landing zone. You will collaborate with development, security, and engineering teams to implement CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure and application deployments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and contribute to the evolution of DevOps standards and cloud engineering practices. This role focuses on building and enhancing automation, reliability, observability, and operational efficiency while building technical depth and contributing to platform ownership within enterprise cloud architecture and governance standards.

Responsibilities

Leadership and Direction

  • Receive broad objectives aligned to DevOps and cloud delivery initiatives and independently determine execution approach within established architectural guardrails. Apply diversified knowledge of DevOps, automation, and cloud engineering principles across assignments.

At The Operational And Company Level

  • Collaborate with IT, development, and business stakeholders to implement and enhance infrastructure and delivery pipelines aligned with enterprise cloud architecture and DevOps practices. Contribute to evolving automation and platform standards while supporting secure, reliable, and scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Enable and support operational teams through automated monitoring, alerting, and incident response, contributing to the diagnosis and resolution of cloud and application issues in coordination with cloud platform engineers.
  • Work closely with support, security, architecture, and development teams to embed DevOps practices across the solution lifecycle, ensuring secure and maintainable systems from build through production.

Do the Work

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure that enable reliable application delivery aligned with enterprise cloud architecture and governance standards.
  • Apply and advance DevOps and cloud operations best practices related to automation, security, governance, scalability, and reliability, contributing to the evolution of platform standards.
  • Support cloud migration, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives by designing and enabling automated build, test, deployment, and operational workflows aligned with the enterprise Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
  • Develop and deploy infrastructure and application delivery artifacts using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps tooling, and CI/CD practices in a governed enterprise cloud environment.
  • Ensure infrastructure and application deployments align with enterprise architecture standards, security controls, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, raising and resolving compliance considerations as needed.
  • Improve system performance, reliability, and availability through monitoring, alerting, automation, and structured continuous improvement practices.
  • Implement and maintain cost visibility, usage monitoring, and automation to support responsible cloud financial management.
  • Stay current with cloud services, DevOps tools, and emerging technologies, evaluating and applying improvements that enhance delivery and operational maturity.

Success Metrics and Competencies

  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization and external partners.
  • High degree of discretion and ability to manage highly confidential information.
  • Highly motivated and problem-solving attitude.
  • Strong sense of urgency in responding to constituents.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong work ethic and commitment to quality.
  • Self-reliance and ability to operate independently with limited direction.
  • Commitment to promoting the reputation of the company through quality of work.
  • Aspirations to grow professionally and advance within the company.
  • Effective working relationship with internal leaders and peers, as well as external clients.
  • Commitment to becoming a "citizen" of the broader organization, breaking down barriers and silos.
  • Commitment to working in partnership with others inside and outside the organization.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple time-sensitive tasks.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Five or more (5+) years of experience in DevOps engineering, cloud operations, or site reliability–focused roles, preferably in Azure.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, identity, networking, and security concepts, including zero trust models.
  • Experience contributing to the design, implementation, or migration of Azure cloud solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation in cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD workflows using tools such as Terraform, YAML, and Git-based pipelines.
  • Experience working within Azure environments aligned to the Well-Architected Framework (WAF) principles.
  • Experience supporting or contributing to Azure Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) environments and Landing Zones.
  • Proficiency with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling for performance, reliability, and incident management.
  • Working knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving issues across CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, and applications.
  • Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments preferred.
  • Familiarity with compliance and security frameworks such as CIS, NIST 800-53, and GDPR preferred.
  • Relevant cloud or DevOps certifications preferred.

About Bowman

Are you ready to build a career that makes a lasting impact? At Bowman, our people are at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, while helping to shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

A career at Bowman means being part of a collaborative, forward-thinking organization where innovation, inclusion, and growth are encouraged at every level. We offer competitive compensation, a supportive work environment, and benefits designed to help our employees succeed.

Salary and eligible variable compensation (if any) commensurate with experience. Range $ 116,000 - $147,000 and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Our Comprehensive Benefits Package Includes

  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and professional development support
  • Discretionary bonuses and other performance-based incentives
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness initiatives, and employee discounts

Eligibility for certain benefits may vary based on position, location, and employment status.

Physical Demands and Working Environment

  • Primarily indoor professional office environment which may include bright/dim light, noise, fumes, odors, and traffic.
  • Mobility around an office environment.
  • Frequent and prolonged use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc.

Job Description Disclaimer

Note: While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, it is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary at any time with or without notice.

Bowman is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you’d like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here.

Bowman has an obligation to provide and maintain a safe, healthy, and productive environment for its employees and clients. We are committed to maintaining a drug and alcohol-free workplace.

If you have any questions about the application process, please email recruiting@bowman.com.

Firefly Aerospace is seeking a DevOps Engineer II to join our growing infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust DevOps solutions that support our mission to make space accessible. You'll work closely with IT teams, software engineering, and system engineering teams to automate deployment pipelines, optimize infrastructure, and ensure system reliability across our technology stack.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Development

  • Design and implement infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform to provision and manage cloud and on-premises resources
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to automate build, test, and deployment processes
  • Create automation scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention
  • Contribute to designing scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions that support mission-critical aerospace applications
  • Implement monitoring and observability solutions to ensure system health and performance

Troubleshooting & Support

  • Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and deployment issues across Linux-based systems
  • Provide technical support for development teams, including troubleshooting build failures and deployment issues
  • Perform root cause analysis on system failures and implement preventive measures
  • Respond to and resolve incidents in a timely manner, including participation in on-call rotation
  • Optimize system performance through proactive monitoring and tuning

System Administration

  • Administer and maintain Linux servers (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) in development, staging, and production environments
  • Manage version control systems and implement Git workflows and branching strategies
  • Ensure security best practices are implemented across all infrastructure components
  • Maintain documentation for systems, processes, and procedures
  • Collaborate with security teams to implement compliance and security controls

Required Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Linux system administration (RHEL, Ubuntu, or CentOS), including shell scripting (Bash, Python)
  • Terraform: Demonstrated experience using and maintaining Terraform modules and managing infrastructure-as-code
  • Jenkins: Hands-on experience designing and managing Jenkins pipelines, including pipeline-as-code
  • Git: Demonstrated knowledge of Git version control, including branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and repository management
  • Automation: Strong scripting abilities in Bash, Python, or similar languages
  • Problem-solving: Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, TLS, routing, and load balancing
  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2-3 years experience of DevOps experience in a corporate environment
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, SaltStack)
  • Experience with monitoring and logging solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
  • Understanding of security best practices and compliance frameworks
  • Relevant certifications (Linux+, AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes)

Firefly offers outstanding benefits for our employees, including generous health, dental and vision plans with low plan deductibles, parental leave, relocation benefits, educational reimbursement, short term disability, and flexible PTO options.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

  • Collaborate with software and hardware teams to ensure CI/CD pipelines meet the unique needs of embedded systems.
  • Integrate version control, build tools, test frameworks, and deployment systems into a cohesive pipeline.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline performance, addressing bottlenecks or failures promptly.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and emerging tools in CI/CD and embedded development.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipeline tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or similar for pipeline automation.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and branching strategies.
  • Familiarity with containerization and virtualization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, QEMU) in embedded contexts.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of embedded software development and associated toolchains (e.g., GCC, Keil, IAR).
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing in CI/CD environments.
  • Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and their integration into pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team.

Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Success

  • 10+ years of experience Infrastructure Ops & Automation
    Leading the charge on improving the developer experience through the use of modern technologies and innovative uses of open source tooling
  • A security-focused approach, ensuring that policies and procedures and followed entirely and improved when inadequate
  • Working with individuals spanning engineers, product, design, IT, and security
  • Working embedded with engineering teams to evaluate and improve system architecture and deployment quality
  • An innate drive to improve existing systems and processes while developing end-to-end designs to facilitate our critical platform services
  • Documenting everything, understanding why documentation is important, and ensuring proper tracking of issues and/or architecture design changes
  • You should be able to support 24*7 to various teams 
  • You should have Database experience

Desired Experience

Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Computer Science (or equivalent experience)

Cloud platforms

  • You have a high level of skill with all managed services offered by various cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc) - AWS preferred.

Disciplined coding in an agile environment

  • You're well versed in breaking features into tickets, then scoping and working those tickets from PR to release. We do 1-to-2 week sprints as well as Kanban.

CI/CD services

  • You can design and implement a full release pipeline including unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and automatic rollback. We use GitHub Actions, Poetry, Helm, 
  • Serverless Framework.

Infrastructure as Code

  • You can design and implement an IaC codebase that builds an entire company's cloud resources (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, etc).  We use Terraform, Atlantis, and Terragrunt.
  • You understand the importance of key management and can architect and leverage tools such as Hashicorp’s Vault.

Container orchestration

  • You have an understanding of the full stack of abstractions provided by modern container orchestration platforms such as Apache Mesos and Docker Swarm. We use Kubernetes.

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

Success

Cloud platforms

descriptionHtml:
ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will own the delivery of scalable, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions that directly support critical systems and business outcomes. Your role is essential in driving infrastructure excellence across teams by enabling secure, high-performing deployments, optimizing cloud usage, and fostering a strong DevOps culture through mentorship and cross-functional collaboration.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement scalable infrastructure solutions that align with system performance, security, and cost-efficiency goals.
  • Write optimized Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automate cloud-based deployments using modern tools and practices.
  • Support containerized workloads and orchestrate services using tools such as Docker Compose or Kubernetes.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune distributed systems for optimal performance and availability.
  • Establish observability practices by designing health signals and monitoring systems for production workloads.
  • Automate patching, vulnerability scanning, and other compliance-related activities.
  • Evaluate and reduce technical debt, and implement strategies for ongoing system improvement.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge through code reviews, tech talks, and process improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems design, cloud architectures, and multi-layer applications.
  • Strong experience with AWS services and cloud-native computing patterns.
  • Proficiency in writing scalable and optimized IaC.
  • Advanced understanding of authentication, authorization, and general software security practices.
  • Hands-on experience with serverless workloads and container orchestration technologies.
  • Ability to debug complex performance issues and conduct root-cause analysis in production environments.
  • Skilled in cost optimization for cloud services.

Base salary for the role is commensurate with experience and can range between $100,000 - 145,000 + annual bonus opportunity.

Hiring Locations

Our main office is located in Center City, Philadelphia, where we operate on a hybrid model with in-office work required three days a week for local employees. We believe collaboration is most effective when teams come together, which is why we prioritize hiring in the Philadelphia area.

For certain roles, we also hire from hub locations—regions where we have an established presence with multiple team members working remotely. While these employees primarily work from home, we bring them together in person at least once a year for team-building, collaboration, and strategic planning.

Due to tax and labor regulations, we can only hire from specific states. Remote work is supported in the following key hub locations and approved states:

Hub Locations:

  • Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
  • Boston, Massachusetts
  • New York City, New York
  • Baltimore, Maryland
  • Washington, D.C.
  • Charlotte, North Carolina
  • Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina
  • Atlanta, Georgia
  • Chicago, Illinois

Approved States for Remote Work:

CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TN, and VA.

About HealthVerity

HealthVerity is the leader in privacy-protected real-world data exchange, transforming how healthcare and life sciences organizations connect and analyze disparate patient data. By enabling access to the industry’s largest RWD ecosystem, HealthVerity supports critical applications in clinical development, commercial strategy, regulatory decision-making, and public health. To learn more about HealthVerity, visit healthverity.com.

Why you'll love working here

We are making a difference – Our technology is at the forefront of some of the biggest healthcare challenges in the world.

We are one team – Our people define our culture and always will. We take time out to celebrate each other, and acknowledge the value that each of us adds towards our greater mission. Come share all you have to offer.

We are learners – Every team member is continually learning, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or much longer. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our clients, partners, and each other.

Benefits & Perks

Our benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support and enrich the experience of our full-time employees, with eligibility limited to those in permanent positions.

  • Compensation: competitive base salary & annual bonus opportunity (for non-commissioned roles)
  • Benefits: We offer health, dental, and vision coverage starting on day 1. We also offer a 401(k) plan and an equity program, with new hire equity grants beginning at the Director level and above.
  • Flexible location: Remote workdays and 3 days a week of in-office collaboration for team members in the Philadelphia area. Check location requirements with the recruiting team.
  • Generous PTO: Take time off as needed, targeted at 4 weeks per year, including vacation, personal and sick time, plus paid parental leave.
  • Parental Leave: 12 weeks paid leave for childbearing, surrogacy, and adoption; 6 weeks for non-childbearing parents.
  • Comprehensive and individualized onboarding: mentorship program, departmental talks, and a library of resources are available beginning day 1 for each new team member to minimize the stress of starting a new job
  • Professional development: biweekly 1:1s, hands-on leadership that is goal-and growth-oriented for each team member, and an annual budget to support professional development pursuits

We believe incorporating different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds make us stronger and encourages an environment where ageism, racism, sexism, ableism, homophobia, transphobia or any other form of discrimination are not tolerated. All qualified job applicants will be given consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. At HealthVerity, we’re working towards an innovative and connected future for healthcare data and believe the future is better together. We can only do that if everyone has a seat at the table.

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to careers@healthverity.com

Remote opportunities are not available in all areas and require team members to work from a fixed location due to tax and labor law implications - specific questions about remote positions can be discussed during the interview process with your recruiter.

descriptionHtml:
Rhombus Power, Inc. delivers AI-powered predictive intelligence in real time for defense and national security organizations worldwide. Our mission-built products— Ambient AI and Guardian— are transforming strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making. By empowering the shift from reactive analysis to proactive, predictive intelligence and decision support, Rhombus Power is providing foresight and freedom of action when it matters most.

Come join our cross-disciplinary and world-class team that is delivering game-changing solutions to transform global security.

Learn more about Rhombus Power, Inc. and watch a demonstration of Guardian, our AI Platform here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3PxY6su1Q-Q

https://www.youtube.com/@rhombuspower8558/videos

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iby5WVNfQiI

See the following articles to learn more about what we do:

https://www.rhombuspower.com/news-and-media

Location: Palo Alto, CA (HQ)

Travel: This position involves both domestic (CONUS) and international (OCONUS) travel at roughly 15%

We are building technology for national security and defense missions at the highest levels of government and decision-making. Our software helps bring together complex data, systems, and workflows to support critical decisions across the national-security enterprise. As our platform scales, our technology must operate reliably across cloud, on-premises, and distributed environments.

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to help make that possible. This is an opportunity for an ambitious engineer with strong technical foundations who wants to take meaningful ownership, solve challenging problems, and grow quickly in a high-impact environment.

You will own the systems that take our software from a developer’s laptop all the way into production—and increasingly into distributed customer and edge environments. You will work across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, observability, automation, security, and edge deployment to make our software easier to build, deploy, operate, and scale.

This is an end-to-end ownership role. You won't be limited to a narrow infrastructure function or handed fully defined requirements. You will help identify problems, determine the right approach, build the solution, deploy it, operate it, and continuously improve it. When something breaks, you will be expected to understand the problem, work across layers of the stack, and drive it through to resolution.

We are looking for someone who already has strong technical fundamentals, is naturally curious, learns quickly, and wants to take on increasingly difficult problems. You should be excited by the opportunity to grow your scope rather than waiting for someone else to define it.

Because we operate in defense environments, our deployments can be very different from a typical SaaS environment. You may work with cloud infrastructure one day and help deploy software into a disconnected, bandwidth-constrained, resource-constrained, or otherwise challenging environment the next. You will work directly with software engineers, technical leadership, customers, and field teams to make those deployments successful.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end deployment lifecycle—from source control, builds, and testing through production and edge deployment, monitoring, upgrades, recovery, and ongoing operations.
  • Build and improve CI/CD systems that allow engineering teams to build, test, package, and release software quickly and reliably.
  • Design and automate deployments across cloud, on-premises, and distributed edge environments, including environments with limited connectivity, constrained resources, or other operational challenges.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code, creating repeatable, version-controlled environments that can be deployed consistently across cloud and edge locations.
  • Deploy and operate containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and related technologies, including configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
  • Create the tooling engineers need to move faster. Identify repetitive or fragile processes and turn them into reliable automation.
  • Build operational capabilities for configuration management, application lifecycle management, observability, logging, health monitoring, and fleet management across distributed environments.
  • Own reliable release and recovery mechanisms, including deployment validation, rollbacks, upgrades, failure recovery, and disaster recovery.
  • Partner closely with software engineers to improve application architecture, deployment patterns, developer workflows, testability, and operational reliability.
  • Troubleshoot problems across the full stack. Investigate issues spanning applications, containers, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, infrastructure, and deployment systems—and drive them to resolution.
  • Help build secure-by-default infrastructure and delivery practices, including appropriate access controls, vulnerability management, secrets management, and secure software delivery, while maintaining engineering velocity.
  • Support production systems and deployments, including participation in an on-call rotation for critical systems as the team and customer footprint grows.
  • Help shape the deployment architecture as we scale, evolving our platform from early-stage product development toward operating software reliably across a growing distributed customer and edge footprint.
  • Get close to the real-world mission. Travel 15–20% CONUS and OCONUS to support deployments, field operations, customer environments, and system integration activities.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong technical foundations in Linux, networking, systems, and software development workflows.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines, preferably including taking them from an initial implementation to a reliable production system.
  • Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows and platforms such as GitHub or GitLab.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, or another programming language used to automate infrastructure and operational workflows.
  • Experience implementing automated testing, deployment validation, monitoring, and rollback processes.
  • A solid understanding of networking, APIs, system configuration, and distributed systems.
  • The ability to diagnose problems across application, infrastructure, networking, and deployment layers rather than treating each as an isolated domain.
  • Working knowledge of practical software and infrastructure security, including identity and access management, vulnerability management, secrets, and secure configuration.
  • Experience deploying software in distributed, on-premises, or edge environments is highly desirable, but not required.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with software engineers, technical leadership, customers, and field teams.
  • Curiosity and a strong learning mindset. You don't need to know everything; you need to be willing and able to figure things out.
  • A bias toward ownership. You naturally ask, "What needs to happen to make this work?" rather than "What part of this was assigned to me?"
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment where requirements change, problems are sometimes ambiguous, and you may need to define the problem, build the solution, deploy it, and own the outcome.
  • Willingness and ability to travel, roughly 15% CONUS and OCONUS

What We Value

We care less about whether you've worked with every technology on our stack and more about how you approach problems.

The Right Person For This Role

  • Has strong engineering fundamentals and is eager to keep building on them.
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Can move between the details and the bigger picture.
  • Is comfortable saying, "I don't know yet," and then figuring it out.
  • Enjoys building rather than simply maintaining.
  • Looks for ways to automate, simplify, and make systems more reliable.
  • Wants to understand how software behaves in the real world, not just how it works in a development environment.
  • Is energized by difficult deployment environments and problems that don't have an obvious playbook.
  • Wants their responsibilities and impact to grow as they demonstrate capability.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means engineering can move quickly without being held back by deployment and operational complexity.

Software moves predictably from development to production. Deployments are repeatable rather than bespoke. Cloud and edge environments can be provisioned and updated through automation. Failures are observable, diagnosable, and recoverable. Engineers can understand the health of their systems without needing to become infrastructure experts.

You will have significant ownership over how we build, deploy, and operate our software, and your scope will grow as you demonstrate that you can take on more. This is a role for someone who is ready to go beyond their current experience—not because they already know everything, but because they are ambitious, technically capable, and eager to learn.

Salary Range

  • The estimated base salary range for this position is $100,000/year to $120,000/year. Final salary will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Benefits

  • Full medical, dental, vision coverage for employee and dependents
  • 401k matching program
  • PTO and Holidays
  • Bonus and other incentive programs
  • Access to mental health program
  • Access to Flexible Spending Accounts for Health Care, Dependent and Commuter

About Rhombus

Rhombus Power Inc. (Rhombus) is a startup located in the heart of Silicon Valley at Stanford Research Park in Palo Alto.  We use cutting-edge cross-disciplinary approaches to solve pressing Big Data and Sensing problems in security, energy, and healthcare. Our advisory board includes two Nobel Laureates and a Draper Prize winner.

Rhombus compensates, motivates, and develops employees, who are trusted, empowered, and involved. Employees have clear roles and expectations – and their roles are flexible enough to move at the speed of innovation in order to meet and exceed client expectations. We have a unique culture of global purpose, rooted in the innovation and progress of Silicon Valley.

Rhombus knows that diversity is a condition for success. We are committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

descriptionHtml:
AndHealth is on a mission to radically improve access and outcomes for the most challenging chronic health conditions, with the goal of making world-class specialty care accessible and affordable to all. We partner with health systems, community health centers, and independent practices to remove barriers to care to ensure all people have access to the care they deserve.

The Opportunity

Our platform runs on Google Cloud and Firebase, so you won’t spend your days patching servers or nursing infrastructure. Instead, you’ll build the systems that let a small, fast-moving engineering team ship safely: infrastructure as code, trustworthy pipelines, and automation that handles the routine work before anyone has to touch it.

As our DevOps Engineer, you’ll own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and security automation our engineers rely on every day. You’ll bring existing infrastructure under code, make our CI/CD pipelines faster and more trustworthy, and build automation, including AI-assisted systems, that triages and resolves routine security and operational work. The goal is to make it easier for people to build, test, and ship software.

You’ll work in person alongside the engineering team, and much of what you build will be for them. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You’ll share production health and on-call responsibility with the team, and you’ll have room to shape how we operate as we grow. This is an on-site role in Columbus, Ohio, and is not remote or hybrid.

What You’ll Do In The Role

  • Keep production dependable. Share on-call and incident response with the team, improve monitoring and alerting so problems are easy to diagnose, and lead or join root cause analysis after incidents. Write and test runbooks and recovery procedures before they’re needed.
  • Bring all infrastructure under one source of truth. Move the parts of our environment built by hand in the cloud console into Terraform, and keep access, service accounts, secrets, and certificates in order so nothing depends on someone’s memory.
  • Help engineers ship quickly and with confidence. Own our GitHub Actions workflows and deployments across development, staging, and production. Build faster feedback loops, stronger validation, and rollbacks that work. As AI-assisted development changes how we build software, help rethink the path from code change to trusted release.
  • Remove friction from developers’ day. Find where engineers get slowed down and build the internal tools and patterns that clear those obstacles. You’ll work inside the engineering process, not as a separate ops queue.
  • Automate security and compliance work. Partner with our security team to triage findings as they appear, gather context, and propose fixes for human approval. Apply the same approach to SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence gathering and control documentation.
  • Eliminate repetitive chores. Automate recurring operational and engineering work, including building and deploying AI agents where they help, with clear checks and human oversight. When a new platform need comes up, evaluate the options and recommend one.
  • Own the engineering side of Zoom. Zoom supports our meetings, phone system, patient visits, transcription, and Contact Center. You’ll handle integrations, API automation, reporting, and analytics. Day-to-day telecom administration is handled separately.

Education & Licensure Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Other Skills Or Qualifications

  • Software and DevOps depth. About 6 to 10 years of experience, with a software development foundation and hands-on DevOps, platform, or SRE work. You’ve operated production systems, not only designed them.
  • Cloud and infrastructure-as-code experience. Strong experience with a major cloud provider (Google Cloud is a plus) and Terraform or comparable tools
  • CI/CD experience. You’ve built and maintained delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar) and can explain the tradeoffs behind testing, promotion, deployment, and rollback.
  • A history of building internal tools. You’ve built and maintained tools that other engineers or teams actually use.
  • An AI-forward approach. You’ve built or deployed AI agents or AI-assisted automation, and you understand where they help, where they don’t, and what the risks are. You’re eager to use these capabilities, not waiting to see if they pan out.
  • Security awareness. You understand IAM, secrets, vulnerability management, and the practical controls needed in a regulated environment.
  • Operational judgment. You can investigate an unfamiliar failure, communicate clearly during an incident, and follow through afterward. You’re willing to take part in on-call.
  • Independence. You don’t need much oversight, and you’re ready to grow toward staff-level scope.
  • Cross-functional range. You work well with engineers, security, compliance, IT, and vendors.

Nice To Have

  • Firebase, Node.js/TypeScript, Docker or container orchestration
  • SOC 2 or HIPAA experience, healthcare technology
  • Developer-experience work
  • Zoom APIs, telephony, or contact-center platforms
  • A home lab or side projects. Many people who thrive in roles like this build and experiment outside of work, but it’s never required.

Here’s What We’d Like To Offer You

  • Equal investment and support for our people and patients.
  • A fun and ambitious start-up environment with a culture that takes on important things, takes risks, and learns quickly.
  • The ability to demonstrate creativity, innovation, and conscientiousness, and find joy in working together.
  • A team of highly skilled, incredibly kind, and welcoming employees, every one of whom has something unique to offer.
  • We know that the overall success of our business is a collaborative effort, and we strive to provide ongoing opportunities for our employees to learn and grow, both personally and professionally.
  • Full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits package which includes Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance, Paid time off, Short- and Long-Term Disability, and more.

We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Enlighten, honored as a Top Workplace from USA Today, is a leader in big data solution development and deployment, with expertise in cloud-based services, software and systems engineering, cyber capabilities, and data science. Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.

We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done—while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.

Why Enlighten?

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

  • 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
  • 10% 401k benefit.
  • Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
  • Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $137,510.00 - $185,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment between Enlighten headquarters and customer sites in MD (on average 3 days a week).

If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

#Mid-Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
  • Support development and deployment of non-cloud (Edge) infrastructure of on-premise and portable equipment.
  • Automate deployment processes and ensure reliability and scalability of services.
  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate their applications into the infrastructure.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and resolve issues as necessary.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, continuously exploring new ways to improve our infrastructure.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active TS/SCI with CI Poly U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 9+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 7 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 13 years relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
  • Proficient in configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Experience with application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
  • Ability to develop in multiple programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
  • Must be comfortable in a terminal-based environment.
  • Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.
  • Must have a DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e. Security+) or ability to obtain within 60 days of hire.
  • Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 3 days per week between our Columbia, MD office and customer sites in Fort Meade and Annapolis Junction. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with big data technologies like: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
  • Experience with K9s, AWS CLI and other AWS services like SNS, SQS and Diode is a plus.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

The DevOps Engineer designs and implements a fully automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) ecosystem, Internal Developer Portal (IDP), and secure cloud networking across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. The role also contributes to scalable cloud network architecture, self-service tooling, network-aware CI/CD pipelines, and integrated developer platform capabilities that standardize software delivery across the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities, as They Align to Ryan’s Key Results

Key Responsibilities

People

  • Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency.
  • Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices.

Client

Internal Developer Portal (IDP)

  • Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows.
  • Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load.
  • Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms.
  • Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata.
  • Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements.

Value

Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications.
  • Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines.
  • Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices.
  • Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability.

Cloud and Infrastructure Automation

  • Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy-as-code.
  • Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.

DevOps and Platform Best Practices

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation.
  • Six or more years of hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives for new tools and processes.
  • Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, security, and operations teams.
  • Clear, transparent communication style with a bias toward documentation and shared ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or implementing a commercial Internal Developer Portal, such as Harness IDP, Port, or a similar platform.
  • Experience implementing platform engineering concepts and developer self-service models.
  • Familiarity with service mesh, application programming interface (API) gateways, or cloud-native networking.
  • Experience implementing security automation and compliance guardrails.
  • Knowledge of observability platforms, including Datadog, Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK), and cloud-native tools.
  • Experience in multicloud or hybrid cloud environments.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related technical field.

Certificates and Licenses

  • Valid driver’s license required.
  • AWS and/or Azure certifications preferred; professional-level or specialty certifications preferred.
  • Additional certifications in DevOps, Kubernetes, or cloud technologies are a plus.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

  • Standard indoor working environment.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.


Northrop Grumman Space Systems is looking for a DevOps or Principal DevOps Engineer to augment our team. This position is based in Aurora, CO


Primary Responsibilities

  • Responsible for planning and evolving processes and infrastructure to execute programs supporting rapid capability maturation and deployment.
  • Integrates development pipelines leveraging automation with test-driven development tools and continuous integration/test frameworks.
  • Define and implement the build, deployment, provisioning, and monitoring standards for the program.
  • Ensures implementation of Software Configuration Management (SCM), code quality, and code coverage with automated testing for Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Work as part of an Agile development team to deliver end-end automation of deployment, monitoring, and infrastructure management framework.
  • Build and configure delivery environments supporting CD/CI tools using an Agile delivery methodology.
  • Create scripts and/or templates to automate infrastructure provisioning and management tasks.
  • Work closely with development teams to create an automated continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) system.
  • Work together with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution
  • Monitor and support all installed systems and infrastructure.
  • Develop custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks.
  • Contribute to the design of information and operational support systems.
  • Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools.
  • Oversee the company’s security, backup, and redundancy strategies.
  • Evaluate application performance, identify potential bottlenecks, develop solutions, and implement them with the help of developers.

This position can be staffed at a level 2 or 3, based on the basic qualifications below.


Basic Qualifications

  • United States Citizenship is required to be considered.
  • Must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope, with the ability to obtain and maintain SCI approval/access.
  • Must have an active U.S. Government CI Polygraph at time of application, current and within scope.
  • Level 2: Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of relevant experience; 0 years with a Master's
  • Level 3: Bachelor’s degree with 5 + years of relevant experience; 3 years with a Master's
  • Experience with integration and testing of software
  • Experience deploying services in a Kubernetes environment using Helm Charts
  • Ability to troubleshoot and fix deployments and then update charts to ensure future success
  • Strong Linux skills
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between system expertise and tier 1 support


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying one of the following: Kafka, Nifi, or Confluent
  • Experience working as Tier 3 support for an operational system

Secondary Level Salary Range: $114,000.00 - $171,000.00
